data.value: Tanga server yakaiswa neSynix, wobva wazvitaura muSatisfactory ′s in-game Server Manager. Dzokai pano kuti mubatanidze API.

data.name: Satisfactory.ConnectedHint
data.value: API yakabatana ne{0}. Fungisisa kuti uwane mashoko aripo.

data.name: Satisfactory.SetupSteps
data.value:
Pedzisa kumisikidza kwekutanga muSatisfactory ?? s Server Manager uye chengeta server ichimhanya ne-NewConsole.
Dzvanya pasi apa. Synix inotumira murayiro, inoverenga chiratidzo chitsva, inochiongorora, uye inochengetedza zvakachengeteka. Hapana kutevedzera kana kuisa.

data.name: Satisfactory.Error.AmbiguousToken
data.value: Console yakadzosa zviratidzo zvakasiyana. Hapana kubatana kwakachengetedzwa.

data.name: Satisfactory.Error.ConsoleUnavailable
data.value: Synix haikwanisi kuwana unreal console server iyi. Tanga ne-NewConsole uye shandisa zvakafanana Windows mvumo yeSynix uye server.

data.name: Satisfactory.Error.ConsoleTokenMissing
data.value: Murayiro wacho wakatumirwa, asi Synix haina kukwanisa kuverenga chiratidzo chitsva chose kubva pakuburitswa kwebasa iri. Ongorora kuti server iri kupindura uye kuti zvinyorwa zvayo zvinogona kunyorwa here. Chero kubatana kwakaponeswa kwakachengetwa; Mutungamiriri haana kuedzwazve.

data.name: Satisfactory.Error.ConsoleBusy
data.value: Console haisi kupindura kana kubatana kuri kutoitika. Mirira, edza zvakare. Murayiro wacho hauzombodzokororwi.

data.name: Satisfactory.TokenSafety
data.value: Izvi zvinopa Synix Administrator kuwana. Chiratidzo chacho chakavharidzirwa nokuda kweakaundi yako yeWindows uye hachina kumbobvira chawedzerwa kumitambo yekugadzirisa kana kutangisa nharo. Satisfactory inoratidzira mune yayo pachayo console uye zvinyorwa; chengeta avo private. Kubvisa kubatana kwakaponeswa hakubvisi chiratidzo.

data.name: Satisfactory.SecurityHelp
data.value: Mushure setup muna Satisfactory, kutanga Server pamwe -NewConsole. In Synix: Server Options → Satisfactory Control Center → Connect API → Connect zvoga. Kubatanidzwa uku kusingabvumirwi hakumboregi kutonga kwevashandisi.

data.name: GameDefinitions.Builder.Guide
data.value:
Kurumidza Kutanga 1. Pinda zita chairo remutambo uye nhamba Steam Server AppID. 2. Pinda Server executable nzira zvichienderana yakaiswa Server dhairekitori. 3. Pinda chete mashoko omurayiro anotevera executable. Shandisa zviratidzo zvinotsigirwa pazasi apo Synix inofanira kuisa marongero emushandisi. 4. Sarudza kuti mutambo unowana sei faira rakagadziriswa. A maneja muoti kunoda zvizere, kushanda configuration faira, kwete chikamu muenzaniso. 5. Sarudza Validate & Preview. Gadzirisa dambudziko rimwe nerimwe rakataurwa usati waponesa. 6. Chengetedza, kuvakazve Synix, kumhanya automated miedzo, ipapo bvunzo kugadzwa / kutanga / kumisa / kuongorora mutambo.
MAFARO ANodiwa • Zita remutambo: zita rinoonekwa nevashandisi muSynix. • Definition ID: unique smallcase ID; Synix inoigadzira kubva muzita remutambo kwauri. • Steam AppID: yakatsaurirwa server AppID, kwete nguva dzose mutengi mutambo AppID. • SteamCMD app configuration: kazhinji isina chinhu. Shared GoldSrc AppID 90 mitambo inoshandisa fomu yakasimbiswa "90 mod folder", zvakadai se "90 mod cstrike". Synix inogamuchira chete fomu iri rakachengeteka. • Inogona kuitwa: somuenzaniso Binaries\Win64\Server.exe. Haisanganisi folda yekuisa. • Ports: Verified default mutambo uye mubvunzo ports. • Mepu uye mitambo yemitambo: pindai kukosha kumwe chete kwemutambo pamutsetse mumwe nomumwe. Izvi zvinozadza zvisarudzo zvinoratidzwa pakugadzira kana kugadzirisa sevha.
ZVINOTAURWA NEZVEKUTENGA Usapinda mubhuku racho pacharo. Chengetedza mureza mutambo yakatarwa sezvo dzose rugwaro uye kuisa Tags chete nokuda tsika kudzorwa Synix. Muenzaniso: -port {port} -queryport {query} -name "{ServerName}" -maxplayers {MaxPlayers}
ZVINONYANYA ZVINOTsigirwa [LAUNCH_ARGUMENT_TAGS]
RCON RECIPE Isa {rcon} muhurongwa hwekutanga apo murairo wekusarudza weRCON unofanira kuva. MuRCON syntax, shandisa: [RCON_ARGUMENT_TAGS] Muenzaniso RCON syntax: +rcon.port {rcon_port} +rcon.password "{rcon_pass}"
KUGADZIRIRA KWAKAITIKA • Haisati yaongororwa: Synix haichengeti faira rekugadzirisa. • Game inoigadzira mushure mekutanga kutanga: shandisa configuration yakazara yakabatwa sechinhu chekugadzirisa nekugadzirisa template. • Synix inoigadzira kubva pane template: Synix inoisa kugadziriswa kwakazara pamberi pekutanga kutanga. • Vhura nharo chete: mutambo haudi kugadziriswa kwehurongwa uhwu.
ZVIMWE ZVINONYANYA TEMPLATE TAGS {ServerName}, {Password}, {HasPassword}, {AdminPassword}, {MaxPlayers}, {Port}, {QueryPort}, {RCONPort}, {RCONPassword}, {EnableRcon}, {Identity}, {WorldName}, {WorldSeed}, {WorldSize}, {AppPort}, {LocalIP}, {PublicIP}, {IsPvp}, {IsPve}, {GameMode} {HasPassword} inonyora kukosha kwechokwadi kwekutsanangurwa kana password ye server iripo uye kukosha kwayo kwenhema kana password isina chinhu. Shandisa Wedzera mafaira ekugadzirisa kana sevha ichida mafaira anopfuura rimwe. Sarudza faira rimwe nerimwe rakazara, wobva wagadzirisa nzvimbo yaro yakaiswa patafura kuitira kuti nzira yacho ienderane nefaira re server. Synix inosimbisa, inosanganisa, inonyora, inogadzirisa, uye inovandudza mafaira ose akanyorwa pamwe chete.
MAFAERA ANODIWA ANOPIWA NEMUSHANDISI Isa nzira imwe yakachengeteka pamutsetse, ichibva muforodha yakaiswa seva. Mafaera anodiwa anodzivisa kutanga kusvikira avapo; mafaera esarudzo anopinzwa kana awanikwa asi haadzivisi kutanga. Kana mafaera anodiwa achibva mumutambo wakajairika, tsanangura danho rimwe nerimwe remushandisi mumirayiridzo yekugadzira. Synix haidhawunirodhi mafaera evatambi ane rezinesi, hainzvengi kodzero dzevaridzi uye haiaparadzirizve. Forodha yedata yekunze izita reforodha iro Synix inogona kutsvaga pasi pemaforodha eDocuments emushandisi. Risiye risina chinhu kana mushandisi achifanira kukopa mafaera nemaoko.
Yambiro Yokutanga-Yekutanga uye ICON Ita kuti chiyeuchidzo chizivikanwe apo vashandisi vanofanira kupedza kugadziriswa vasati vatanga kutanga. Nyora matanho chaiwo uye tsanangura zvose zvinofanira kuwanikwa nomushandisi kubva pakugadzwa kwemutambo. Icon URL inosarudzwa uye inofanira kushandisa HTTPS. Synix inodzokera kune yakaiswa server executable icon kana isina chinhu.
KUDZIDZIRWA KWEZVIMWE NEZVINHU Tanga tsanangudzo itsva uye matemplate pakudzokorora 1. Wedzera kuongororwa kwedudziro pese panoshanduka tsanangudzo yemutambo. Wedzera shanduko yetemplate chete apo marongero ekugadzirisa anotarisirwa achinja. Synix inoramba kunyora pasi pasina shanduko yepamusoro uye inochengetedza backup yekuvandudza.
POST-INSTALL OPTION Bvumira Steam runtime kukopa chete kana Server yave akasimbiswa kuti kunoda. Chinangwa chacho chinofanira kuva faira rakati mukati meiyo server installation. Synix inotora zvinyorwa zvayo zvitatu zvakatenderwa Steam runtime DLLs chete.
ZVINODZIDZISWA Nenguva Isa shoma hurongwa RAM kuna 0 kana mutambo hauna verified shoma. Hardware uye Windows runtime checks kutsanangura kushayikwa zvinodiwa pamberi configuration uye kuvharira ngozi kutanga; hazvichinji Windows marongero. Sarudza .NET Framework kana Visual C ++ runtime chete kana zvinodiwa nemutambo zviri pamutemo zvichiratidza. Synix inoongorora registry yeWindows asi haimbogadziri kana kudhawunirodha zvinodiwa zvisati zvaitwa. Hyper-V inoda Windows Professional kana yakakwirira, saka kusarudza Hyper-V kunosarudzawo kuti Windows chinodiwa.
ZVINHU ZVAKAITIKA Pakutanga Shandisa kutevedzera maitiro akajairwa kumaseva akazvipira. Kushandiswa kwekunze kunongogadzirirwa mutyairi wekutanga, muchina chaiwo, kana kumwe kushandiswa uko kune hupenyu hwehupenyu hwemaseva; inoita kuti kuongorora mibvunzo kusashande. Gadza Inodiwa Inoratidzika Manager yemitambo iyo yepamutemo server manager inofanira kuramba yakavhurika. Izvi zvinopesana nechisarudzo chevashandisi chepasirese checonsole yekuvanzika chete nokuda kwetsanangudzo iyoyo. Kukwidziridzwa kwekutanga kunotsigirwa chete kune .exe, .bat, uye .cmd kutanga mafaera. Bvumidza kutengeswa kwefaira rekutanga chete kana mushandisi achigona kugadzira nekumhanyisa faira rekutanga rakadzokororwa kunze kweSynix. Mharidzo yakagadzirira inoratidzwa pashure pokunge mitambo yokugadzirira yakakodzera yaitwa. Iyi minda inosarudza yakavakirwa-mukati, inobvumidzwa Synix maitiro uye haigone kumhanya script kana plugins.
LOG DISCOVERY Pinda nzira dzakachengeteka dzine chokuita nefaira rebasa rakaiswa. Shandisa * kune imwe nzira chikamu kana faira zita uye ** nokuda nested mafaira. Vatsigiri venzvimbo ndivo {Identity}, {ServerName}, {WorldName}, {Port}, uye {QueryPort}. Mienzaniso: logs\latest.log, Saved\Logs\*.log, profiles\{Identity}\logs\**\*.log. Synix inotsvaga nzira idzi chete kana mushandisi akakumbira kuvhura zvinyorwa zvitsva zvemutambo.

data.name: Text.ED08E4C207A6FC2493D7
data.value: ◇ Minda inonzwisisika inotevedzera Synix Privacy Mode.

data.name: Text.4234688FB477D9CF1421
data.value: ◇ Kudzora kunoziva template: marongero asina kuwanikwa anodzorwa otomatiki kumutambo wakasarudzwa.

data.name: Text.1B0142C80D27A3442046
data.value: ⚠ Kuchinja nzvimbo iyi hakubvisi zvekuchengetedza kubva mufolda yapfuura.

data.name: Text.A9B62C4456D11AE0550C
data.value: 🔒 [REQUIRED] Pinda Server Name uye sarudza Game Template.

data.name: Text.1A759326BD5A56996BF1
data.value: 1 DHAYI RENyu RIRI KUPARANA Maseva, marongero, backups, runtimes, uye SteamCMD anochengetwa pasi peC:\Synix saka kugadzirisa kwekushandisa hakuvatsivi.

data.name: Text.CD33F03B524794FFF78C
data.value: 2 Wedzera Server Sarudza mutambo, pinda zvigadziriso zveushamwari, uye rega Synix uiise. Steam login inodikanwa chete kana mutambo wacho uchidaro.

data.name: Text.61A00FCEB996AF15FF21
data.value: 3 START, STOP, AND VERIFY Synix inoratidza nharo dzakananga dzekutanga, inovimbisa kutanga, inoshandisa maitiro akachengeteka ekumira kana achitsigirwa, uye inochengeta zvinyorwa zvenguva pfupi zviripo.

data.name: Text.CA9A7AA7C8AF17BABA8C
data.value: 4 Network Access Windows Firewall mvumo uye router chiteshi forwarding zvakasiyana. Synix inoongorora kukakavadzana kwomunyika, asi haimboshandisi router yako.

data.name: Text.C638A97009ED3C9CCB29
data.value: 5 RECOVERY AND BACKUPS Shandisa Settings > Advanced > Troubleshooter kuti uongorore uye ugadzirise zvinhu zvakanaka. Shandisa Backups usati watamisa Synix kana kuita kuchinja kukuru.

data.name: Text.2B2D3EED7C841FFB78AA
data.value: Kudzora kwekupinda, maitiro ekutanga, uye kusangana

data.name: Text.74ECEE4668229DC04361
data.value: Zita reakaundi, kwete zita rako rekuratidzira reSteam

data.name: Text.C404A6A32FD8F56893D3
data.value: Wedzera mamwe matemplate ose akazara ayo mutambo unoda. Gadzirisa Nzvimbo yakaiswa kuitira kuti nzira imwe neimwe ienderane neakaiswa server folda.

data.name: Text.8F2ED817BE8BBE23D64C
data.value: Uchapupu hwekushandisa hunobva pane zvinoitwa neSynix; nharo dzinoda kuongororwa kwechokwadi-server.

data.name: Text.BC489FF2DAD82D69C258
data.value: Automatic safety checklist uye matanho anotevera

data.value: Anogadzira otomatiki yakachengeteka mutambo / Server dhairekitori pazasi configured Games nzira.

data.value: Zvikamu zvinotanga neMicrosoft yakajeka inotungamirira kurodha pasi kana nguva yekumhanya isisipo.

data.name: Text.AAFE71EF1584DE2CA4E2
data.value: Anovhara setup ine mashoko akajeka kana purogiramu yacho isingatsigiri AVX2.

data.value: Tarisa nguva dzekumhanyisa dzakagovaniswa, mafaera emaseva, marongero, zviteshi, Windows Firewall, diski nzvimbo, maitiro akambomiswa, zvinyorwa zvazvino, uye hutano hweSynix kugadzirisa kubva panzvimbo imwechete.

data.name: Text.37923AD83E636BE4C27F
data.value: Ongorora SteamCMD kuti uwane zvichangobva kuitika usati watanga kushanda.

data.value: Ongorora SteamCMD, runtimes, server mafaira, configurations, zviteshi, Windows Firewall, diski nzvimbo, kuvhiringidzwa pezvakaitwa, ichangobva Logs, uye update utano.

data.name: Text.1DF3BE2046D08A780F73
data.value: Inotarisa kuburitswa kwebhuku chaiko pasina kuvakazve Synix, kutanga kusunungurwa, kana kuwana C:\Synix.

data.value: Inoongorora kuburitswa kweWindows .NET Framework yakaiswa mushandisi asati atanga.

data.value: Sarudza rudzi rwevashandisi kuti uratidze nhoroondo yavo yekusimbisa.

data.name: Text.22FCE0291808752AD7BC
data.value: Sarudza backup inofanira kutsiva mafaira aripo.

data.name: Text.30F3BBCB43AC48EBFD1C
data.value: Sarudza mutauro unoshandiswa neSynix. Kugadziriswa kwemutambo uye kukosha kwekugadzirisa kunoramba kuri muChirungu.

data.value: Pedzisa kugadzwa kwefaira kunodiwa mushandisi akazvitsaurira asati atanga.

data.value: Nzira yekugadzirisa maererano neakaiswa server folda

data.value: Bvumidza kubviswa kwemitemo ye firewall yakanyorwa

data.name: Text.C2BD3BDCD4926716C67B
data.value: Ramba uchizviita pashure pokunge waongorora matanho anodiwa.

data.value: Kopa mafaira eSteam akaiswa pasi mushure mekuisa

data.value: Inofukidza nguva yakabatana yeMicrosoft inoshandiswa nemaseva aripo 2015, 2017, 2019, uye 2022.

data.value: Gadzira yakasimbiswa yakavakirwa-mukati mutambo tsanangudzo pasina plugins kana magwaro. Zvinorondedzerwa zvinoponeswa mupurogiramu yacho uye zvinowanikwa chete pashure pokunge Synix yavakwazve.

data.value: Usabatanidza mapassword, webhooks, IP kero, configuration private, kana zvizere kutanga mirairo. Synix inobvisa zvakavanzika zvakajairika isati yatumira.

data.name: Text.89BF7052C30A2A455D98
data.value: Mutemo wega wega unonongedzera kune inoitwa pasi peC:\Synix\Games\[Game]\[Server], asi iyo yega server faira yapera uye hapana yakaiswa Synix server ine nzira.

data.value: Gadzirisa serverconfig.xml zvakachengeteka pasina kuchinja XML chimiro chayo.

data.value: Ingogoneswa chete kana kusingazivikanwe kuiswa kweSteamCMD kukundikana uye account yeSteam ichidikanwa.

data.name: Text.2F7C7C280CF67E40627A
data.value: Ingobvumidza chete kana sevha isingakwanise kumhanya nemazvo pasina Windows kukwirira.

data.name: Text.615A691F61191EE9C393
data.value: Gonesa RCON chete nokuda mutambo Templates kuti rutsigiro akachengeteka kure mirairo.

data.name: Text.59AD73A66B0E19C3759F
data.value: Gadza kana server ine mubvunzo wakaongororwa kana network probe iyo Synix inogona kutarisa.

data.name: Text.518F7A1D974E46AED149
data.value: Pindai maID muchitevedzano chavanofanira kutakura. Shandisa makomamu, nzvimbo, kana kuti chitupa chimwe chete pamutsetse. Synix haidi dhatabhesi yemazita emhando.

data.name: Text.E486E8326F69B31FB7D5
data.value: Pinda mashoko omutambo, wobva waongorora usati waponesa.

data.value: Muenzaniso: Server inovhara masekondi mashomanana mushure mekutanga

data.value: Kushandiswa kwekunze kunogadzirirwa vatyairi kana michina chaiyo uye kunoita kuti kuongorora mibvunzo kusashanda.

data.name: Text.0078A1C33BF28B41D89B
data.value: Inowana mitemo iyo inoshanda yaive pasi peC:\Synix\Games\[Game]\[Server], asi iyo chaiyo server haina kuchengetwa uye faira yayo ye server yaenda. Zviteshi uye zvigadziro zvekuisa zvisina kufanira hazviongororwi.

data.value: Vhara kero dzeIP, mapassword, uye mamwe mashoko anonetsa paunenge uchigovana skrini.

data.name: LaunchCommand.Error.UnsafeBatchValue
data.value: Nzvimbo yokutanga ye{0} haigoni kupfuudzwa zvakachengeteka kuburikidza neiyi Windows batch launcher. Mashoko akabatanidzwa kaviri, mitsetse yakaparadzaniswa, kana kuti mashoko anosiyana-siyana haatsigirwi pano. Kukosha kwacho hakuna kuchinja.

data.name: LaunchCommand.Error.UnsafeBatchArguments
data.value: Mutemo wakazadziswa webatch une mutongo usina kuchengeteka kana kuti shanduko yekuwedzera. Ongorora kukosha kwekutanga uye zvikonzero zvekuwedzera; hapana chakatanga.

data.name: Configuration.Editor.Error.YamlUnsupported
data.value: YAML mutsetse {0} haisi kushanda kana kuti inoshandisa chinhu icho mupepeti uyu asingagoni kuchinja zvakachengeteka. Inotsigirwa: gwaro rimwe chete rine mapepa/zvinyorwa zvakarongedzwa uye tsika dzemutsetse mumwe chete. Kuyerera kuunganidzwa, multiline tsika, Tags, anchors, uye aliases havasi kutsigirwa. Hapana chakaponeswa.

data.name: EmpyrionMods.Error.Profile
data.value: Kugadziriswa kwepakiti iyi kunotsigirwa chete pamafaira eEmpyrion's Documented Content.

data.name: EmpyrionMods.Error.FolderName
data.value: Shandisa zita refaira re1–80 mavara, pasina slashes, Windows mazita akachengetwa, kana kutungamira / kumashure nzvimbo. Zita remamiriro ezvinhu harigoni kuva nhamba yeWorkshop chete.

data.name: EmpyrionMods.Error.Layout
data.value: Sarudza mamiriro ezvinhu akazara akadhindwa kana kuti purogiramu yakagadzirwa ye server mod, kwete kugadzwa kwemutambo, kuunganidzwa kweWorkshop, bhuruu, kana archive yekodhi.

data.name: EmpyrionMods.Error.ScenarioLayout
data.value: A mamiriro ezvinhu anofanira kuva gameoptions.yaml uye ayo Content, Playfields, Sectors, kana Prefabs zvinhu pamwe chete, kana ZIP mudzi kana mukati imwe mamiriro ezvinhu foshoro.

data.name: EmpyrionMods.Error.ScenarioCode
data.value: Iyi purogiramu yemamiriro ezvinhu ine DLL, C#, kana JAR code. Pinda server code yoga kuburikidza Empyrion Server mods pashure pokudzokorora munyori mirayiridzo.

data.name: EmpyrionMods.Error.ModLayout
data.value: Sarudza mod package yakakwana yakanyorwa: mafaira eDLL uye mafaira avo anotsigira anofanira kunge ari pamudzi wepakiti kana mukati memafolda ega ega emod. Mamwe mafaira emucheka uye zvizere archives server hazvigamuchirwi.

data.name: EmpyrionMods.Error.MissingScenario
data.value: Izvozvo hazvisi kuitika. Tanga waisa mamiriro ezvinhu akazara, wobva wasarudza kubva pane zvakagadzirwa.

data.name: EmpyrionMods.Error.ConfigurationChanged
data.value: Mamiriro ezvinhu kana kuti zvigadziriso zvekuchengetedza zvakachinja apo hwindo iri raiva rakavhurika. Vhara uye sarudzazve mamiriro acho ezvinhu.

data.name: EmpyrionMods.Error.ExistingSave
data.value: Rudzi irworwo rwuripo. Mamwe mamiriro ezvinhu anoda zita idzva risina kushandiswa. Synix haina kutsiva kana kubvisa nyika iripo.

data.name: EmpyrionMods.Error.Configuration
data.value: dedicated.yaml haisipo, yakakura kwazvo, kana kuti haina GameConfig.CustomScenario uye GameConfig.GameName marongero. Tanga wagadzira server yacho.

data.name: EmpyrionMods.Error.SaveFailed
data.value: Synix haina kukwanisa kuchengetedza chinyorwa chebasa. Kugadziriswa kwemamiriro ezvinhu akapfuura kwakadzorerwa; Rudzi rwomutsigiri rwakachengetwa.

data.name: EmpyrionMods.Error.ProtectedScenario
data.value: Synix haizobvisi mamiriro ezvinhu akasarudzwa kana zvinhu zvemaitiro apo nyika dzakachengetedzwa dziripo. Nyika idzodzo dzinogona kuramba dzichienderana nemafaira. Hapana mafaira emamiriro ezvinhu akabviswa.

data.name: EmpyrionMods.ImportedScenario
data.value: Mafaira emamiriro ezvinhu aivigirwa kunze. Nyika iripo uye kusarudzwa kwemamiriro ezvinhu hazvina kuchinja. Shandisa Sarudza Scenario kusarudza mamiriro ezvinhu uye chengetedza zita. Chengetedza zita rimwechete refaira rekutarisa kana uchinge waisa zvigadziriso.

data.name: EmpyrionMods.Picker.ScenarioHelp
data.value: Nyora muSteam uye rega kurodha pasi kupera, wobva wasarudza faira yemamiriro ezvinhu pasi pesteamapps\workshop\content\383120, kana kusarudza mamiriro ezvinhu akazara ZIP. Izvi zvinopinza kopi yomunharaunda; Steam haizogadziridzi kopi yebasa racho.

data.name: EmpyrionMods.Picker.ModHelp
data.value: Sarudza ZIP yakazara yakagadzirirwa server mod kana faira kubva kumunyori waunovimba naye. Chengetedza DLLs, _Info.yaml (kana yakapihwa), kuvimba uye zvinhu pamwechete. Synix haibudisi zvinoenderana kana kumhanya mod code pachayo.

data.name: EmpyrionMods.Picker.FolderName
data.value: Zita refaira remamiriro ezvinhu pane server (shandisazve zita iri kuti ugadzirise)

data.name: EmpyrionMods.Selection.Confirm
EmpyrionMods.Selection.Saved
data.value: Nyaya yacho uye chisarudzo chekuchengetedza zvakachengetwa. Ita kuti server igadziriswe kana yagadzirira, wobva waongorora zvinyorwa zvayo zvemutambo wobva wasangana nemutengi. Mabhokisi enyika aripo akachengetwa.

data.name: EmpyrionMods.Selection.Help
EmpyrionMods.Selection.SaveName
data.value: Chengetedza zita (GameConfig.GameName ?? kwete zita rekuratidzira re server)

data.value: Mamwe mamiriro ezvinhu anoda kuponeswa patsva. Synix inopa zita idzva uye haimbobvisi kana kunyora pasi nyika iripo.

data.value: Pinda faira rakadhindwa kana kuti ZIP. Shandisa Sarudza Scenario gare gare; kuchengetedzwa kwezvivako zviripo.

data.value: Tumira pasi mafaira akazara emamod kana maZIP. Ongorora kuvimba kwomunyori; kodhi inomhanya muEmpyrion.

data.name: EmpyrionMods.Remove.Confirm
data.value: Dzokorora kutengeswa kwezvinhu zvine {0} here? Mafaira ose akaiswa nepakeji imwe cheteyo achabviswa kana kudzorerwa kumakopi avo ekare, kusanganisira mamwe ma mods ari mupakeji. Mafaira akachinjwa kunze kweSynix achadzivisa kudzokorora. Ramba uchiita backup yakazara yevashandi usati waenderera mberi.

data.name: ModPackages.Error.FolderUnsupported
data.value: Iyi add-on system haitsigiri kutengeswa kwemafolda. Sarudza imwe yemapakeji ayo anotsigirwa.

data.name: ModPackages.Error.Layout
data.value: Sarudza faira rakazara remamodeli kana mafirimu rine mafaira epakiti anodiwa, kwete kuiswa kwemutambo kana kuunganidzwa kwekurodha pasi kusingabatanidzwi.

data.value: Mapakeji acho anodarika miganhu yekupinza yeiyi add-on system, kana kuti zviri mukati mayo zvakashandurwa panguva yekutepfenyurwa. Hapana chakaiswa.

data.name: ModPackages.Picker.Help
data.value: Sarudza mod ZIP yakakwana kana faira yemutambo uye framework yakasarudzwa. Chengetedza zvinyorwa zvayo zvinodikanwa, kuvimba uye zvinhu pamwe chete. Ongorora nzvimbo yauri kuenda uye tarisa zvabuda usati waisa.

data.value: Iyi faira yemamiriro ezvinhu yatovapo. Mafaira anoenderana achatsiviwa, izvo zvinogona kukanganisa nyika dzinoshandisa mamiriro ezvinhu aya. Ramba uine backup yakazara yevashandisi uye shandisa zita rakasiyana remafolda kune imwe mamiriro ezvinhu. Mafaira epasi rakaponeswa haazoshandurwi.

data.value: Mafaira ehurumende akaiswa, asi Synix haina kukwanisa kuchengetedza marongero eserver. Ongorora mvumo dzemafolda uye chengetedza gadziriro yebasa zvakare usati watanga. Mafaira akaiswa haana kubviswa.

data.name: MinecraftWorkspace.OverviewHelp
data.value: Gadzirisa server yakasarudzwa yeMinecraft pano. Rega kuita izvozvo usati wachinja mafaira, nyika, mapakeji, kana kuti nguva yekumhanya. Tanga, mira, uye tangazve kushandisa Synix's normal lifecycle safeguards.

data.name: MinecraftWorkspace.OverviewValues
MinecraftWorkspace.ScheduleHelp
data.value: Shandisa purogiramu yokutangazve uye yokuraramisa, kusanganisira kumirira vatambi nokuita backup yakazara kutanga. Nguva dzinoshandisa nguva yePC iyi. Synix inofanira kunge iri kumhanya kuitira kuti purogiramu yayo itange kushanda.

data.name: MinecraftWorkspace.ScheduleValues
MinecraftWorkspace.PlayersHelp
data.value: Gadziridza kuti uone mazita ari paIndaneti uye zvinyorwa zvekuwana zvakachengetwa. Sarudza kana kuti nyora zita remutambi, wobva wadzokorora zvawakaita. Mirayiro inoda sevha inomhanya uye kubatana kwekonsoli inoshanda. Bedrock haitsigiri mirairo yekurambidza Java.

data.name: MinecraftWorkspace.SettingsHelp
data.value: Edita server.properties uye mod / plugin configuration mafaira. Vhoriyamu inoshandiswa neSynix inowirirana apo server.properties inochengetwa. Zita rakashambadzirwa / MOTD rakaparadzaniswa nezita remuno rekunyora uku. Refresh inodzorerazve kugadziriswa kwekunze kwekugadzirisa paunenge wakamira.

data.name: MinecraftWorkspace.EditorHelp
data.value: Save inogadzira makopi ekudzorera. Kuchinja ports, nyika, mbeu, mutambo muoti, mutambi muganhu, uye akatsigira Minecraft kudzora marongero zvakare update Synix. JSON, XML, uye YAML inoongororwa isati yachengetwa; mamwe mafomati anoda kugadziriswa nokungwarira. Chengeta zviratidzo zvako zvakavanzika.

data.name: MinecraftWorkspace.WorldsHelp
data.value: Pinda Java kana Bedrock nyika ZIP mune itsva dhairekitori, ipapo sarudza kuti kurishandisa. Nyika dziripo hadzina kutsiviwa. Mabhuku acho haashandurwi. Kuchinja hakuiti kuvandudza, kudzikisira, kana kuongorora kuwirirana kwemutambo / mod yenyika; dzokera shure kutanga.

data.name: MinecraftWorkspace.ModsHelp
data.value: Ongorora metadata yeJAR uye zvinoenderana, maneja imwe neimwe yekuwedzera, kana kuongorora yakazara server pack. Shandisa purogiramu chaiyo mutambo shanduro uye loader kuvaka. Kuongorora kuwirirana kunopa mazano uye hakuratidzi kuti kodhi yakachengeteka kana kuti mod imwe neimwe ichashanda.

data.name: MinecraftWorkspace.BackupsHelp
data.value: Zvigadziro zvizere zvinosanganisira foshoro ye server, nyika, zvinowedzerwa, uye gadziriso. Tanga wamisa server. Ongorora kuvimbika kwako usati wadzorera. Kudzorera kunotsiva mafaira eserver; zvikwereti zvinoongorora kuvimbika kwezvinyorwa, kwete kuti backup ine dambudziko riripo kare here.

data.name: MinecraftWorkspace.RecoveryHelp
data.value: Chinhu chimwe nechimwe chinoshandurwa chinochengeta mafaira apfuura uye hashes. Sarudza shanduko yakashandiswa kana kuti yakamiswa kuti uidzore. Dzokorora kuchinja kutsva kunowirirana kutanga. Mafaira akagadziridzwa nechokunze uye nyika inoshanda inotorwa inodzivirirwa. Ramba uine zvekuchengetedza zvizere zvenguva yekumhanya / nyika yekuvandudza.

data.name: MinecraftWorkspace.DiagnosticsHelp
data.value: Tsvaka matambudziko akajairika mubhuku re server rekare uye mushumo wekupedzisira wekuparara. Zvakawanikwa zvinongova zviratidzo, kwete zvinokonzera. Process CPU/RAM haisi Minecraft TPS/MSPT; shandisa in-server inowirirana profileer pakusarudza tick performance.

data.name: MinecraftWorkspace.ConfirmStop
data.value: Kurambidza server iyi kuburikidza Synix ikozvino?

data.name: MinecraftWorkspace.ConfirmRestart
data.value: Tangazve sevha iyi kuburikidza neSynix ikozvino?

data.name: MinecraftWorkspace.RuntimeNotice
data.value: Isa shanduro yemutambo yakasarudzwa, loader, uye kuvaka kubva kunzvimbo dzavo dzepamutemo? Izvi zvinogona kudhawunirodha Java uye kumhanya yepamutemo Forge / NeoForge installer. Mafaira eserver anotangwa pakutanga; mafaira akambochinjwa anochengetwa kuti awanezve. Nyika nedzimwewo dzakachengetedzwa. Ita backup yakazara usati wachinja shanduro dzemutambo. Hapana server yemutambo yakatanga.

data.name: MinecraftWorkspace.ConfirmPlayer
data.value: Kutumira mutambi akasarudzwa murayiro? Kusvika kwomushandisi kunopa kutonga kwakakura pamusoro pemushandi wemutambo.

data.name: MinecraftWorkspace.ConfirmWorld
data.value: Kushandisa nyika yakasarudzwa pakutanga kunotevera? Nyika yazvino inoramba iri padisiki. Ingosarudza nyika inowirirana neshanduro, shanduro, uye mods yebasa iri.

data.name: MinecraftWorkspace.PackNotice
data.value: Kununura iyi yakavimbika Server rongedza? A Modrinth rongedza anogona kudhawunirodha referenced mafaira kubva mvumo HTTPS manyuko. Mods uye magwaro emitambo runomhanya bumbiro mukati mutambo Server. Kugadziriswa, hash, kuwirirana, uye kuongororwa kweantivirus kuripo hazvisi vimbiso yokuchengeteka. Ongorora kuchinja kwose usati wazvishandisa.

data.name: MinecraftWorkspace.CompatibilityNotice
data.value: Cheki dzinoverenga metadata pasina kutakura mod code. Nhamba dzakaoma dzemavhezheni, kuvimba kwemamiriro ezvinhu, uye mamwe metadata akabatanidzwa / akagara nhaka anoda kuongororwa nemaoko. Kuongorora uku hakuvimbisi kuwirirana kana kusavapo kwe malware.

data.name: MinecraftWorkspace.BackupSpace
data.value: Ongorora nzvimbo yokuchengetedza uye nzvimbo iripo.

data.name: MinecraftWorkspace.ConfirmBackup
data.value: Kugadzira backup yakazara yeiyi server yakamira?

data.name: MinecraftWorkspace.ConfirmRestore
data.value: Kudzorera backup yakazara yakasarudzwa? Mafaira aripo eserver achatsiviwa. Ongorora zvinyorwa zvacho uye chengeta mafaira ose aripo aunoda usati waenderera mberi.

data.name: MinecraftWorkspace.UndoNotice
data.value: Tora mafaira epamberi ekuchinja uku. Mafaira akawedzerwa nokuchinja uku anobviswa chete kana asina kuchinja. Mafaira akachinjwa anodzivisa kudzoreredza. Kuchengetedza kwakakwana kunodikanwa kudzorera chero shanduko yenyika yakaitwa mushure mekutanga shanduro yemutambo yakasiyana.

data.name: MinecraftWorkspace.NoLogFindings
data.value: Hapana muenzaniso unozivikanwa wakawanikwa mumabhuku aripo achangobva kuwanikwa. Uku hakusi kuongororwa kwakazara kwehutano. Shandisa Kugadzirira uye tarisa kukanganisa kwekutanga pedyo nenguva yekukundikana.

data.name: MinecraftWorkspace.PreviewSummary
data.value: Ongororo isati yashandiswa: {0} itsva • {1} yakatsiviwa • {2} yakabviswa. Mafaira akanga apfuura anochengetwa kuti apore. Hapana server yakatanga.

data.name: MinecraftWorkspace.Error.Runtime
data.value: Iyo yakakumbirwa yakagadzikana server kuvaka kana kurodha pasi metadata haina kuwanikwa. Dzorerazve chisarudzo cheshanduro/kuvaka woedzazve.

data.name: MinecraftWorkspace.Error.Size
data.value: Zvinhu izvi zvinopfuura miganhu yefaira rinotsigirwa, metadata, kana kuti ukuru hwose.

data.name: MinecraftWorkspace.Error.Recovery
data.value: Dhiyabhorosi rekudzorera harisipo kana kuti harienderani. Chengeta faira rekudzorera uye shandisa backup yakazara yakasimbiswa.

data.name: MinecraftWorkspace.Error.PendingRecovery
data.value: Kushandiswa kwezviripo kwakapfuura kunoda kudzorerwa. Vhura Changes Recovery woigadzirisa usati waita imwe shanduko.

data.name: MinecraftWorkspace.Error.Changed
data.value: Faira rakashandurwa kubvira pakadzokororwa kana kuti kubva pakuitwa uku. Gadziridza uye dzokorora zvakare. Hapana zvinyorwa zvisingabatanidzwi zvichanyorwa.

data.name: MinecraftWorkspace.Error.Layout
data.value: Kugadzirwa kwepakiti kana kuti nzira yacho haina kuchengeteka, haina kujeka, kana kuti haina kutsigirwa. Sarudza server pack inotsigirwa kana kuti world archive.

data.name: MinecraftWorkspace.Error.ActiveWorld
data.value: Iyi ndiyo nyika inoshingaira yokunze. Shandukira kune imwe nyika usati wabvisa kutengeswa kwayo.

data.name: MinecraftWorkspace.Error.WorldExists
data.value: Folda yenyika iyoyo yatovapo. Sarudza zita idzva remafolda; nyika dziripo hadzina kumbobvira dzanyatsokanganiswa nekunze.

data.name: MinecraftWorkspace.Error.WorldLayout
data.value: Sarudza archive ine nyika imwe chete ne level.dat. Zvirongwa zvizere-server uye multi-nyika dzinoshandisa backup / restore workflow pachinzvimbo.

data.name: MinecraftWorkspace.Error.WorldEdition
data.value: Nyika iyi haibvumirani neshanduro yeserver kana kuti inoshaya nzvimbo yayo inotarisirwa / mafaira edhatabhesi. Nyika dzeJava neBedrock hadzina kutendeuka.

data.name: MinecraftWorkspace.Error.WorldName
data.value: Shandisa zita refaira renyika rakachengeteka, risina nzira kana mazita akachengetedzwa eWindows. Pamusoro penyika dzinotorwa, shandisa tsamba, nhamba, nzvimbo, mitsetse, kana kuti zviratidzo.

data.name: MinecraftWorkspace.Error.JavaOnly
data.value: Basa iri rinoitirwa Java server mods/plugins. Shandisa Bedrock's own supported add-on workflow; Java JARs haigoni kumhanya paBedrock.

data.name: MinecraftWorkspace.Error.PackEmpty
data.value: Hapana zvirimo mumaseva zvakatsigirwa zvakawanikwa. Zvirongwa zvekutanga, mafaira emutengi, nguva dzekufamba, nyika, uye marongero e-root server hazvisi kutorwa kunze ne modpack workflow.

data.name: MinecraftWorkspace.Error.LoaderMismatch
data.value: Rudzi rwezviri mukati haruenderani nesoftware yevashandisi yakasarudzwa. Mods vanoda matching mod loader; Bukkit / Paper plugins inoda plugin runtime.

data.name: MinecraftWorkspace.Error.CurseForgeManifest
data.value: Ichi chinonzi CurseForge client manifest, kwete server pack yakazara. Dhawunirodha server yemunyori ZIP ine ma mods chaiwo uye marongero; mafaira asina kuwanika haasi kushayikwa.

data.name: MinecraftWorkspace.Error.PackVersion
data.value: Minecraft vhezheni yepakiti uye loader/build inofanira kuenderana neserver iyi. Tanga wasarudza nguva iyoyo chaiyo. Zvitoro zvisina kutsigirwa hazvichinjiwi.

data.name: MinecraftWorkspace.Error.DownloadSource
data.value: Kudhanilodha kana kutungamirirwazve hakusi gwaro revanhu vose HTTPS rinotenderwa. Shandisa chirongwa cheZIP chinotsigirwa nemunyori.

data.name: MinecraftWorkspace.Error.DownloadHash
data.value: Faira rakadhindwa harina kuenderana nehukuru hwaro hwakataurwa kana hash yeSHA-512. Hapana chakaiswa.

data.name: MinecraftWorkspace.Error.Properties
data.value: Mutengo weMinecraft unoshandiswa neSynix hauna kushanda kana kuti unopesana. Ongorora zviteshi, muganhu wemutambi, nzira yemutambo, uye marongero ekudzora usati waponesa.

data.name: MinecraftWorkspace.Error.SaveEntry
data.value: Synix haina kukwanisa kuchengetedza updated server kupinda. Basa racho harina kugamuchirwa; mafaira ekudzoreredza akachengetwa pazvinenge zvichidiwa.

data.name: MinecraftWorkspace.Error.ManagementLocal
data.value: Synix's Minecraft management connection inofanira kuramba iri pa localhost. Usashandisa Indaneti kuti uone izvi.

data.name: MinecraftWorkspace.Error.PortConflict
data.value: Chiteshi chakagadziriswa ndecheimwe server yeSynix. Sarudza chiteshi chakasiyana usati waponesa.

data.name: MinecraftWorkspace.Error.Player
data.value: Sarudza chiito chinotsigirwa uye zita remutambi rinoshanda. Kurambidzwa kweJava hakusi mirairo yeBedrock.

data.name: MinecraftWorkspace.Error.StartFailed
data.value: Server haina kutanga. Ongorora Kugadzirira uye log yebasa re dashboard usati waedzazve.

data.name: MinecraftWorkspace.Check.MetadataUnknown
data.value: Metadata haina kukwanisa kuverengwa zvizere. Ongorora faira racho uye zvinodiwa nemunyori waro.

data.name: MinecraftWorkspace.Check.Duplicate
data.value: Anopfuura JAR rimwe chete repamusoro-soro rinozivisa chiziviso ichi. Ongorora uye bvisa shanduro yakadzokororwa.

data.name: MinecraftWorkspace.Check.ClientOnly
data.value: JAR iyi inozvizivisa kuva mutengi chete. Usaisa pane server yakatsaurirwa.

data.name: MinecraftWorkspace.Check.WrongLoader
data.value: Metadata yeJAR iyi haibvumirani nemutoro/software yakasarudzwa.

data.name: MinecraftWorkspace.Check.DependencyMissing
data.value: Kuvimba kunodikanwa kusingawaniki mu metadata yakatsanangurwa: {0}. Tarisa uone kuti zvinhu zvakanyatsosanganiswa sei kana kuti ndezvipi zvisingabatsiri usati waisa chimwe chinhu.

data.name: MinecraftWorkspace.Check.DependencyReview
data.value: Manually tarisa kuvimba {0}: inodiwa {1}, scanned {2}. Rondedzero iyi / shanduro haina kunzwisiswa zvizere.

data.name: MinecraftWorkspace.Log.Java
data.value: Nhoroondo yacho inoratidza kusawirirana kweJava/class-version. Shandisa shanduro yeJava inodikanwa neserver yakasarudzwa uye mod loader.

data.name: MinecraftWorkspace.Log.Memory
data.value: Nhoroondo yacho inoratidza kuti Java haina kukwanisa kugovera ndangariro yakakwana. Ongorora RAM iripo, muganhu wevashandi, uye kana mamwe maseva ari kuushandisa.

data.name: MinecraftWorkspace.Log.Dependency
data.value: Nhoroondo yacho inotaura nezvezvinodikanwa zvekuvimbika. Ongorora kukanganisa kwekutanga kwekutakura, wobva waongorora mod chaiyo, kuvimba, shanduro yemutambo, uye kuvakwa kwekutakura.

data.name: MinecraftWorkspace.Log.Port
data.value: Nhoroondo yacho inoratidza kuti chiteshi chacho chave kushandiswa. Ongorora mamwe maitiro uye zviteshi zvakagadzirirwa server iyi; usavhure zviteshi zvisina hukama zve firewall.

data.name: MinecraftWorkspace.Log.Eula
data.value: Nhoroondo yacho inoda kugamuchirwa kweMinecraft EULA. Verenga uye ugamuchire muhurongwa hwokutanga hwekushanda kana uchibvumirana nazvo.

data.name: MinecraftWorkspace.Log.Tick
data.value: Nhoroondo yacho inotaura nezvekufamba zvishoma nezvishoma kana kuti nguva yokuchengeta imbwa. Tarisa CPU mutoro, nyika chizvarwa, masangano, uye mods. Zvimwe RAM chete zvingasaita kuti izvi zvigadziriswe.

data.name: MinecraftWorkspace.Log.Mixin
data.value: Kanganiso yemusanganiswa inowanzobatanidza musanganiswa usingaenderani we mod/loader. Ongorora chikonzero chokutanga mumushumo wekuparara uye shanduro dzinodiwa dzepakiti.

data.name: MinecraftWorkspace.Log.World
data.value: Nhoroondo yacho inotaura zvikanganiso zvokuverenga mashoko enyika. Mira server uye chengetedza mafaira aripo usati waedza kuvimbiswa kwekudzivirira kunowirirana.

data.name: MinecraftWorkspace.Error.RuntimeRecovery
data.value: Chivako ichi chekare hachina nguva yekumhanya yakanyorwa. Shandisa zvizere Server negadziriro yeparutivi kudzorera; Synix haizofungiri mutakuri wayo wapfuura uye shanduro.

data.name: MinecraftWorkspace.Error.RuntimeMismatch
data.value: Nguva yekumhanya yakaiswa haibvumirani neshanduro yakasarudzwa, vhezheni, loader, kana Java chinodikanwa. Vhura Minecraft Control Center uye shandisa Apply Runtime usati watanga.

data.name: MinecraftWorkspace.Error.InvalidValue
data.value: Huwandu hwe{0} hahuna kushanda. Gadzirisa marongero aya usati waponesa.

data.name: MinecraftWorkspace.Empty
data.value: Hapana zvinhu zvokuratidza. Gadziridza mushure mekuwedzera zvemukati kana kuchinja marongero eiyi server.

data.name: MinecraftWorkspace.CompatibilitySummary
data.value: {0} add-ons yakaonekwa • {1} zvakawanikwa kuti zviongororwe. Kuongorora uku hakushanduri mafaira.

data.name: MinecraftWorkspace.NoCompatibilityAddOns
data.value: Hapana zvekuwedzera zvakawanikwa mu active mods kana plugins folder yeiyi server setup.

data.name: MinecraftWorkspace.NoCompatibilityFindings
data.value: Hapana nyaya dzakawanikwa pakuongororwa kwemetadata. Izvi hazvirevi kuti mod dzose kana kuti plugin dzichashanda pamwe chete.

data.name: AsaPackages.Help
data.value: Sarudza ASA Windows-server ZIP yakadhindwa kana faira rakatorwa. Synix inowana mod descriptors mukati me flat, yakaputirwa, kana multi-mod mapakeji uye inogadzirira yavo CurseForge IDs kuti iongororwe. Mafaira eZIP haana kukopwa kana kuiswa. ASA inotora uye inorekodha iyo yazvino sevha yekuvaka yeanopa paunotanga sevha; izvi hazvisimbisi shanduro yeZIP.

data.name: AsaPackages.Choose
data.value: Sarudza ZIP kana faira rokuongorora. Hapana marongero eserver kana mafaera achachinjwa kusvikira iwe waongorora uye uchengetedza mod ID rondedzero zvakasiyana.

data.name: AsaPackages.Trust
data.value: Metadata yemapakeji haina kuvimbwa nayo. Kuzivikanwa hakusi kuongorora malware, kuongorora kuwirirana, kana kuti uchapupu hwokuzivikanwa kwemuparidzi.

data.name: AsaPackages.Reading
data.value: Kuverenga metadata yepakiti. Hapana mod code inoitwa.

data.name: AsaPackages.Found
data.value: {0} mods yakaonekwa; {1} maID matsva okuwedzera. Zvitupa zviripo zvinochengeta urongwa hwazvo. Ongorora rondedzero yose usati waponesa.

data.name: AsaPackages.Timeout
data.value: Kuongororwa kwepakiti kwakadzimwa kana kuti kwakatora nguva yakareba. Sarudza faira duku uye edzazve.

data.name: AsaPackages.Error.Source
data.value: Sarudza ARK Server mod ZIP kana kuti rakatorwa mod forodha. Mamwe mafomati emafaira haatsigirwi nemuverengi uyu.

data.name: AsaPackages.Error.Limit
data.value: Pasuru yacho inodarika miganhu yemutori wemetadata. Sarudza homwe duku kana ZIP kwete kupfuura 100 mod descriptors.

data.name: AsaPackages.Error.Layout
data.value: Mupakeji wacho une nzira dzisina kuchengeteka, zvinongedzo, nzira dzakatevedzana, mafaira anopesana, kana kuti mamwe mafolda akazara. Hapana chakachinja.

data.name: AsaPackages.Error.Descriptor
data.value: Hapana .uplugin mod descriptor yakawanikwa. Sarudza mod ZIP kana rakatorwa dhairekitori; nhoroondo dzakachengetwa dzinofanira kutanga dzatorwa.

data.name: AsaPackages.Error.Metadata
data.value: Mod descriptor haisi inoshanda, isina kujeka JSON. Hapana chakachinja.

data.name: AsaPackages.Error.Game
data.value: Chirevo hachizivisi chirongwa cheARK: Survival Ascended CurseForge. Synix haazombozivi mutambo kana mod ID.

data.name: AsaPackages.Error.Id
data.value: Chirevo hachina imwechete inoshanda CurseForge chirongwa ID (cf_ugcID). Shandisa Manage Mod IDs neID kubva kumunyori CurseForge peji.

data.name: AsaPackages.Error.ServerBuild
data.value: Mod haina WindowsServer package inozivikanwa kana kuti haisi kuwirirana .ucas/.utoc faira. Sarudza Windows-server download, kwete mutengi kuvaka.

data.name: AsaPackages.Error.DuplicateMod
data.value: Bhokisi racho rine mashoko anopfuura rimwe chete anotaura nezvechinhu chimwe chete. Sarudza shanduro imwe chete yechinhu chimwe nechimwe uye ongorora zvakare.

data.name: AsePackages.Help
data.value: Sarudza ARK: Survival Evolved mod ZIP kana faira rine .mod descriptor uye inoenderana yakabikwa mod faira. Synix inoverenga zita reWorkshop ID kubva kune descriptor, kwete zita reZIP. Mafaira haapindurwi kana kuiswa: mushure mekuongororwa, Synix inovandudza ActiveMods uye ModIDS yeARK's otomatiki kurodha pasi nzira. Mamepu uye kutendeuka kwakazara kungada kugadziriswa kwebasa rakaparadzana. Mapakeji eASA CurseForge haasi kuwirirana.

data.name: AsePackages.Error.Layout
data.value: Uku hakusi kutengeswa kwakazara kweASE mod. Sanganisira .mod descriptor uye kuwirirana mod forodha pamwe mod.info uye yakabikwa zvinhu. Chiziviso chakabatanidzwa chinofanira kuenderana nezita ripi neripi refaira rekutsanangura nhamba. Raw Workshop .z downloads isina yakagadzirirwa .mod faira haina kutsigirwa nemuverengi uyu; shandisa Manage Mod IDs panzvimbo payo.

data.name: ArkPackages.Error.WrongEdition
data.value: Mupakeji uyu une tsanangudzo yeimwe ARK edition. ASE Steam Workshop mods uye ASA CurseForge mods hazvigone kuchinjaniswa. Sarudza purogiramu ye server yakasarudzwa.

data.name: UniversalMods.Locations.Help
data.value: Gadza mod kana plugin faira uye akagamuchira huru mafaira mhando uchishandisa mutambo uyu kana loader mirayiridzo. Izvi zvinoshanda chete kune iyi server. Sarudza nzvimbo iripo kuti igadziridzwe; hapana mafaira emudiki anochinjwa pano.

data.name: UniversalMods.Locations.Path
data.value: Faira riri mukati me server (semuenzaniso: BepInEx/plugins)

data.name: UniversalMods.Locations.Warning
data.value: Kupinza mafaira hakugadziri mutakuri kana modhi inodzorwa nemupi wekunyoresa. Ongorora mirayiridzo yokugadza mutambo wacho.

data.name: UniversalMods.Locations.Start
data.value: Shandisa nzvimbo dzokunze kuti ugadzire foldari yemudiki kana plugin yebasa iri. Kupinza mafaira hakuratidzi kuti mutambo unogona kuzvitakura.

data.name: UniversalMods.Import.Help
data.value: Sarudza faira riri mukati mepurogiramu ine zvirimo munzvimbo yakasarudzwa yebasa. Mabhokisi ari pasi apa anochengetwa. Unogona kubvisa mapepa ekudhawunirodha nekusarudza faira rakadzika. Mafaira akanyorwa chete ndiwo achatorwa; mafaira aripo anogamuchira makopi ekudzoreredza. Izvi hazvishanduri mods asingawirirani.

data.name: UniversalMods.Import.Reading
data.value: Kuverenga purogiramu uye kugadzirira kuongororwa kwekupedzisira...

data.name: UniversalMods.Import.Summary
data.value: {0} mafaira akasarudzwa; {1} mafaira aripo achachengetwa asati atorwa. Hapana chinoiswa kusvikira chibvumirano chinotevera chaitwa.

data.name: UniversalMods.Error.InvalidLocations
data.value: Nzvimbo dzokupinza dzakaponeswa hadzina kushanda kana kuti dzinobva kune imwe server game. Hapana mafaira akachinjwa.

data.name: UniversalMods.Error.InstallFolder
data.value: Isa sevha iyi usati wagadzirisa nzvimbo dzokunze.

data.name: UniversalMods.Error.LocationLimit
data.value: Server inogona kuva kusvika 32 custom import nzvimbo.

data.name: UniversalMods.Error.LocationName
data.value: Pinda zita nzvimbo 1–80 mavara uye sarudza Mod kana Plugin.

data.name: UniversalMods.Error.Extensions
data.value: Pinda 1–32 main file extensions, kusanganisira dots dzavo, akadai .dll kana .pak. Zvirongwa zvekuisa uye zvinyorwa zvemirairo hazvibvumirwi.

data.name: UniversalMods.Error.Collision
data.value: Pasuru yacho ine kukakavadzana kwemafaira/mafolda. Sarudza purogiramu yakakwana, isina kushatisa.

data.name: UniversalMods.Error.NoFiles
data.value: Folda yepakiti yakasarudzwa haina imwe yemhando huru dzefaira dzenzvimbo iyi. Sarudza imwe faira yezvinyorwa kana kuti ongorora mhando dzinogamuchirwa dzenzvimbo yacho.

data.name: UniversalMods.Error.PackageRoot
data.value: Sarudza faira rinoshanda mukati mepakiti. Nzira dziri kunze kwepakiti hadzigamuchirwi.

data.name: UniversalMods.Import.Done
data.value: Mafaira ari kutorwa. Makopi okudzorera akachengetwa kuti agadzirise mafaira. Ongorora loader uye Activation zvinodiwa mutambo uyu usati watanga. Hapana server yakatangwa.

data.name: UniversalMods.Import.Rollback

data.name: ModSupport.EvidenceNote
data.value: Kutsigirwa kwakanyorwa hakusi kuedzwa kwekuwirirana kwehupenyu-server. Server mods, mutengi mods uye loader installers zvakasiyana. Hapana chinhu chinotorwa pasi, chinoiswa kana kuti chinotanga nebhuku rino.

data.name: ModInstallGuide.ManualActivation
data.value: Kutevedzera mafaira hakugadziri mutakuri kana kunyoresa/kuita mod. Tevedza Mod rutsigiro & setup uye munyori wacho Server mirayiridzo, ipapo kutanga Server pachako uye tarisa log yayo.

data.name: ModInstallGuide.ScenarioActivation

data.name: ModInstallGuide.FileRecovery
data.value: Mira server, sarudza chinhu chinotorwa uye shandisa Roll Back Import. Izvi zvinodzorera mafaira akatsiviwa uye zvinobvisa mafaira matsva kubva mukutenga ikoko; kuongororwa kunotevera kunogona kuvharira kudzokorora. Haridzoreri kuchinja kwenyika. Ita backup yakazara usati watanga.

data.name: ModInstallGuide.ProviderRecovery

data.name: GameText.Introduction
data.value: Synix inogamuchira zvinyorwa zvepasi rose. Nzvimbo imwe neimwe iri pasi apa ine chimiro chayo cheuchapupu; rutsigiro rwemusoro haruratidzi rutsigiro rwepassword. Kusasimbiswa hakurevi kuti hakuna kutsigirwa uye hakuiti mutemo weChirungu chete. Kunyora hakusi kuedza kwepamoyo kweshanduro yega yega yemutambo, font yemutengi kana nzira yekupinda.

data.name: GameText.SafetyNote
data.value: Chengetedza mapassword sezvawakanyora: mavara akafanana anoonekwa anogona kuva nekodhi dzakasiyana. Miganhu yemutambo iripo uye zvinoparadzanisa zvinorambidzwa zvichiri kushanda. Zviratidzo zvekuzivisa, ID, mazita emafolda uye mazita evashandisi emutambi ane mitemo yakaparadzana.

data.name: GameText.UnverifiedNote
data.value: Tsvakurudzo yepaIndaneti haina kuzivisa rutsigiro rwemarudzi ose panyaya iyi. Ongorora zvinyorwa zvemutambo zviripo uye edza mavara chaiwo usati waavimba nawo. Munda wakaremara muSynix hausipo pamutambo.

data.name: Content.007253C01F3D240BCA85
data.value: Euro Truck Simulator 2 inofanira kutumira kunze mepu yayo, DLC, uye mod package mafaira kubva mumutambo wakajairika server yakatsaurirwa isati yatanga. Tevera matanho ekumisikidza anoratidzwa; Synix ichapinza mafaira akagadzirwa mune iyi server.

data.name: Content.00DEEBB0AC0CF305D39F
data.value: Server-side code mods dziripo, kusanganisira mugadziri wacho akagoverana-stockpile mod. Mapakeji marongerwo, dependencies uye nyika activation kunotsamira mutambo/mod shanduro; hapana nzvimbo yeDLL yakajairika inotarisirwa.

data.name: Content.027ABB3BADA8C0B33854
data.value: Sarudza mods nokuda nyika / Server configuration pane kutevedzera generic ZIP. Steam uye crosssplay/mod.io zvinowanikwa zvakasiyana. Server plugins inoda chaiyo server implementation uye plugin kuvaka.

data.name: Content.02F77AA927B80C70293F
data.value:
ZVINONYANYA KUDZIDZA:
1. Simudza server kamwe chete kuti ugadzire 'PCServer-UDKGame.ini', woizomira.
2. Gadzirisa faira kuti utarise kutenderera kwemepu uye mitemo yekukuvara kwechikwata.
3. Zvinyorwa zvepamutemo: https://chivalrythegame.com/

data.name: Content.030CAD445A59DD2F29E2
data.value: SteamCMD Kurodha pasi uye Kufambira Mberi

data.name: Content.03C3E5851F1A6D5D93B8
data.value: Java ine rcon.password; Bedrock haina yakavakirwa-mukati Java RCON endpoint. UTF-8 configuration rutsigiro harugoni kuumba vatambi vatambi vose RCON. Ongorora server chaiyo nemutengi pamwe chete.

data.name: Content.04306C6DCC8E032536F2
data.value: Chengetedza purogiramu imwe neimwe yezvinyorwa uye filelist.xml pamwe chete uye shandisa mapakeji mukugadziriswa kwebasa. Zvinyorwa zvakabudiswa zvebhodhi remirairo zvinoenderana neshanduro; ongorora nzira dzazvino.

data.name: Content.046758F1CA21BD9F666A
data.value:
Shandisa gwaro iri kuti ugadzire server yako yokutanga. Synix inoshanda paPC iyi, saka siya PC yakavhurika apo vanhu vari kutamba. Haufaniri kunyora murayiro wokutanga kuti ugadzire purogiramu yakadaro.
1. Vhura Synix uye rega SteamCMD kuvimba ongororo kupedza. 2. Sarudza Wedzera Server, wobva wagadzira server itsva. Kana mafaira eseri aripo, sarudza Import Existing Server panzvimbo pacho. 3. Pane General, pinda zita rakasiyana-siyana remubatsiri uye sarudza mutambo. Sarudza shanduro, shanduro yemutambo, kana kuti loader kana zvasarudzwa izvi zvichioneka. 4. Chengeta tsika dzakarongwa kunze kwokunge uchida chimwe chinhu chakasiyana. Ongorora mapeji akagoneswa ekumisikidza uye gadzirisa meseji chaiyo yekumisikidza inodiwa pazasi. 5. Sarudza Save Server. Izvi zvinowedzera chinyorwa kune dashboard; hazvirevi kuti mutambo wapedza kuiswa. 6. Sarudzai chinyorwa chacho uye sarudza Start. Ita kuti kurodha pasi uye kutanga kwekugadzirira kupere, uchitevera chero zvirevo Synix zvinoratidza. 7. Pedzisa chero kumisikidza kunopihwa nemutambo, senge chibvumirano, kupinda muakaundi, kana kugadzira chikamu mumutungamiri wayo we server mumutambo. 8. Unganidza kubva pakombiyuta iyi kana kuti pane imwe mudziyo uri pamambure ako. Kana izvi zvangoshanda, gadzira backup usati wawedzera mods kana kuti uchiita kuchinja kukuru.
Kana Ukasangana Nechinetso Vhura Kugadzirira kwebasa rakasarudzwa uye verenga Activity & Diagnostics. Tevera chikanganiso chacho pane kudzvanya Start kakawanda. Kune Minecraft kana Satisfactory, chikamu chemitambo inotsanangura matanho ekuwedzera.
Kugamuchira vanhu vari kunze kwenetiweki yako idanho rakasiyana rokushamwaridzana. Chokutanga, simbisa kuti server iri kushanda munharaunda.

data.name: Content.04A9AB215D19FA573345
data.value:
Chinhu chimwe nechimwe chinopinda paDashboard chinoda zita rayo uye faira rekugadza. Synix inoshandura zita reserver kuita Windows-yakachengeteka kuzivikanwa kweiyo inotsigirwa faira uye kutanga marongero. Izvi zvinoita kuti zviitiko zvisiyane nekugoverana mafaira zvisingaiti; haisi muchina chaiwo kana kuti muganhu wokuchengetedza.
DZIMWE DZIMWE DZIMWE DZIMWE • C:\Synix ?? main Synix data workspace. • C:\Synix\SteamCMD ?? yakagoverwa mutambo downloader. • C:\Synix\Games\<mutambo>\<server> ?? zvakajairika server zvigadziro. • C:\Synix\BackupGames ?? Normal backup root. • C:\Synix\SynixData\logs ?? magwaro ekushandisa uye mishumo yekukanganisa.
Mafaira ekushandisa MSI anowanzoiswa pasi pe%LocalAppData%\Programs\Synix. Dzimwe sarudzo uye kukosha kwakadzivirirwa neWindows zvakare ndezveakaundi yako yeWindows.
Nzvimbo DZEKUTENGA Shandisa Install & Launch pakusarudza server folder. Kuti ugadzire chimwe chinhu chitsva, sarudza faira risina chinhu rine nzvimbo yakakwana yemutambo nekuvandudzwa. Usarongedza mbiri mbiri kune rimwe bhuku.
Open Server Folder inoratidza nzvimbo chaiyo yebasa rakasarudzwa. Open Backup Folder inoratidza nzvimbo yayo yekuchengetedza; usafungidzira chero nzira kubva zita rayo kuratidza.
MAPONDO Anogona Kurarama Kwose Mutambo unogona kuchengeta nyika muAppData, Documents, imwe dhiraivha, kana kuti hurongwa hwayo hwekushandisa. Ongorora nzvimbo chaiyo yemutambo wacho usati waibatsira kana kuti waifambisa.
Kuchinja mazita kana kufambisa mafaira muFile Explorer hakuiti kuti nzira dzose dzakaponeswa dzivandudzwe. Shandisa Synix inotsigirwa kutumira / kuendesa basa uye nzira dzekuongorora usati watanga. Zviitiko zvakasiyana-siyana zvinodawo zviteshi zvemambure zvisingapesani.

data.name: Content.0AD494C5598090AE9CCD
data.value: Space Engineers inoshandisa yayo yepamutemo Dedicated Server Manager, iyo Synix inofanira kuchengeta ichioneka. Paanotanga kuvhura, sarudza Local/Console, sarudza Continue to server configuration, pinda server uye nyika marongero, uye sarudza Save & start. Shandisa maneja kuti uwane marongero epamberi, nyika, mods, vatungamiriri, uye console yayo. Synix inochengeta muenzaniso uyu pasi pefaira reInstance rebasa. Maitiro epamberi Local/Console haadi kodzero dzevatungamiriri; kusika basa Windows anoita. Zvinodikanwa zvepamutemo ndezve .NET Framework 4.8 kana zvitsva, Visual C++ Redistributable 2013 uye 2017, zvirinani 6 GB yehurongwa RAM, uye UDP chiteshi 27016 chinobvumidzwa kuburikidza neWindows Firewall uye chinotumirwa mu router yevatambi veInternet. Nhungamiro yepamutemo: https://www.spaceengineersgame.com/dedicated-servers/

data.name: Content.0B2D550B207DD25F9B2D
data.value:
Imbwa yokurinda inotarisa maitiro anozivikanwa emaseva uye inogona kutanga kudzoreredza kwakagadziriswa mushure mekubva kusingatarisirwi kana dambudziko rakaonekwa.
KUSHANDISA Kwakajairika Shandisa Synix' s Stop and Restart controls kuti uwane kuchinja kwaunoita nemaune. Synix inobatanidza zviito izvozvo nevatariri kuitira kuti kuvharwa kwakakumbirwa kurege kubatwa sechimbichimbi.
Kuvhara hwindo remutambo, kuuraya muTask Manager, kana kuti kumumisa achishandisa mumwe maneja kungaita sezvisingatarisirwi uye kunokonzera kupora.
DZIMWE DZIDZO ZVAKAITIKAzve Rega sevha ichipfuura neSynix, wozoongorora zvinyorwa zvitsva zvemutambo. Gadzirisa dambudziko riri pasi pe runtime, configuration, port, memory, kana mod risati ratangazve. Kudzoreredza hakugoni kugadzirisa mod isingaenderani kana kuti gadziriro yemutambo isina kupera.
Kukundikana kwebasa uye kubvunza kusingawaniki zvinetso zvakasiyana. Nguva yokudzorera inobva pamutambo uye mamiriro ezvinhu aripo, naizvozvo usashandisa nguva imwe chete yokuzorora.
ZVINOTAURWA Synix inocherechedza inotsigirwa launchers uye mwana pezvakaitwa kunobva Server. Makombiyuta chaiwo anotarisirwa kunze kana kuti masevhisi ekutumira anogona kurarama kupfuura mutanga uye anoda kutonga kwemutambo.
The watchdog haisi kutsiva verified backups kana kutarisa Server ichangobva kuchinjwa panguva yayo rokutanga akabudirira kutanga.

data.name: Content.0D2E92094CEB8EC48551
data.value:
Shandisa bhatani reSynix's lifecycle kuti ushandise sevha. Izvi zvinobvumira murindi kusiyanisa kumbomira nechinangwa kubva pakurovera.
START Sarudza chinyorwa uye sarudza Kutanga kamwe chete. Synix inoongorora zvinodiwa, nzira, zviteshi, uye yakasarudzwa pre-kutanga kuchengetedza, inogadzirira mafaira anotsigirwa asipo, uye inotangisa sevha. Mirira zvabuda usati waedzazve.
STOP Sarudza Stop uye rega mutambo nguva kuponesa uye kuvhara. Synix inoshandisa kutsigirwa kunofadza kuvhara kana kuripo, uye ipapo nhanho-nhanho maitiro ekupedza kukanganisa kana zvichidikanwa. Kupedza basa nokumanikidzwa kunogona kurasikirwa nokufambira mberi kusina kuchengetedzwa.
RESTART Sarudza Tangazve kuti umise boka riripo uye utange muenzaniso mutsva. Usatanga imwe kopi nemaoko uku zvichiitika.
Kana Bhatani risina Kuwanika Rimwe sangano rinogona kunge riine server, kana kuti mutambo wacho unogona kunge uri mumamiriro ekuchinja, kana kuti mutambo wacho unogona kunge uchishandisa kushandiswa kwekunze. Verenga mashoko ezvekuita uye zvaunogona kuita.
Dzivisa kuuraya sevha muTask Manager kana kuiita kuti isashande pane chimwe chishandiso chisingabatanidzwi nokuda kwekuchengetedza kwakajairika. Izvozvo zvinogona kuita sekubva kwacho kusingatarisirwi uye kuita kuti munhu apore.
Mitambo inotarisirwa kuburikidza nemichina chaiyo kana masevhisi ekushandisa ekunze inoda kuongororwa kwehupenyu hwavo. Kuvharwa kwechombo hakuratidzi kuti masevhisi iwayo akamira.

data.name: Content.14E361A374F9F14F65DD
data.value:
Satisfactory inoda kumisikidza kwokutanga mune yayo Server Manager mumutambo. Synix inogona kuisa uye kuvhura server yakatsaurirwa, asi haina kutsiva kupomera server kana kugadzira chikamu chayo.
Pedzisa Mutambo 1. Gadzira zvinyorwa zveSatisfactory uye Tanga muSynix. 2. Mirira kuti server yakatsaurirwa ipedze kutakura. 3. Vhura Satisfactory's in-game Server Manager uye wedzera kana kusarudza server. 4. Zvikumbire, sarudza password yemutungamiriri, uye pinda semutungamiriri. 5. Gadzira kana kurodha chikamu chaunoda kushandisa.
Synix inotarisira inotsigirwa launch/configuration values, kusanganisira launch port uye MaxPlayers. Mafaira anoshanda ari pasi peFactoryGame\Saved\Config\WindowsServer.
CONNECT SYNIX 1. Ita kuti server irambe ichimhanya ne-NewConsole. Tarisa zvinyorwa zvinotorwa kana zvekare; kana ukawedzera nharo iyi, restart kuburikidza Synix. 2. Shandisa zvakafanana Windows mvumo pamwero Synix uye Server, zvichida dzose User mvumo. 3. Sarudza server iyoyo uye vhura Server Options → Satisfactory Control Center → Connect API. 4. Sarudza Connect otomatiki kamwe chete uye mirira.
Synix inotumira server.GenerateAPIToken, inoverenga zvakazara zvitsva zvinobuda, inosimbisa nzvimbo yeAPI, uye inochengetedza chiratidzo chakavharidzirwa cheakaundi yako yeWindows. Chiratidzo ichi chinopa mutariri mukana wokuwana, kwete kungotarisa.
Nhoroondo dzekubudirira Token yakasimbiswa uye yakachengetedzwa zvakachengeteka uye inovhura Overview. Haufaniri kutevedzera mutsetse wekonzo kana kuisa chiratidzo nemaoko.
Kana kuedza kukundikana, Synix inochengeta chero kubatana kwakaponeswa kare uye haizomboedzizve murairo. Verenga mhedzisiro yacho usati waedzazve.
Izvi zvinobatanidza kune yakasarudzwa server pane iyi PC; haidi mutemo mutsva we router weSynix. Normal Start, Stop, uye Restart vachiri kushanda pasina API chiratidzo.

data.name: Content.1734B5184A8732EBE5C7
data.value:
Sarudza pane imwe dashboard uye vhura Server Options. Zvishandiso chete zvinotsigirwa nechikamu ichocho uye mamiriro acho ezvinhu zvinowanikwa.
MAFIRES NEKUCHENGETERA • Open Server Folder uye Open Backup Folder dzinovhura nzvimbo dzinoshanda. • Mugadziri wekugadzirisa anozarura mafaira anotsigirwa emitambo. • Update Server inotora mutambo unotsigirwa. • Ongorora Game Files kuongorora kana kuti gadzirisa mafaira anotarisirwa nomugadziri. • Backup and Restore kuchengetedza kana kudzorera chigadzirwa chakasarudzwa. • Gadzira Batch File inotumira kunze gwaro rekutanga apo chimiro chinotsigira. • Delete inobvisa chinyorwa uye inopa chete sarudzo dzekubvisa faira dzinoratidzwa mukusimbiswa kwayo.
ZVINOTAURANA NEZVIMWE Zvishandiso Zvemitambo Connection Information inoratidza kero, zviteshi, uye kutevedzera zviito. Kuedzwa kwekubatana, Mod & Plugin Manager, Minecraft zvishandiso, uye Satisfactory Control Center inoonekwa kana ichitsigirwa.
CHERECHEDZA Mushumiri Ari Kumhanya Dzvanya kaviri pane mutsara wacho kuti uwane mashoko ezvekuita. Rarama Process Details rinoratidza verified launchers, console hosts, uye vashandi pezvakaitwa kuti kupinda. Mutambo une maitiro akawanda unogona kuva neID inopfuura imwe.
Shandisa chishandiso Monitor kuongorora kuti Server wacho CPU uye ndangariro nhoroondo. Kuverenga uku kunosiyana nehurukuro yose yePC yepadhibhodhi.
Kuvhara hwindo rezvidzidzo kana rekutarisa zviwanikwa hakumisi mutambo. Shandisa chiito chokumisa pa dashboard kana uchifunga kudaro.

data.name: Content.18D0D93C3EB881DA2D03
data.value:
Sarudza shanduro yeMinecraft usati wasarudza mods kana marongero ekubatanidza. Java uye Bedrock ndeyemhando dzakasiyana dzevashandisi; Bedrock haisi Java loader.
Gadza SERVER 1. Gadzira zvinyorwa zveMinecraft uye sarudza Java kana Bedrock. 2. Nokuda kweJava, sarudza shanduro yeMinecraft, loader, uye inowirirana loader version inopiwa nevasarudzo. 3. Ongorora nyika, chizvarwa mutambo muoti, mutambi muganhu, ndangariro, zviteshi, uye yakaita kuchengeteka minda. 4. Chengetedza uye Tanga neSynix. 5. Verenga chibvumirano chipi nechipi kana kuti kutanga nokukurumidza usati wachigamuchira. 6. Mirira kuti nyika ipedze kurodha, wobva wabatana neyakafanana mutengi edition uye shanduro. 7. Tsigira nyika inoshanda usati wawedzera mods.
JAVA NEBEDROCK Java sarudzo dzinosanganisira Vanilla, Fabric, Forge, NeoForge, Paper, uye Purpur uko kuvaka kunowanikwa. Shandisa shanduro uye kuvaka vakasarudzwa; Paper uye Purpur inoshandisa plugins, nepo Fabric, Forge, uye NeoForge inoshandisa yavo inoenderana mods. Synix inotora runtime yakasarudzwa kubva kumupi wayo wepamutemo.
Bedrock inoshandisa yepamutemo Bedrock Dedicated Server package uye haishandisi Java.
FANANA NEZVINHU ZVAKAITIKA Sarudza mutakuri unodiwa nemamod yako. Enzanisa Minecraft shanduro, loader, dependencies, uye chero mutengi divi zvinodiwa.
Fabric, Forge, NeoForge, uye plugin-server mapakeji haasi kuchinjana. Kugadzira modhi kana plugins faira hakugadziri iyo inodiwa loader kana server framework. Browse Catalog haisi automatic modpack kana dependence installation.
Gadziriro Gadzirisa inotarisira server.properties uye edition-specific settings. Java inopawo Spectator mode. Technical tsika uye mirairo kuchengeta chimiro Minecraft anotarisira.
Kubva Server Options, vhura Minecraft Control Center. Peji yayo yeZvirongwa inonyora mafaira ekugadzirisa anogona kugadziriswa. Edit File inopa kugadziriswa kwemavara; Structured Editor inopa mupepeti aripo anoziva mafomati. Ose ari maviri anochengetedza shanduko apo server iri kumiswa. Kuzivikanwa server.properties tsika dzakadai zviteshi, mutambi muganhu, nyika, mbeu, muoti, uye mirairo-channel marongero zvakare update Synix akaponeswa kupinda. Zita rakashambadzirwa/MOTD rakaparadzaniswa nezita remunyika rekupinda. Zvirongwa zvema mods zvisingazivikanwi zvinoramba zviri mumafaira avo.
Synix inodzokorora marongero aya isati yagadzirisa kana kuti yatanga, uye kana Refresh ichishandiswa ichimiswa. Kana shanduro yekunze isiriyo kana kuti ichipesana neimwe nyaya, gadzirisa dambudziko rakanyorwa panzvimbo pekudzokorora kutanga sevha. Mupepeti anoramba kunyora pasi faira rakashandurwa kubva payakavhurwa; re-vhura kuti upedze zvinyorwa zvitsva.
KUCHINJWA KWE SERVER Chengetedza backup yakazara yevhavha usati wachinja mavhezheni kana ma loader. Sarudza nguva itsva yekumhanya muSeta, chengetedza chinyorwa chakadzokororwa, wobva wasarudza Apply Runtime muMinecraft Control Center. Synix inogadzirira nguva yekumhanyisa yepamutemo zvakasiyana, inochengetedza server.properties uye maforodha epasi rose, uye inorekodha mafaera ekumhanyisa akatsiviwa. Hazviiti kuti server itange kushanda. Kutanga kunovharwa apo nguva yekumhanya yakanyorwa uye chimiro chakasarudzwa chisingabvumirani.
Kudzorera faira hakubvisi kuchinja kwenyika kwakaitwa pashure pokunge sevha yatanga. Usambofunga kuti nyika yakavhurwa neMinecraft nyowani kana ma mods akasiyana anogona kuiswa zvakachengeteka neyekare runtime; dzorera matching kuzara backup pachinzvimbo.
Mira usati wachinja mafaira anoda kutangazve. Usatsiva nyika iripo netemplate itsva senzira pfupi yekugadzirisa.
Kana Vatambi Vasingakwanisi Kujoina Ongorora shanduro, mutambo / loader shanduro, Mods kunodiwa, uye chaiko chiteshi / protocol yeshanduro yakasarudzwa. Kana uchida kubuda mangwanani, ongorora mubhuku remitambo kuti uone kana paine kukanganisa kwechibvumirano, nguva yekumhanya, ndangariro, kana kuti kuvimba.

data.name: Content.29DD837D20479ABA0D1B
data.value:
Vhura Satisfactory Control Center pashure pokubatanidza munharaunda API. Sarudza tab yebasa raunoda.
ZVINOTAURWA NEZVAZVO Sarudza Refresh kuti uverenge zita remusangano, nhamba / muganho wevatambi vakabatana, mamiriro emutambo, avhareji tick rate, nguva yekutamba, uye nhanho yehunyanzvi.
Dashboard player anoverenga update rwoga apo kubatana kwakasimba; tafura yeChirangaridzo inovandudzwa kana zvikumbirwa. API iyi inopa nhamba, kwete mazita evatambi. Shanduro yakamiswa kana kuti server ichimirira nguva haisi nzira yakamiswa.
SERVER SETINGS Sarudza Refresh, gadzirisa tsika dzinotsigirwa, wozoshandisa kuchinja. Ongororazve zvauri kutarisira pashure pokunge wazorodza. Dzimwe nzira dzinoda kutangazve; kushandisa shanduko hakuiti kuti mutambo utangezve.
Kuisa makiyi uye tsika dzinogamuchirwa zvinoramba zviri mumutauro wehunyanzvi wemutambo.
MAGAMBO AKAPONESWA • Chengetedza ikozvino: Pinda zita kana kuti shandisa zita rakanyorwa Synix. Kudzokorora zita kunogona kudzikamisa kuchengetedza kuripo. • Mutoro wakasarudzwa: Ongorora kusimbiswa. Synix inotanga kuchengetedza kufambira mberi kwezvino kana musangano uri kushanda; kuremerwa kunogona kubvisa vatambi. • Upload save: Inowedzera faira rakasarudzwa uye rinogona kutsiva rakachengetwa rine zita rimwe chete. Haizvitakuri zvoga. • Dhawunirodha yakasarudzwa: Inochengetedza kopi yacho panzira yaunosarudza.
Ramba uine vanhu vakazvimirira vasati vatsiva kana kutakura nyika inokosha. Kuchengetedza kuendesa kune 512 MB kuchengetedzeka muganho. API inogona kunge isingawanikwi kwenguva pfupi panguva yekuremerwa kwemusangano.
KUNYANYA KUDZIDZA Tumira mumwe anotsigirwa mutambo murayiro panguva uye verenga kusimbiswa. Zvinyorwa, mirairo yechiratidzo / password, uye kuchinja kwekuwana kusina kuchengeteka kunovharirwa pano.
Mitemo yekumisa inotsigirwa inoendeswa kuburikidza neSynix's stop workflow. Mirayiridzo Output anoramba ari hwindo iri pane kuiswa dashboard kana Synix magwaro zvinyorwa; mutambo wacho unogona kuramba uchinyora zvinyorwa zvayo.

data.name: Content.29E9D2F428F5E2BA4705
data.value: Mugadziri anogadzira zvinyorwa zve plug-in subfolders yeJava-edition server plugins. Mabhuku aripo uye echinyakare anoshandisa maAPI akasiyana; ongorora shanduro yakaiswa uye plugin format usati washandisa nzvimbo yekuenda.

data.name: Content.2B0EFE8DBC3E9BEC09E3
data.value:
MULTIPLAYER GAME FILES ZVINGADZIDZIWA:
Synix inogadza iyo yakatsaurirwa-server package asi haigone kurodha pasi, kuteedzera, kana kugoverazve mafaera ane rezinesi kubva kumutambo wakajairwa. Kana sevha ikashuma kushayikwa kwezvinyorwa zvevatambi vakawanda kana kukanganisa panguva yekurodha kana kuchinja mepu, isa Dark Messiah yeMight & Magic Multiplayer kuburikidza neSteam uchishandisa account iyo iri muridzi wayo. Kopa mpsrc multiplayer zvemukati kubva kumutambo kuiswa mune ino yakatsaurirwa-server dhairekitori, uye ita shuwa kuti mapcycle.txt uye maplist.txt ine mepu dzaunoda kumhanya.
Nhanho iyi inofanira kupedzwa nemushandisi ari kuisa server. Mitambo yemhando yemitambo ndeye 0 Deathmatch, 1 Team Deathmatch, 2 Crusade, 3 Capture the Flag, uye 4 Colosseum.

data.name: Content.2B637CF2169F0AD865CF
data.value:
Verenga mhedzisiro yeConnect otomatiki usati waedza zvakare. Murayiro unoratidzwa mukonzoli yemitambo haupupupuri kuti kutora zviratidzo, kuongorora, uye kuchengetedza zvose zvakabudirira.
Ongorora Kukundikana Kwakajeka • Console isingawaniki: Simbisa -NewConsole, sevha yakasarudzwa, uye inoenderana neWindows mvumo mazinga. • Mutemo usina kupedzwa uri mukati: Zvibvise iwe pachako. Synix haisi kuzovhiringidza. • Mirayiridzo inomhanya asi hapana chiratidzo chinobatwa: Rega kutanga kupera, tarisa zvinyorwa zvemitambo zvinogona kunyorwa, uye regai zvizere zvitsva zvinobuda zvisvike. • Mafirita anovhiringidza: Bvisai mafirita ekubatanidza/kusabvisa uye regai console ipindure. • API chiteshi ndeimwe nzira: Kururamisa yakasarudzwa Server configured mutambo chiteshi. Usatumira chiratidzo chacho kumuteereri asina ukama. • Token yakarambwa kana kuchengetedza kubatana hakugoni kuvhurwa: Complete game-owned setup, ipapo batanidza zvakare. • API isingawaniki: Mirira kutanga kana kuti chengetedza kutakura uye tarisa zvinyorwa zvemutambo.
Mhinduro itsva inogona kunge iine kukosha kwakafanana kwechiratidzo seimwe mhinduro yapfuura. Kubata kunoshandisa kubuda kwakagadzirwa pashure pemurayiro, kwete chiratidzo chechinyakare chakasarudzwa mubhuku.
Kudzivirira Kana Kuti Kubvisa Kuwana Satisfactory inodhinda zviratidzo zvemutungamiri mukonzo yake uye zvinyorwa. Vachengete vari voga uye bvisa mitsetse yechiratidzo kubva pakushambadzira uye mishumo.
Synix inosimbisa kuti nzvimbo yekupedzisira inobva kune yakasarudzwa server uye inopinda chitupa chayo. Usadzima kuongorora kwechitupa kuti ugadzirise kukundikana.
Bvisa zvakachengetwa tokeni deletes Synix kuchengetwa kubatana; haibvisi chiratidzo chiri pabasa.
Kuti ubvise zviratidzo zvekushandisa zviripo, shandisa server.InvalidateAPITokens muSatisfactory's server console kana Server Manager console. Izvi zvinokanganisawo zvimwe zvibatanidziro zvinoshandisa zviratidzo izvozvo.
Nokuda kweimwe nhoroondo yeWindows kana kuti kuiswa kwakamisikidzwa, batanidzazve kana kubatana kwakachengetedzwa kwakaponeswa kusingagoni kushandiswa.

data.name: Content.2E2BBD89AFEC2FD2B678
data.value:
Verenga zviitiko zvitsva zvebasa nemitambo yebasa rakasarudzwa. Tsvaka kukundikana kwokutanga chaiko panzvimbo pomashoko okupedzisira okuvhara.
KUSVIRA PAMATANGIRO EKUTANGA Kana KUBVA PAMASI 1. Ongorora faira rakasarudzwa rokugadza, rinogona kuitwa, mutambo edition, uye loader. 2. Tarisa mafaira anodiwa, vakasununguka RAM / diski nzvimbo, uye vakagara zviteshi. 3. Pedzisa chibvumirano chipi nechipi, kupinda muakaundi, chinodikanwa chechiratidzo, kana kumisikidzwa kwemusangano wemutambo. 4. Kuti uwane mods, enzanisa mutambo, mutakuri, zvinoenderana, uye zvinodiwa nemutengi. 5. Mira kuburikidza Synix asati kuchinja mafaira, ipapo edza imwe kutanga.
Mutyairi anorarama anogona kuramba aripo pashure pokunge sevha chaiyo yaputsika. Server ine utano inogonawo kumirira kutakurwa kwenyika kana kuva nemubvunzo usingawaniki / API. Ongorora mamiriro acho zvakasiyana.
KUMISA Kana Kuti Kuita Zvekare Kunotora Nguva Mitambo inoda nguva yekuchengetedza uye kuvhara mabasa evashandi. Mirira mhedzisiro yeSynix uye verenga mharidzo yayo yekumisa. Kudzokera shure kwakamanikidzwa kunogona kurasikirwa nokufambira mberi kusina kuponeswa.
Usaparadza maitiro panguva imwe chete, tanga imwe kopi, kana kushandisa mumwe maneja pakumisikidza kwakafanana.
Chishandiso Kana Kuti Gadziriro Inoshayikwa Tarisa unyanzvi hwepurogiramu yacho uye mamiriro acho. Zvimwe zvisarudzo zvinorambidzwa nokuti mutambo unovabata kana kuti hapana nzira yekutarisira inotsigirwa. N/A player data harisi otomatiki Server kukundikana.
Kana dambudziko racho rikaramba riripo, nyora zvawakaita, kukanganisa kwawakaita, uye chinyorwa chiduku chawakanyora usati wachinja zvimwe zvinhu.

data.name: Content.3111DCC7482FEADC74FC
data.value:
KUSHANDIRA kana Kuvandudza Server MODPACK 1. Ita backup yakazara-server uye kumisa Server. Shandisa Synix nemvumo yeWindows yakajairika. 2. Gadza uye shandisa pakiti chaiyo Minecraft shanduro, loader, uye loader kuvaka kutanga. 3. MuMinecraft Control Center → Mods & Plugins, sarudza Import Server Pack. Sarudza Modrinth .mrpack kana yakazara server ZIP ine chaiyo mods / plugins uye configuration mafaira. 4. Optional server mods inopukunyuka kunze kwekunge Include optional server mods yasarudzwa. Zvinyorwa zveModrinth zvemutengi chete uye zvinopesana nemutengi hazvitengesi. 5. Ongorora mhedzisiro yekutarisa, kuongorora metadata, zvinyorwa zvakapukunyuka, uye mafaira ose anofanira kuwedzerwa, kutsiviwa, kana kubviswa. Ongorora chete kana kunobva uye kuchinja kwacho kuri kwakakodzera. 6. Tanga nemaoko pashure pokugadza, verenga console, uye edza kuwirirana mutengi kubatana.
Mutengesi haashandisi mapakeji anotumirwa ekutanga, anotsiva nyika, kana kunyora pamusoro midzi server.properties. Dhawunirodha server yakazara yemunyori kana mutengi weCurseForge kutumira kunze kunongova nemanyorerwo ekurodha pasi. Kudhanilodha kwakavanzika, hosts dzisina kutsigirwa, kana loaders dzisina kutsigirwa dzinoda mafaira emubatsiri anotsigirwa; Synix haipfuuri zvipingamupinyi zvevatengesi.
Modrinth downloads vari hash-akaongororwa. Metadata yeJAR inotsigirwa inoongororwa ye loader, mutengi-chete zvemukati, duplicate IDs, uye zvinoenderana zvakataurwa pasina kumhanyisa JAR. Metadata isingazivikanwi uye shanduro dzakaoma dzinoda kuongororwa. Kuongororwa kwakachena kana kuti kusavapo kwemakakatanwa anozivikanwa hakurevi kuti mod yacho yakachengeteka kana kuti inowirirana. Zvinodzikira zvisingaoneki hazvibviswi zvinyararire.
Kuunzazve pakiti yakafanana ine zita kunogona kubvisa maJAR ayo akambotarisirwa ayo asisipo, asi chete kana mafaera iwayo achiri kuenderana nemahashes avo akanyorwa. JARs dzisina kutarisirwa uye mafaira enyika haabviswi. Mafaira ekugadzirisa anopiwa nepaketi itsva anogona kutsiva akare; chinyorwa chinozviratidza usati wasimbisa. Chengetedza zita rimwechete refaira re server-ZIP kana uchigadzirisa iyo pack kuitira kuti ionekwe seyakafanana pack.
KUGADZIRWA Kwenyika Yose Shandisa Worlds kunyora pasi nyika dzinozivikanwa. Import World ZIP kopi imwe anoenderana-edition nyika itsva zita forodha; haina overwriting huripo nyika kana kutendeuka pakati Java uye Bedrock. Sarudza nyika yakaiswa uye Activate World kuti uchinje mazita enzvimbo uye nyika yeSynix pamwe chete. Kutanga kunotevera kunotakura nyika yakasarudzwa. Kuchinja mbeu kunokanganisa kubereka nyika itsva, kwete nzvimbo iripo.
KUPENYURA Kudzorera kunonyora kuchinja kwakaitwa mafaira aya. Undo inodzorera mafaira akanyorwa kare kana kuti inobvisa mafaira akaiswa neshanduko iyoyo. Siyana nenyika inotengeswa kunze kwenyika usati wabvisa kutengeswa kwayo. Kana mafaira akagadziridzwa gare gare, Synix inoramba kuanyora pamusoro; chengetedza zvinyorwa uye shandisa backup yakakodzera kana zvichidikanwa.
Kudzoreredza kuri kumirira kunovharira Kutanga kusvikira kudzoreredza kwapera uye chinyorwa chakachengetedzwa chichibvumirana nemafaira akadzorerwa. Zvirongwa zvekare zvisina runtime profile yakanyorwa zvinoda backup yakazara yekudzoreredza runtime. Backups inoramba iri yakazara-server-folder backups, yakazvimiririra pane zvinyorwa zvakasiyana-siyana zvekuchinja.
Mushure mokubudirira kudzorera kwakakwana, zvinyorwa zvekare zvekuchinja nzvimbo yekushanda zvinoratidzwa kuti zvinotsiviwa ne backup iyoyo. Zvinoramba zvichioneka kuti zvienderane asi hazvigoni kubviswa pamafaira akadzorerwa. Kupinza kana kugadzirisa zvinyorwa pashure pokudzorerwa kunogadzira zvinyorwa zvitsva zvekudzorera.
DHAGNOSTICS NEZVIMWE ZVAKAITIKA Diagnostics anoverenga ichangobva magwaro uye kukanganisa-mishumo miswe nokuda kwakajairika Java, ndangariro, kuvimba, chiteshi, nyika, uye tick-nguva zvinetso. Hapana muenzaniso wakaonekwa hausi uchapupu hwokuti sevha yacho ine utano hwakanaka. Kuita kunovhura chigadziro chemidziyo; CPU uye RAM kuyerwa hakusi kutsiva mutambo tick profileing.
Schedules inovhura Synix's iripo restart uye kugadziriswa marongero. Sarudza mazuva anodiwa, nguva, mutambi-kumirira maitiro, backup, uye update mikana, ipapo ongorora uye chengetedza. Nzvimbo yebasa haigadziri purogiramu yechipiri kana kuchinja purogiramu yako.

data.name: Content.34AD8EEA90B225512F6F
data.value:
Sarudza Minecraft server, wobva wazarura Server Options → Minecraft Control Center. Mapeji eConsole nePlayer anochengeta mirayiridzo nemidziyo yemutambi pamwe chete. Mamwe mapeji anopa marongero, nyika, zvinowedzerwa, zvizere-server backups, restart kuronga, kupora, uye diagnostics.
ZVINOTAURWA Kugadziriswa kunotsigirwa kunogona kushandisa Synix-inodzorwa koni, inotsigirwa localhost manejimendi chiteshi, kana sarudzo yeRCON. Chiteshi chiripo chinoenderana nehurukuro uye kugadziriswa kwebasa.
Pane hwindo rakavanzika remunyika rinogona kuramba richisiya nzvimbo inotsigirwa yemitemo iripo. Kana kudzora kwakadzimwa, tarisa kuti server iri kumhanya uye kuti marongero ayo ekutarisira anoshanda.
ZVINOGADZIRWA Kana ichitsigirwa, Synix inopa zviziviso, runyorwa rwevatambi, kuenzanisa, shanduko yemushandisi uye yekubvumidzwa, nguva / mamiriro ekunze kudzora, uye kuchengetedza.
Sarudza mutambi waunoda uye verenga chiito chacho usati wachisimbisa. Kubvumira opareta kuwana kunopa simba mutambo mvumo. Usangogumira pakugadzirisa dambudziko rokubatana.
ZVINOTAURWA ZVINONYANYA Shandisa matauriro anotarisirwa neshanduro iyoyo. Mirairo yakadai serondedzero uye chengetedza-zvose inouya mumutambo uye haishandurwe neSynix interface. Ongorora mitemo yomutambo usati watumira murayiro unoshandura nyika kana mvumo.
ZVINOFUNDWA NEZITA Mubvunzo unogona kupa nhamba yevatambi pasina runyorwa rune zita. Tafura yemazita isina chinhu hairatidzi kuti hapana munhu ane ukama.
Shandisa dashboard Stop kana Restart chiito upenyu kutenderera kuchinja kuitira kuti muchengeti agare achiziva shutdown iri nemaune.
Chengetedza RCON inosarudzwa kana kutungamirirwa kwemagumo emugumo aripo kunze kwekunge uine hurongwa hwakachengetedzwa hwekutonga kure. Mutambo weruzhinji haudi kuti zvizivikanwe kana kuti magumo.
