Jason Turner anochengetedza kodzero dzose, zita, uye kufarira muSoftware uye pamusoro payo, kusanganisira kodzero dzese dzekodzero nedzimwe kodzero dzepfungwa. Hapana kodzero dzokuva muridzi dzinotumirwa kwamuri pasi pechiremera ichi.
2. Kubhadharwa kweZvibvumirano Zviduku
Zvichienderana nezvose zviri pasi pemvumo iyi, unopiwa rezinesi rakaganhurirwa, risingasarudzwi, risingachinji, risingabvumirwi kuwana rezinesi, uye rinobviswa:
- Dhawunirodha uye shandisa Software nokuda kwako pachako, vasiri zvokutengeserana zvinangwa. - Ona uye dzidzai kodhi yepakutanga. - Ita makopi okuchengetedza kuti ushandise. - Chinja kodhi yepakutanga kuti ushandise pachako. - Nyora uye shandisa shanduko dzako pachako pane zvishandiso zvaunoita kana kuti zvaunodzora.
Kodzero ipi neipi isina kupiwa zvakananga nerutenderano urwu inochengeterwa muridzi wekodzero.
3. Kuchinja Kwemunhu
Unogona kuchinja Software kuti usangane nezvinodiwa zvako.
Kugadziridza kwako pachako kunofanira kuramba kwakavanzika kunze kwokunge Jason Turner akupa mvumo yakanyorwa yokuparadzira.
Iwe haugoni kubudisa, kuisa, kugovana, kuburitsa, kuparadzira, kana kuita kuti kodhi yakashandurwa yekodhi kana yakashandurwa yakaunganidzwa binaries iwanikwe neruzhinji seyakazvimirira vhezheni yeSynix.
4. Kurambidzwa
Iwe haugoni, pasina mvumo yakanyorwa yapfuura kubva kuna Jason Turner:
4.1 Kushandiswa kwezvokutengeserana
- Tengesa, renda, hirisa, rezinesi, sublicense, kana kubhadhara Software. - Tengesa kana kuparadzira zvigadziriswa kana kuti zvisina kugadziriswa zvakagadzirwa. - Shandisa Software kana kuti kodhi yayo yepakutanga sechikamu chechigadzirwa chinobhadharwa kana basa rokutengesa. - Kubudirira zvakananga kana zvisina kunanga kubva pakuparadzira, kupa marezenisi, kuchinja zita, kana kupa mukana weSoftware.
4.2 Kugoverwazve uye Kugamuchira Vanhu
- Upload, mirror, kana kuitisa Software pane imwe Website, repository, kudhanilodha basa, faira kugoverana papuratifomu, kana Anwendung chitoro. - Dzokorora kodhi yepakutanga kana kuti mabhinari akagadzirwa, angava akagadziridzwa kana asina kugadziriswa. - Gadzira kana kubudisa zvigadziri zvisiri zvepamutemo, mapakeji anotakurika, magirazi, kana kurodha pasi zvinongedzo. - Shambadza zvinyorwa zvinobva pafork kana kopi yakashandurwa yeSoftware. - Ipa furika, shanduko, kana shanduro yakatorwa sechigadzirwa chakazvimirira kana chinokwikwidzana.
4.3 Rebranding and Attribution
- Bvisa,vanza, kana kuti uchinje zita reSynix, zviziviso zvekutepfenyura, zvikwereti zvemunyori, zviziviso zvemarezinesi, marogo, kana kuiswa. - Dzosera zita kana kuti shandura zita reSoftware kuti ibudiswe pachena kana kuparadzirwa. - Taura kuti wakasika Software yepakutanga. - Shandisa Synix zita kana kuti chiratidzo nenzira inonyengera inoratidza kutsigirwa, kubvumirwa, kubatana, kana kuti chinzvimbo chepamutemo.
4.4 Reverse Engineering and Protection Bypass
Muchikamu chakakwirira chinobvumirwa nemutemo unoshanda, haugoni kudzoreredza injiniya, decompile, disassemble, kana neimwe nzira edza kupfuudza zviziviso zvekupa marezinesi, attribution, kuchengeteka maficha, update checks, kana branding iri mune yepamutemo yakagadzirwa kuburitswa.
Kurambidzwa uku hakurambidzi kodzero dzisingabviswi dzaunopiwa nomutemo unoshanda.
5. GitHub Forks uye mipiro
Iyo yepamutemo Synix repository inogona kuoneka pachena paGitHub. Nzvimbo yeGitHub inogona kubvumira vashandisi kuti vaone uye vape nzvimbo yekuchengetera yeruzhinji kuburikidza neGitHub's yakavakirwa-mukati mashandiro.
Fork yeGitHub haikubvumiri kuti:
- Kubudisa kusiri pamutemo Synix kuburitswa. - Govera mabhinari akachinjwa kana asina kuchinjwa. - Rebrand Synix. - Shandisa peji rakaparadzana revanhu vose rokurodha pasi kana kuti girazi. - Taura forokeri senzira yako pachako. - Kugoverazve Software kunze kwekushanda kwakaganhurirwa kunopiwa neGitHub.
GitHub forks inogona kushandiswa chete kuongorora kodhi, kugadzirira mupiro, kana kuendesa chikumbiro chekubvisa kune yepamutemo Synix repository. Kuchinja kwomunhu oga kusiri kupiwa sechibvumirano kunofanira kuramba kuripo uye kwakavanzika.
Nokutumira kodhi yepakutanga, zvinyorwa, mifananidzo, kana imwewo mupiro kuSynix repository yepamutemo, unoratidza kuti une kodzero yekuutumira uye kupa Jason Turner rezinesi risingaperi, repasi rose, risingasaruri, risingachinjiki, risina kodzero yekushandisa, kubereka, kuchinja, kubudisa, kuparadzira, sublicense, uye kuisa mupiro iwoyo muSynix.
6. Synix Zita uye Branding
Synix zita, logo, hunhu hwekuona, uye chiratidzo chakabatana chinoramba chiri chivakwa chaJason Turner.
Hapana chiratidzo chekutengeserana kana rezinesi rekushambadzira rinopihwa nemvumo iyi kunze kwekuratidzira zita risina kuchinjwa reSynix uye rekushambadzira paunenge uchishandisa Software.
Kushandiswa kusina mvumo kweSynix branding kunogona kutyora kodzero dzepabonde, chiratidzo chekutengeserana, makwikwi asina kururama, kana mimwe mitemo inoshanda.
7. Kupedza basa
Kodzero dzako pasi pechiremera ichi dzinopera kana ukatyora chero nguva yechiremera ichi.
Mushure mekupedza basa, unofanira:
- Regai kushandisa uye kuchinja Software. - Regai kuparadzira kana kuratidza kopi dzisina kupiwa mvumo. - Bvisa makopi asingabvumirwi nevakawanda, zvinyorwa, magirazi, kana kuti kudhanilodha zviri pasi pekutonga kwako. - Bvisa makopi ako pachako apo mutemo unoda kudaro.
Zvikamu zvine chokuita nokuva muridzi, zvirambidzo, mipiro, kusava nemhosva, uye kuita kuti zvinhu zviitike zvinoramba zviripo kana zvagumiswa.
8. Kuzadziswa
Muridzi wekodzero dzepabonde anogona kutsvaka nzira dzokudzorera dziripo pasi pemutemo unoshanda pakunyora zvisingabvumirwi, kuparadzira, kugamuchira paruzhinji, kutengesa, kuchinjisa zita, kana zvimwe zvinopesana.
Zvigadziriso zviripo zvinogona kusanganisira zvikumbiro zvokubvisa, maitiro ekubviswa kwepuratifomu, kuregererwa kwekurambidzwa, kukuvara, uye dzimwe nzira dzekuregererwa kana zvichidikanwa zviri pamutemo.
Hapana chinhu chiri mumutemo uyu chinovimbisa kuti chiito chipi nechipi chokudzvinyirira kana kuti kururamiswa kuchange kuripo munzvimbo dzose dzokutonga.

11. Mvumo Yakanyorwa
Kusiyana kwechiremera ichi kunoshanda chete kana kupiwa nemunyori naJason Turner.
Mibvunzo kana zvikumbiro zvekubvumirwa zvinofanira kuendeswa kuburikidza neSynix GitHub repository kana imwe nzira yeSynix yekutaurirana.
12. Zvinyorwa Zvokurodha Pasi
Synix inowanikwa chete kubva kune aya masosi epamutemo:
- https://github.com/ubidzz/Synix-Control-Panel/releases - https://synix.info
Makopi anopiwa nedzimwe nzvimbo dzepaIndaneti haasimbiswi naJason Turner uye angava asina kuchengeteka, akachinjwa, akwegura, kana kuti akabatanidzwa nesoftware isingadiwi. Kuchengeteka kwavo uye kuvimbika hazvivimbiswi naJason Turner.
Kunyoresa Synix, kubatanidza kuGitHub, kana kupa kurodha pasi hakusi kuendesa muridzi kana kureva mvumo, kubatana, kutsigirwa, kana chinzvimbo chepamutemo. Synix inoramba iri yaJason Turner.
Kugamuchira, kutevedzera, kumirira, kurongedzazve, kana kuti kuputira zvakarekodhwa kunoda mvumo yokutanga yakanyorwa. Chinongedzo chiri kunzvimbo yepamutemo hachipi mvumo iyoyo.
Chikamu 4.2 hachirambidzi zvakajairika zvakananga zvinongedzo kune aya masosi ehurumende ayo anonyatsopa Synix naJason Turner. Zvinongedzo zvakadaro hazviiti kuti webhusaiti inobatanidza ive sosi yepamutemo.
Iyo WinGet package ubidzz.Synix inzira yekumisikidza yakatenderwa kana ichidhonza iyo isina kugadziriswa installer zvakananga kubva kune yepamutemo GitHub kuburitswa. Izvi hazvibvumiri kugamuchira kana kudzokorora kwevatatu.
13. Kukurukurirana Kwevanhu Vachirarama Uye Kuvanzika
Synix inosanganisira sarudzo yekurarama yekuverenga iyo inofungidzira huwandu hwekumhanyisa Synix zvikamu pahttps://synix.info. Ichi chimiro chakagoneswa nekutadza. Unogona kuidzima chero nguva muZvirongwa > Privacy & Security > Share active count pasina kudzikisira zvimwe zvinhu zveSynix. Chisarudzo chakachengetwa kare chinoremekedzwa.
Paunenge uchigonesa, Synix inotumira chiratidzo chekuvapo kweHTTPS kuhttps://synix.info/api/presence paunotanga uye anenge maminetsi ese e10 apo app iri kumhanya, kusanganisira kumashure. Chiratidzo chine random temporary session code uye generic Synix application identifier, pasina message body. Kodhi yemusangano inochengetwa chete mundangariro uye inotsiviwa panotanga musangano mutsva wekushuma; haisi chiratidzo chechigadzirwa chisingaperi.
Iyo counter haina kuisa zita rako, email kero, mapasiwedi, server kana mutambi ruzivo, marongero akakosha, mafaera, kana michina yekuzivisa.
Kwenguva imwe neimwe, nzvimbo yepaIndaneti inongochengeta hash yekodhi yepurogiramu uye nguva yechiratidzo chayo chazvino. Nzvimbo yepaIndaneti yevoruzhinji inoratidza chete nhamba yakazara yevanhu vanopinda misangano, iyo inofungidzirwa kwete nhamba yevanhu vakasiyana-siyana. Musangano unomira kuverenga pashure pemaminitsi 15 pasina chiratidzo. Nhoroondo dzisina kushanda dzinova dzakakodzera kucheneswa mushure memaminitsi e30 uye dzinobviswa kana zvikumbiro zvinotevera zvekuchenesa zvichiitwa. Synix haibatanidzi zvinyorwa izvi zvinopesana neakaundi-manager account kana paired-computer identities.
Kudzima chimiro kunomisa zvimwe zviratidzo zvekuvapo uye kunoita chikumbiro chimwe chakanakisisa chekubvisa chikamu chiripo. Kuvhara Synix kunoedzawo kubviswa; kana kubviswa kusingakwanisi kusvika pawebsite, chikamu chinomira kuverenga mushure menguva yekusaita basa.
Kungofanana nechero kubatana kweInternet, masevhisi anotambira webhusaiti anogamuchira ruzivo rwekubatana rwakajairika, senge iyo inotangira IP kero uye nguva yekukumbira, uye inogona kuigadzirisa kana kuiisa pasi pemitemo yavo yekuvanzika. Ruzivo urwu haruchengetwi mutafura yeSynix yemabasa kana kuratidzwa mukuverengwa kweruzhinji.
14. Zvakavanzika uye Kuchengetedzwa Kwekuwana Kubva Kure
14.1 Kuwana Kwaungaita Uye Kusatengeswa Kwemashoko
Kutungamirirwa kure pahttps://manager.synix.info hakubvumirwi uye kwakadzimwa kusvikira iwe wabatanidza komputa uye wabvumidza account yekukumbira muapp yeSynix pakombuta iyoyo. Unogona kushandisa Synix munharaunda pasina account yemaneja. Chiverengero chemabasa eruzhinji chakaparadzaniswa uye chinogona kudzimwa zvakazvimiririra.
Synix haisi kutengesa, kurenda, kutengesa, kana kuburitsa ruzivo rweakaundi yako, ruzivo rwemakombiyuta akabatanidzwa, basa riri kure, kana ruzivo rwevashandisi kune vashambadziri kana vatengesi ve data. Synix haishandisi ruzivo urwu pakushambadzira kwakanangwa kana kuvaka maprofayiri ekushambadzira kubva mariri. Mashoko acho anogadziriswa kuti ape zvinhu zvaunosarudza, uone kuti unokwanisa kuwanikwa sei, ushandise basa racho, uye uzvidzivirire pakushandiswa zvisina kufanira.
Kuwana zviri kure hakusi basa rekuchengetedza risina chinhu. Inoda zvinyorwa zvayo zvishoma, zvekuisa pamwe chete, zvokushanda, uye zvekuchengetedza zvakatsanangurwa pasi apa. Nhoroondo idzi hadzibudiswi muchikamu chebasa rehurumende kana kuiswa pachena kune mamwe maakaundi evatungamiriri kuburikidza nebasa racho.
14.2 Zvinoramba Zviri Pakombiyuta Yako
Synix haina kutumira otomatiki nyika dzemitambo, mafaera emitambo-server, zvirimo zvefaira rekugadzirisa, zvemukati zvekuchengetedza archives, raw console output, kana zvakachengetedzwa password yemutambo-server. Remote backup uye kudzorera kumhanya pakombiyuta yakabatanidzwa; mafaira ekuchengetedza anoramba ari munzvimbo dzakagadzirirwa ipapo. Kana ukasarudza kunyora murayiro wekutamba mutambo pawebsite, rugwaro rwawo runogadziriswa uye rwunotumirwa kukombiyuta yakabatanidzwa, kusanganisira chero tsika dzinonzwisisika dzaunoisa murugwaro irworwo. Mutungamiri haasi cloud backup yekuchengetedza uye haapi isina muganho kure desktop, Windows mirairo-yakakurumidza kuwana, kana yakajairwa faira yekutarisa.
Synix inochengeta marongero ayo emunharaunda, rondedzero yevashandi, nhoroondo, backups, uye mamiriro ekubatanidza pakombuta yako. Kiyi yokusaina yemakombiyuta yakabatanidzwa inoramba iri muWindows key storage. Synix inosarudza kuchengetedza kunotsigirwa neTPM kana iripo uye neimwe nzira inotsigira kiyi ye software inodzivirirwa neWindows, kusanganisira pamakombiyuta anowirirana. Kuwanika kweTPM hakusi kuvimbisa kuti kombiyuta haina kukanganiswa.
Mashoko aya anotsanangura Synix remote management. Mitambo, Steam, mods, kudyidzana kweDiscord, kutumira kunze, uye mishumo yekutsigira yaunosarudza kugovana ine yavo data inoyerera. Usaisa mapasiwedi kana mamwe mashoko anonzwisisika muzita remakomputa, mazita emaseva, kana mazita emafaira ekuchengetedza, nokuti mazita iwayo anogona kuoneka mumaneja.
14.3 Information Manager Processes uye Stores
- Account uye authentication: Zita rako rekushandisa rakasarudzwa, account identifier, nguva yekugadzira, zvekuchengetedza zvaunofarira, hash ye password yakasungwa, encrypted authenticator secret kana yakaiswa, passkey public credentials kana yakaiswa, uye zvinyorwa zvenguva pfupi zvekuongorora / zvikamu. Mapassword uye kodhi dzekuongorora dzinogadziriswa kuti dziongorore kusaina-in; mapassword anogara aripo haachengetwi semashoko anogona kuverengwa. Synix haigamuchiri zvigunwe zvako, mufananidzo wechiso chako, kiyi yekupinda, kana kiyi yekusaina yemakombiyuta akabatanidzwa. Kunyoresa hakukumbiri zita chairo kana kero yeemail. - Kubatanidza uye kubatana: Chiziviso chekombiyuta chaunosarudza, chiziviso chechigadzirwa chisina kujairika, kiyi yayo yekusaina yeruzhinji, kushamwaridzana kweakaundi, mhando yemupi wekushandisa kiyi yakataurwa, mamiriro ekubvumidzwa kwekubatanidza, uye nguva yekupedzisira yekubatana. Chinyararire chakasimbiswa chinobatanidza chinogona kuramba chakavhurika Synix ichimhanya kuitira kuti webhusaiti ikwanise kumutsa app yakabatanidzwa pakarepo. The relay anotakura wake / disconnect zviziviso uye kubatana metadata, kwete mutambo mafaira kana Server snapshots. - Mamiriro ekuratidzira: Zviratidzo zvemaserver mashoma, mazita, mazita emutambo, kumhanya kwemamiriro, kuverengwa kwevatambi, nguva yekushandisa, zviito zviripo, nguva yekupedzisira yekuchengetedza / mamiriro, yakasanganiswa CPU uye RAM kuverenga kubva kumitambo-server maitiro ari kumhanya (kusanganisira avo vanovhura uye vashandi), uye rakaparadzana komputa yese CPU, yakashandiswa / yakazara RAM, uye network kutumira / kugamuchira mitengo. Computer network rates zvinosanganisira LAN traffic pamusoro Active gateway adapters; zviziviso zveadapter, IP kero, zvirimo mumapakeji, uye nzvimbo dzekufambisa hadzitumirwe nekuverenga uku. App yacho inotumira pfupiso idzi apo chiratidzo cheManeja chakasimbiswa chiri kushanda. CPU/RAM updates dzinosanganisira makombiyuta akabatanidzwa; Detailed server updates kufukidza vakasarudzwa kombiyuta. Updates kazhinji kumhanya ose 10 masekonzi uye kumbomira pashure Active maonero kuvhara, disconnect, kupera, kana kuti vakavanzwa sezvinobvira. Zvimwe zvikamu zvinoshingaira zvebrowser zvinogona kuchengeta maonero avo achimhanya. - Zviito uye backups zvinokumbirwa: Server / zviito zvekuzivisa, nguva yekukumbira, kufambira mberi / mhedzisiro, uye, kana ukakumbira sarudzo dzekuchengetedza, zvekuchengetedza zvekuzivisa, mazita emafaira, mazuva, saizi, uye zvitupa zvehutano. Zvemukati zvekuchengetedza uye nzira dzese dzemuno hadzitumidzwe pachinhu ichi. - Game-console mirairo: An opaque mutambo kumhanya kuzivikanwa, pfupi-refu unlock mvumo, uye murayiro rugwaro iwe kupinza. Rugwaro rwuri kumirira runovharidzirwa mudhatabhesi yebasa uye rwunobviswa pakanyorwa ikoko apo kutumira kunotenderwa. Haisi kuverengerwa muzvinyorwa zvenguva pfupi yapfuura kana kuti zvinyorwa zvekuzivisa account. Mugumisiro wekutumira unoreva kuti rugwaro rwakatumirwa kumutambo, kwete kuti mutambo wacho wakaugamuchira kana kuti wakaupedzisa. Mhinduro dzemutambo uye muti wepurogiramu womunharaunda hauna kuiswa. - Kuchengetedzwa uye kudzivirira kushungurudzwa: mhando yekusaina-in, kuverengwa kwemapoka uye nguva dzekuedza, rudzi rwechiitiko chekudzorera / chengetedzo, uye makombiyuta akakodzera. Zvinyorwa zvenguva pfupi-zvekukwirira kwemitengo zvinogona kushandisa keyed hashes yeIP kero dzekubatanidza uye account identifiers. Synix's account-alert records hadzina password dzakaedzwa, verification codes, raw IP address, kana browser fingerprints. Vanopa mabasa ekubata vanogona kugadzirisa ruzivo rwekubatanidza zvakasiyana sezvinotsanangurwa muChikamu 14.6.
Nzvimbo yepaIndaneti inonyatsogadzirisa pfupiso dzinobvumirwa nemirairo kuti ipe kutarisirwa kure. HTTPS uye yakavharidzirwa relay connections kudzivirira motokari mukutakura; uku hakusi kutaura kuti basa rekugamuchira harigoni kugadzirisa data.
14.4 Kuchengetwa nekubviswa
- Zvitupa zveakaundi uye marongero anoramba aripo kusvikira akaundi yacho yabviswa. Nhoroondo dzakabvumirwa dzokubatanidza dzinoramba dziripo kusvikira kombiyuta isina kubatanidzwa kana kuti account yacho yabviswa. - Mapikicha emamiriro ezvinhu uye kuverenga kweCPU/RAM kunovharwa nekuverenga kutsva uye vanova vakakodzera kucheneswa mushure memaminitsi e15 pasina kutsiviwa. Nguva yekupedzisira yekubatanidza inoramba iri chikamu cherekodhi yekubatanidza. - Remote command records, results, and returned backup-choicho metadata become eligible for cleaning after 24 hours. - Mirayiridzo yemitambo yekonzoli iripo inopera mushure memasekondi 30. Chinyorwa chisina kuendeswa chinova chakakodzera kudzimwa kana nguva yacho yapera kana kubviswa; kubvumirwa kwekutumira kunovapa mvumo pakarepo. Kubvumirwa kwekombiyuta kunopera mumaminitsi matatu. Chiziviso chekuita uye mhedzisiro yakatarwa yekuendesa inotevera nguva yekurekodha ye24-awa yekuita. - Zviitiko zvokupora / kuchengeteka uye kutadza kusaina-in alerts zvinova zvinokodzera kucheneswa mushure memazuva 90. Kukundikana kwekusaina kunochengetedza zvikwata zve100 zvitsva; kukundikana kunoenderana mukati menguva ye10 maminetsi akabatanidzwa pamwechete. - Zvirongwa zvebrowser zvinopera mushure memaminitsi 30 pasina zvikumbiro zvemaneja kana mushure me8 maawa akazara. Kuedza kwekuongorora kunopera mushure memaminitsi e5; Kudzoreredza kwepasword kwenguva pfupi kunopera mukati memaminitsi e10 uye kushandiswa kamwechete. Nhoroondo dzakapera dzekuongorora, kudzoreredza, kuchengetedzwa kwekudzokorora, uye muganho wehuwandu hunobviswa panguva yekuchenesa. Kunyoreswa kweakaundi kusina kukwana kunova kwakakodzera kucheneswa mushure me24 maawa.
Kunopera kunomisa mvumo kunyange rekodhi risati radzimwa. Kuchenesa kwedatabhesi kwezuva nezuva kunoitwa panguva yekukumbira kwebasa rinotevera, kanenge kamwe chete paminiti imwe neimwe ye10 yekuchenesa kwemaneja, saka nguva dziri pamusoro apa inguva dzekupera kana nguva dzekuchenesa-kufanirwa pane zvipikirwa zvekudzimwa panguva chaiyo. Zvinyorwa zvevatengesi uye makopi ekuchengetedza ane upenyu hwakasiyana.
Kubvisa pairing kunobvisa pairing yakasarudzwa uye zvinyorwa zvayo zviri kure kubva ku active service database. Nhoroondo yekudzoserwa / kuchengetedzwa kunogona kugara neakaundi kwenguva iri pamusoro apa. Kudzima account yemaneja kunobvisa zvitupa zvayo, kubatanidza, snapshots, mirairo, uye nhoroondo dzekuchengetedza / kudzoreredza account kubva kudhatabhesi rebasa rakashanda. Haibvisi mavhareji emutambo wako, nyika, marongero, kana mafaira ekuchengetedza. Zvinyorwa zvenguva pfupi zvekudzivirira kushungurudzwa uye zvinyorwa kana backups zvakachengetwa nemupi hazvirevi kuti zvinobviswa pakarepo nechero chiito.
14.5 Kudzora Kwako uye Kudzivirirwa Kwekupinda
Kupinda-mukati kunoda password yako pamwe chete nepaskey iripo kana authenticator, yakadai seGoogle Authenticator. Nhoroondo dzakagadzirirwa kuti dzitsvake nzira mbiri idzi dzinochengeta zvinodiwa zvose zviri zviviri. Kuchinja password, kubvisa kombiyuta pawebsite, uye kubvisa account yemaneja kunoda kuongororwa kutsva kwekuchinja kwakadaro.
Kuvhura tsika mutambo-kunyaradza chiyamuro zvinodawo kuitika nhoroondo password uye kutsva kuongorora pasi nhoroondo iripo nzira zvinodiwa. Kubvumirwa kunosungirirwa nebrowser imwe chete, kombiyuta yakabatanidzwa, sevha yakachengetwa uye mutambo uripo unomhanya kwemaminitsi matatu. Kumira, kutangazve, konzo yakavharwa, kugadzirisa konzo kwakadzimwa kana kuti maitiro akarasika anodzivisa mamwe mirairo. Kubvisa kana kuvanza tab yemaneja kunogumisa kubvumirwa kweiyo tab. Mabhatani akajairika ekuita sevhavha anochengeta zvavanoda kuti vapinde. chete inotsigirwa mutambo-muridzi input kubatana vanokodzera; chiratidzo chakasiyana chete hachibvumiri kunyora muWindows command prompt.
Kombiyuta yakanyatsobvumirwa inogona kupa pasipoti yechinguvana kana ukakanganwa pasipoti yako yepawebsite. Haikwanisi kusarudza imwe nhoroondo. Chirevo chechinguva hachikundikani kana kubvisa zvaunoda zviripo zvepasskey/authenticator, uye unofanira kusarudza chirevo chitsva usati wapinda maneja. Kupedza kupora kunodzosera dzimwe nguva dzaunoita basa rokutsvaga.
Mutariri weSynix anochengeta chiratidzo chake chekupinda mubhurawuza mundangariro yeiyo tab yazvino, kwete mumacookies, nzvimbo yekuchengetera, kana kuchengetedza kwemusangano. Kuvandudza kana kuvhara tab kunorasikirwa nekupinda kwacho. Izvi hazvirambidzi browser rako kana password maneja kuchengetedza zvitupa kana ukasarudza, uye hazvitsananguri makuki akagadzirirwa zvakasiyana nevanopa webhusaiti / kuchengeteka kana basa rekushandura rewebsite yeruzhinji.
Unogona kusaina, kubvisa purogiramu dzese dzebrowser, kana kuti kubvisa kombiyuta. Chikumbiro chemuno cheSynix chinogona kudzima uye kubvisa kubatana kwayo kure pasina kupinda muwebsite. Kana isiripo, inomisa kuwana kure munzvimbo uye inoedza zvakare kubvisa webhusaiti kana kubatana kuripo. Kudzokorora app kana Windows hakugadziri otomatiki zvakajeka kubviswa pairing. Kushandiswa kwomunyika chete kunoramba kuripo.
14.6 Hosting, Peji dzeveruzhinji, uye Miganhu Yekuchengetedza
Webhusaiti yepamutemo inoshandisa OpenAI's Sites hosting uye Cloudflare masevhisi ekuendesa, kuchengetedza, chengetedzo, uye kutepfenyura. Vatengesi ava vanogadzirisa ruzivo runodiwa kuti vape masevhisi aya uye vanogona kugamuchira kero dzeIP, kukumbira misoro, nguva, uye mamwe metadata yekubatanidza, kana kuchengetedza zvinyorwa zvavo zvekushandisa uye makopi ekuchengetedza. Mitemo yavo yekuvanzika inoshanda pakugadziriswa kwavo: https://openai.com/policies/privacy-policy/ uye https://www.cloudflare.com/privacypolicy/.
Shanduro yepachivande yemapeji uye kurodha pasi kweGitHub zvinobatanidza vanopa vavo. Mutungamiri wepachivande akaparadzaniswa nemapeji eruzhinji uye haatarisi mutengesi weshanduro yeruzhinji kana zvinyorwa zvekushambadzira. Synix haiiti tsanangudzo yakajeka yekuti kushanyira chero webhusaiti hakuiti makuki, zvinyorwa, kana kuchengetwa kwedata. Mashoko anogonawo kuziviswa kana zvichidikanwa nemutemo; chibvumirano chisina kutengeswa chiri pamusoro hachidzivisi kugamuchira kunodiwa kana kuzivisa zviri pamutemo.
Synix inoshandisa kubatanidza kwakasimbiswa, zvikumbiro zvemakombiyuta zvakasainwa, kubatana kwenetiweki kwakavharidzirwa, kuongororwa kwekuwana kweakaundi, uye kubvumidzwa kwenguva pfupi kudzikisa kuwana kusina mvumo. Zvivimbiso izvi hazviiti kuti kuwana kure kusashatise kana kuvimbisa kudzivirirwa pakurwiswa kwose, kombiyuta/browser yakakuvadzwa, nzira dzekuongorora dzakabiwa, kana basa rakakuvadzwa. Chengetedza Synix uye Windows yakagadziridzwa, chengetedza account yako uye nzira dzekuongorora, uye bvuma chete makombiyuta uye maakaundi aunodzora.
Chiziviso ichi chiri pachena pahttps://synix.info/license/ uye chinobatanidzwa muApp's Help Center uye installer. Mibvunzo yekuvanzika inogona kumutswa kuburikidza nesarudzo dzepamutemo dzekutsigira pahttps://synix.info/support/. Usaisa mapassword, makodhi ekudzoreredza, kana rumwe ruzivo rweakaundi yakavanzika mumeseji yeruzhinji yekutsigira. Kuvandudzwa kwechiziviso ichi kunosanganisira kuongororwa kutsva uye zuva.

data.name: Content.3EDF002B53C15DD7A21D
data.value:
Vhura Zvirongwa → Taura Dambudziko kuti ugadzirire mushumo, kana kuti shandisa nzvimbo dzepamutemo dzekutsigira pazasi.
Ita Kuti Dambudziko Ridzokere Sanganisira nzira yekuisa, shanduro dzeSynix uye Windows dzauri kushandisa, mutambo/profile, uye ruzivo rwakakodzera rwekudhinda/loader.
Rondedzera: • Zvawakadzvanya kana kuti zvawakachinja. • Zvawaitarisira uye zvakaitika. • Chikanganiso chaicho uye chinyorwa chiduku chiri pedyo nenguva yacho. • Kana marongero acho akashanda kare uye chii chakashanduka.
Ongororo Usati Wagovana Bvisa mapassword, tokens, webhook URLs, nzira dzako pachako, uye ruzivo rwe network rwausingadi kuti ruzivikanwe. Maitiro Okuvanzika haagoni kuchenesa mafaira ose akabatanidzwa. Usabatanidza zvinyorwa zvizere kana magadzirirwo emutambo usina kuzvitarisa.
Kana uchida shanduro, nyora mutauro wakasarudzwa, zita rehwindo, uye mashoko chaiwo anooneka. Nokuda kwedambudziko rekutsanangurwa kwemutambo, shandisa mharidzo yekugadzirisa uye zvinyorwa zvemutambo zvakakodzera.
ZVINOFANIRA KUFARIRWA Mharidzo dzemasangano: https://github.com/ubidzz/Synix-Control-Panel/issues
Community Discord: https://discord.gg/WduKEU3j8s
Repository yeprojekti: https://github.com/ubidzz/Synix-Control-Panel
Kugadzwa kwakabudirira kwekushandisa kana kuvaka hakugoni kuedza mutambo wose, mod, uye nzvimbo yemambure. Nhanho dzakajeka dzekudzokorora dzinobatsira kusiyanisa dambudziko reSynix kubva kumutambo kana host-setup dambudziko.

data.name: Content.3FCD178C083A4D548FE7
data.value:
Dzvanya pane mutsara weserver usati washandisa zvigadziro zviri pasi. Mutsetse wakasarudzwa unoratidza kuti chiito chinokanganisa server ipi.
Tsvaka Mushumiri Shandisa bhokisi rokutsvaka kuti uchenese nemutambo kana zita rebasa. Firita remamiriro ezvinhu rinowedzera kuderedza rondedzero yacho. Kana chimwe chinhu chichiita sechisina kuoneka, bvisa mafirita ose ari maviri usati wafunga kuti chabviswa.
Verenga MUCHIDZIDZO • Maserver akaiswa anoverenga zvinyorwa zvemaserver zvakanyorwa. • Running Now inoratidza zvinyorwa zvinotaurwa kuti zviri kumhanya. • CPU Kushandiswa uye RAM Kushandiswa kunotsanangura PC yose, kwete Synix chete. • Dhiyabhorosi yemutambi inowanikwa chete kana mutambo wakasarudzwa ukafumura sosi inotsigirwa.
ZVINOTAURWA Zuva Nezuva • Tanga, Mira, uye Tangazve kutarisira server yakasarudzwa. • Kugadzirisa kunovhura nzvimbo dzayo dzokugadza. • Kugadzirira kunotarisa nyaya dzinogona kukutadzisa kushanda. • Server Options ine mafaira, kugadziriswa, kubatana, uye zvishandiso zvemutambo. • Dzvanya kaviri mutsetse kuti uongorore server yacho zvakadzama.
Activity & Diagnostics inoratidza kufambira mberi uye nyevero dzakakodzera. Verenga mashoko achangobva kubuda usati waita chimwe chinhu. CLEAR inochenesa nzvimbo inooneka yebasa; haisi murayiro wokubvisa mafaira ose erogi.
Basa rokumhanya harina kugadzirirwa vatambi. Kuiswa, kutakura pasi pose, zvibvumirano, uye kugadziriswa kwemutambo kunogona kuenderera mberi pashure pokunge muitiro waitika. Simbisa kugadzirira mubhuku remutambo uye nokujoina.

data.name: Content.3FDD32467F5AC4908CBA
data.value:
Open Server Options → Mod & Plugin Manager yeprofile inotsigirwa. Synix inoona zvirimo zvakaiswa uye nzvimbo dzinotsigirwa; harisi bhuku rine zvinhu zvose zvitsva.
Gadza KUSHANDISA KUPENYURA 1. Tsigira nyika, zvekuwedzera zviripo, uye kugadziriswa kwakakanganiswa. 2. Dzivisa server kuburikidza Synix uye kumirira kuti boka rayo muitiro kubuda. 3. Ongorora system yekuwedzera yakaonekwa, nzvimbo yekugadza, uye rondedzero yekuchengetedza. 4. Sarudza Install From File kana Import Package kuti uwane faira rinotsigirwa, ZIP, kana kuti mod yakazara. Zvisarudzo zviripo zvinoenderana nehurongwa hwekuwedzera hwemutambo. 5. Ongorora nzvimbo yauri kuenda, zvabuda pakuongorora, yambiro, uye kusimbisa. 6. Regai kugadzira, kutsigira, uye kuisa kupera. 7. Synix inovandudza rondedzero apo kugadzwa kunopera. Tangazve kana zvichidikanwa, wobva waongorora zvinyorwa zvemutambo uye kubatana kwemutengi.
Rondedzero yacho inoratidza nzvimbo yekugadza yakasarudzwa. Shandisa Tsvaga kuti uwane chimwe chinhu chinowedzera nezita, mhando, tsime, kana kuti nzira. Fungisisa zvakare uye chengetedza chinhu chakasarudzwa kana chichiripo. Maonero akareruka anovanza mamwe mashoko ezvokushandisa pasina kupfuurira kuongororwa.
Chengeta hwindo rakavhurika apo kuongorora kana kuchinja kuri kuitika. Synix inorambidza zviito zvinopesana kusvikira yapera. Kana chiito chikakundikana, verenga kukanganisa kwacho uye dzokorora rondedzero usati waedzazve.
ZVINHU ZVEKUSHANDIRA Maitiro ekushanda anotsigirwa anosanganisira Minecraft JAR mapakeji, Rust Oxide / uMod plugins, emuno 7 Mazuva Ekufa mapakeji, Empyrion scenarios uye server mods, ARK: Survival Evolved Workshop IDs, uye ARK: Survival Ascended mupi ID. Mamwe masisitimu anoonekwa chete kana kuti anotanga kuda hurongwa hwavo.
Synix inotarisira kugadziriswa kunotsigirwa kwevatengesi IDs apo mutambo / mupi anopa zvirimo. Zvinhu zvisati zvaiswa pasi hazvigoni kuongororwa pachinzvimbo.
ZVINOKONZERWA NEZVINOTAURWA NEBHAIBHERI Zvinotengeswa zvinotarisa marongero emapakeji nenzvimbo dzekuenda uye zvinoramba nzira dzisina kuchengeteka, zvinongedzo, zvirimo zvisingabvumirwi, mapakeji akakura, nzvimbo dzakapetwa, uye kuonekwa kwe malware kwakasimbiswa.
Kuongororwa kweDefender kusingawanikwi kana kuti kusingatsananguriki kunonyevera, kwete uchapupu hwekuti pane malware. Kuongorora kwakachena uye hash yakanyorwawo hazviratidzi kuti purogiramu yechitatu yakavimbika. Mods dzinomhanya nemvumo ye server yeWindows.
MAKATALOG, KUBviswa, Uye Kuwana Browse Catalog inovhura webhusaiti yeanopa. Haizogadzirisi zvinodzikira kana kuisa modpack yakakwana.
Dzivisa server isati yaita Roll Back Import. Izvi zvinodzosera kunze kwenyika yose yakasarudzwa, iyo inogona kunge iine zvimwe zvekuwedzera. Inodzorera zvinyorwa zvakaponeswa uye inobvisa mafaira akaiswa nekupinza ikoko. Dzorera shure zvinhu zvitsva zvinotengeswa pakutanga pavanogovana mafaira; Synix inoramba kunyora pamusoro mafaira akachinjwa kunze kwayo yakanyorwa kupinza kana kushandisa vakachengetedzwa mavambo kuti kukundikana kwavo yakanyorwa kuvimbika ongororo. Zvinyorwa zvekupinza zvekare zvinogona kusasanganisira hashes yezvinyorwa zvakachengetwa.
Kune ID inotungamirirwa nemupi, Remove Selected inobvisa iyo ID kubva kuSynix's inotsigirwa gadziriro; haisi purogiramu yokudzokorora yomunharaunda. Synix inonyora kuchinja kunoitwa, kwete kugadziriswa kwese kwemaoko. Ramba uine ma-full-server backups akazvimirira: kubvisa mod kunogona kuita kuti nyika irege kutorwa kana kubvisa zvirimo zvine mod.
Tafura isina chinhu inoreva kuti hapana zvinowedzerwa zvinotsigirwa zvinoenderana nenzvimbo yekumisikidza yakasarudzwa uye kutsvaga. Bvisa Tsvaga uye tarisa chimiro, faira, uye chimiro usati wafunga kuti mafaera ose ari pane disk akatsvakurudzwa.

data.name: Content.3FFA3E0258F2F0369B0C
data.value:
Vhura Wedzera Server → Game Support Catalog kuti uone zvinozivikanwa naSynix pamusoro pemutambo usati wagadzira chinyorwa. Bhuku racho rinoshandisa tsanangudzo dzakabatanidzwa nechikumbiro chako chawakaisa.
1. Tsvaka zita remutambo. 2. Shandisa configuration, mutambi-data, crossplay, kugarisana, kana kuongorora filters kuderedza mazita. 3. Sarudza mutambo wacho uvhure mashoko acho, kana kuti tinya pairi. 4. Verenga marongero anotsigirwa, purogiramu yevashandi, chinodiwa, uye mashoko ekuongorora.
Bvisa mafirita kana mutambo wacho usiri kutarisirwa. Minecraft's Java uye Bedrock sarudzo dziri chikamu chekugadziriswa kwekugadzirisa basa panzvimbo pemasisitimu maviri ekuchinja.
Verenga Unyanzvi Hwako NYAYA Nhoroondo inogona kupa kugadziriswa kunotarisirwa, kutungamirirwa kumisikidza, kutanga marongero, kana shoma / hwaro rutsigiro. A runyorwa executable kana Steam AppID rinotsanangura mashandiro installation; haibvumiri kusunungurwa kwese kwemutambo.
Chinodikanwa cheSteamCMD chakasimbiswa chinoreva kuti chimiro chinokumbira kuwana account. Kuva muridzi wemutambo uye mitemo yemuparidzi zvinogona kuita kuti pave nezvimwe zvinodiwa.
ZVIMWE zviteshi zvisirizvo hazvisi zvitsva Mutengo wakachengetwa we query-port haupupupuri kuti muteereri wemubvunzo aripo kana kuti anofanira kuiswa pachena. Shandisa chaiwo mutambo configuration uye protocol zvinodiwa.
Catalogue ndiyo nzvimbo yokutarisa tsanangudzo dzakaiswa. Nhoroondo dzomunharaunda dzokuongorora dzinoratidza zvakaonekwa paPC iyi, kwete migumisiro yenyika yose yemashini ose kana kuti mod combination.

data.name: Content.45EB10CB4237CAC4A2E5
data.value:
Vhura chiratidzo che gear pane dashboard kuti uwane marongero ekushandisa. Shandisa bhatani rekuti "Gadzirisa" rebasa kuti uwane marongero anongowanikwa pabasa iroro chete.
ZVAKAITIKA • Ratidza Server Console Window controls kana maseva anotsigirwa achiratidza console yavo yemuno. Hwindo rakavanzwa harirevi kuti sevha yacho yamiswa. • Dark Mode inoshandura dingindira rekushandisa. • SteamCMD Download Speed inosarudza kumhanya kwakazara kana kuti muganho wekutakura unotsigirwa. • Kuchinja kwemitauro kwaitsigirwa nemazita emutauro, matafura, uye mameseji ehutano.
Mamwe mapeji ane nzvimbo dzekuchengetedza uye kutamisa, zvakavanzika / zvekuchengetedza sarudzo, kuzivisa matambudziko, uye epamberi / kumashure marongero. Haufaniri kugonesa zvingasarudzwa kuti ugadzire server yakajairika.
KUTAURA MUDZIMI Sarudza kubva mumitauro inopiwa mukusarudza. Synix controls, rubatsiro nyaya, uye Anwendung generated mashoko anoshandisa mutauro vakasarudzwa. Mirayiridzo yemutambo, tsika dzekugadzirisa uye kuburitswa kwepakutanga kwevashandisi hazvishandurwi. Mafaira ezvinyorwa zvemazuva ano ano anoramba aine mashoko okutanga okuongorora.
Rugwaro rwakatarisana nemutambo harushandurwi: mirairo, makiyi ekugadzirisa uye kukosha, mazita emepu, modes, mazita emafaira, arguments ekutanga, zviratidzo, uye zvinyorwa zvekubudisa-kuziva zvinofanira kuramba zviri muchimiro chinotarisirwa nemutambo.
Kuchinja mutauro wekubatanidza hakushanduri mutsara wemirairo yemutambo kana kushandura kuburitswa kwekombiyuta. Kana chinyorwa chenguva dzose cheSynix chikashandurwa zvisingatarisirwi, taura mashoko acho chaiwo, hwindo racho, uye mutauro wakasarudzwa.

data.name: Content.493BAB772B40AABA8979
data.value:
Vhura Zvirongwa → Privacy & Security usati wagovana skrini kana kuongorora sarudzo dzekuchengetedza.
MUTANGA WEMAHARA Masiki ePrivacy Mode akatsigira kuratidzwa kunonzwisisika, senge kero uye zvitupa. Haishandure IP yako yeruzhinji, encrypt network traffic, kana kuchenesa ose mutambo zvinyorwa uye configuration faira.
Ongorora mufananidzo usati waugovana. Kutevedzera chiito pane imwe nzvimbo yakavharwa kunogonawo kutevedzera kukosha chaiko.
PASWORDS AND TOKEN ZVAKAPONESWA Synix inodzivirira mapassword akachengetwa anotsigirwa, zviratidzo, uye webhook kukosha kwezvino Windows mushandisi. Mutambo wacho unogona kunge uchiri kuda zviratidzo zvinoverenga zviri mumagadzirirwo awo kana kuti nharo dzokutanga.
Kopi yefolda yakajeka kune imwe nhoroondo yeWindows haivimbisi kuti tsika idzi dzakachengetedzwa dzinogona kuvhurwa. Shandisa basa rekufambisa rakavharwa kuti uwane ruzivo rwekufambisa.
ZVINOTAURWA NEVAMWE Mhanya Synix uye dzose mutambo servers pamwe mureza Windows mvumo. Shanduko chaiyo yesisitimu kana mutambo wekutanga unogona kukumbira kusimudzwa zvakasiyana; hakusi chikonzero chokushandisa zvinhu zvose nguva dzose somutungamiriri.
Zvinetso zvekuchenesa moto zvinotsigirwa nemitemo yekare yeSynix. Ongorora mitemo yakataurwa usati wabvuma kubviswa. Haigoni kutarisira mafaira ose akajairwa kana kubvumira kubvisa mitemo isina chokuita ne firewall.
Kana chakavanzika chikafumurwa, chinotsiviwa kana kuti chinodzorwa nehofisi yakachipa. Kuvanza munda kana kubvisa kopi yakachengetwa yeSynix hakuiti kuti kodzero iyoyo ishande kune imwe nzvimbo.

data.name: Content.5157BE079A5B48521112
data.value:
Kuvhara hwindo remwana, kudzikisira Synix, uye kubuda pachena mukushandisa zviito zvakasiyana. Ongorora maitiro ako akagadzirirwa uye chero mashoko okubuda.
KUVHURURA PANEL YEKUTONDRA Synix inogona kuziva zvinotsigirwa server maitiro achiri kumhanya uye kudzorera muridzi wavo. Rega kuongororwa kwekutanga kwepurogiramu kupera usati watanga imwe nyaya.
Kuzivikanwa kwepurogiramu kunofanira kuenderana nechishandiso chakasarudzwa, kwete chete zita rinozivikanwa rinogona kuitwa. Kuputira kwakagadzirirwa kana masevhisi anotarisirwa kunze kungada kutarisirwa kwakawedzerwa.
ZVIMWE ZVAKAITIKA Optional startup / background-agent marongero rutsigiro kuongorora panguva Windows Login. Hazvidiwi kuti vagadzire server yako yokutanga.
Basa rakarongwa rinoda basa rakakodzera reSynix kana kuti mumiririri, purogiramu yeWindows iripo, uye PC yakamuka. Kupinda-mukati kutanga hakusi chipikirwa chokuti basa richamhanya apo muchina wacho wakavharwa.
PANGU USATI Watangazve MAWINDO Pedzisa kuita backups, kudhanilodha, uye kutumira. Mira mitambo kuburikidza Synix saka vanogona kuponesa zvakajairika, ipapo kubuda kana restart Windows.
Usafungidzira kuti console yemitambo yakavanzwa yakamira kana kuti kuvhara hwindo rokutarisa kunovhara mutambo wayo. Ongorora dashboard uye shandisa zvinodzora upenyu hwevanhu.

data.name: Content.57A2257D55B43047831A
data.value:
Vhura mhedzisiro yekugadzirira yeiyo server yakasarudzwa kuti uone chinodiwa chisipo. Nguva yekumhanya inosanganisirwa neSynix haitsivi zvinodiwa zvakasiyana zvemutambo.
ZVIMWE ZVINOSHAKA DLL Meseji Zvikanganiso kutaura MSVCP140.dll kana VCRUNTIME140.dll kazhinji kureva Visual C ++ runtime chinodiwa. Shandisa mirayiridzo mutambo uye anoenderana akatsigira Microsoft redistributable.
Microsoft's redistributable information: https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/cpp/windows/latest-supported-vc-redist
Usatore mafaira eDLL kubva kumawebhusaiti asina kujairika kana kuisa DLL dzisina hukama padivi pe server executable.
ZVIMWE ZVINODZIRWA Mutambo unogona kuda account, server kodzero, chaiyo Java runtime, Windows hunhu, kana inotsigirwa Hardware. Pedzisa zvinodiwa izvi usati wachinja zviteshi zvisingabatanidzwi kana reset configuration.
Minecraft Java, shandisa rutsigiro shanduro / loader mubatanidzwa kubva Synix selectors. Bedrock haishandisi Java.
Nokuda kwekushandiswa kunoda Hyper-V kana hardware virtualization, tarisa kuongorora kwayo kwemutambo. Usagonesa zvinhu zvesisitimu kana kumhanya sevhavha imwe neimwe semutungamiriri kungopfuudza nyevero.
Pashure pokugadzirisa chinodikanwa, ita kutanga patsva uye tarisa kukanganisa kwekutanga kunokosha kwemutambo kana kuchiri kutadza.

data.value:
ZVINONYANYA KUDZIDZA:
1. Synix inovhura yepamutemo Space Engineers Dedicated Server Manager uye inogara ichiichengeta ichionekwa.
2. Sarudza 'Local/Console', sarudza 'Continue to server configuration', pinda server uye nyika marongero, ipapo sarudza 'Save & start'.
3. Shandisa maneja kuti uwane marongero epamberi, nyika, mods, vatungamiriri, uye live console. Dhiyabhorosi yemushandisi inochengetwa mukati meSynix server's Instance faira.
4. Maitiro epamberi Local/Console haadi kodzero dzevatungamiriri. Windows service mode inoita.
5. Zvinodikanwa: .NET Framework 4.8 kana yazvino, Visual C ++ Redistributable 2013 uye 2017, zvirinani 6 GB yesystem RAM, uye UDP chiteshi 27016 chakabvumidzwa kuburikidza neWindows Firewall uye yakatumirwa kune vatambi veInternet.
6. Zvinyorwa zvepamutemo: https://www.spaceengineersgame.com/dedicated-servers/

data.name: Content.5D3A53B459DA2A7A26AF
data.value:
Shandisa gwaro iri apo LAN kutamba kunoshanda asi bvunzo yeruzhinji haina.
ZVINHU ZVAUNOGONA Kutaura Nevanhu Vose Dzimwe router hadzitsigiri NAT loopback, inonziwo hairpinning. Kubatana kunobva mukati meimba yacho nehurukuro yayo yeruzhinji kunogona kukundikana kunyange apo vatambi vokunze vanogona kujoina.
Shandisa kero yeLAN pamba uye bvunza mumwe munhu ane imwe Internet connection kuti aongorore kero yeruzhinji. Kuongorora kwakakundikana kwePC WAN pachako hakuratidzi kuti internet yapera.
Kufambira Mberi Hakusi Kusiyana Tarisa kune imwe router kumusoro, kaviri NAT, kana mutakuri-grade NAT (CGNAT). Enzanisa ruzivo rweWAN rwe router nekero yeruzhinji uye bvunza ISP kana kubatana kunopinda kuchitsigirwa.
Mutemo wekutumira mberi pane router yako haugone kuvhura ISP-inodzorwa upstream NAT. Zvichienderana nekubatana, panogona kudikanwa sevhisi yeruzhinji, yakakodzera VPN/tunnel, kana server yakagadzirirwa. Aya marongero ekunze, kwete akavakirwa-mukati Synix zvinhu.
Usabatanidze manejimendi nePlayer Access Kubatanidzwa kwekudzora kure uye kubatana kwemutambi wemutambo inzira dzakasiyana. Kubvumira zviziviso zveAPI kana Discord zvemuno hazviiti kuti mutambo uwanewe kubva paIndaneti.
Chengeta chero network bvunzo narrowly scope kuti mutambo wacho echokwadi chiteshi uye protocol. Usashambadza mapasiwedi, tokens, screenshots ye router, kana ruzivo rwemagariro paunenge uchikumbira kubatsirwa.

data.name: Content.6B534A2A8D64DD2115B8
data.value:
Shandisa bhuku rinotaura nezvechikamu chakakundikana.
KUSHANDISA Kwakaita SYNIX Activity & Diagnostics inoratidza kufambira mberi uye yambiro dzine chokuita nemushandisi pane dashboard. Kubvisa nzvimbo iyoyo kunobvisa mashoko anooneka chete; hakubvisi kuongororwa kwose kwakaponeswa.
ZVINONYANYA Zvekushandisa Synix zvinyorwa zvemashoko uye mishumo yekufa kwevanhu inowanzova pasi pe: C:\Synix\SynixData\logs
Dhiyabhorosi yekukurumidzira inogona kutumidza zita refaira chairo. Shandisa nzira iyoyo uye nguva yekusakwanisa kuwana chinyorwa chakakodzera.
Zvikanganiso zvokuongorora zvinobatwa zvinogona kunyorwa mubhuku rokunyora mashoko pasina kuoneka pa dashboard. Kusiyana kwakanyorwa kunotarisirwa hakusi uchapupu hwokuwira kwechikumbiro.
GAME LOGS Shandisa chaicho mutambo log ari Server vakasarudzwa kuti nyika kutakura, configuration, mod, uye mutambo run-nguva zvikanganiso. Nzvimbo yaro inoenderana nemutambo uye inogona kunge iri kunze kwemudzi wekuisa.
VERENGA MUCHINANGWA Cherechedza chiito uye nguva, wobva waongorora mashoko akakomberedza kukundikana kokutanga kunokosha. Mutsetse wokuvhara pakupedzisira unogona kuva mugumisiro kwete chikonzero.
Usati wagovana chero chinyorwa, bvisa mapassword, tokens, webhooks, kero dzepachivande, uye nzira dzomunhu oga. Satisfactory's own console/log inogona kunge iine admin token. Chengeta zvinyorwa zvacho zvepachivande kuti uongorore.

data.name: Content.72F10866249FA31A6B09
data.value:
Kudzorera kunogona kutsiva zviri mukati mekugadzwa kweserver yakasarudzwa. Sarudza server yakakodzera uye chengeta chero chinhu chitsva usati waenderera mberi.
1. Mira server uye ita kopi yakaparadzana yemafaira aripo aunogona kuda. 2. Vhura basa rekudzorera backup muServer Options. 3. Sarudza archive yaunoda uye tarisa server yayo, zuva, saizi, uye mamiriro ehutongi. 4. Ongorora usati wadzorera. Synix backups ine SHA-256 zvitupa zvinogona kuongororwa neaya zvitupa; zvinyorwa zvekare zvinogona kuzivikanwa senhaka. 5. Verenga yambiro yokutsiva uye simbisa chete kana iyi iri nzvimbo yaunoda kupora. 6. Rega kutenderera nekudzoreredza kupera pasina kuvhara Synix kana kubvisa kuchengetedza. 7. Tanga sevha uye simbisa kuti nyika yaunoda uye marongero zvakadzorerwa.
ZVINOTAURWA Nekuongororwa Kuongororwa kwekuvimbika kunoratidza kuchinja kunoitika pakubhengi. Hachiratidzi kuti nyika yakanga ine utano hwakanaka payakaponeswa kana kuti nhoroondo yomumwe munhu yakavimbika.
KANA KUDYISWA Kwakavhiringidzwa Chengetedza dura racho nemamwe mafaira ekudzorera kana kuti ekudzoreredza. Verenga mashoko ekudzorera usati waedza kudzorera kana kubvisa mafaira.
Usabvisa ZIP pane imwe server iri kumhanya. Kana mutambo wacho uchiramba uchichengetedza kunze kwefaira rekuisa, dzorera zvakasiyana nehurongwa hunotsigirwa nemutambo.
Chengeta backup yepakutanga kusvikira waedza server yakadzorerwa uye kubatana kwemutengi.

data.name: Content.74448A2C2CBD821D56C4
data.value:
Import Existing Server inonyora kuiswa kunotsigirwa kuripo pane diski. Haisi reinstall uye yakasiyana nekupinza yakazara Synix kutumira pasuru.
Usati Watora Ita backup yakaparadzana, kusanganisira chero kuchengetedza kunze kwefaira rekuisa. Mira sevha uye usashande mumwe maneja kana purogiramu anogona kuitanga apo Synix iri kuitarisira.
KUNyoresa KUSHANDISA 1. Sarudza Wedzera Server → Import Server iripo. 2. Sarudza dhairekitori rekugadza sevha chairo, kwete nzira pfupi, faira reZIP, kana dhairekitori remutengi wemutambo. 3. Regai Synix kuongorora, ipapo simbisa mutambo vakaona, shanduro, executable, uye marongero. 4. Ipa chinyorwa zita rakasiyana uye zadza chero kukosha kushayikwa. 5. Pedzisa kuunza, vhura Configure, uye tarisa nzira dzayo nemapuranga. 6. Mhanya Kugadzirira, wozoita kutanga kumwe chete. Ongorora kuti nyika yaunoda uye marongero zvainge zvakatakurwa.
ZVICHANDISA ZVINokosha Kunyoresa hakufambisi chigadzirwa chacho, kuchidzokorora, kana kutsiva mafaira acho. Zviito zvinotevera zvaunosarudza zvakajeka, zvakadai seKuvandudza, Kusimbisa, kana kugadzirisa configuration, zvinogona kuchinja mafaira.
Magadzirirwo ekuvhara ekutanga, modpacks, mapasiwedi, uye kuchengetedza kwekunze kunogona kusangoonekwa. Nzira imwe chete yekuisa haigoni kunyorwa kaviri.
Kana KUSVIRA Kwakundikana Ongorora kuti wakasarudza kuiswa kwevashumiri vakatsaurirwa kunotsigirwa neprofile yakasarudzwa. Usashandura zita remunhu asingabatanidzwi kuti aite kuti zvinhu zvienderane. Taura nezvemutambo wacho uye marongerwo emafolda akagadziriswa kuitira kuti tsanangudzo yawo ikwanise kuongororwa.

data.name: Content.749F8256FE4490AB39C8
data.value:
Shandisa gwaro iri apo configuration editor inoshuma kushayikwa kwemunda unotarisirwa, hurongwa husina kukodzera, kana kuti template isingaenderani.
Kunzwisisa Zvisarudzo • Zvakajairika kuchengetedza zvinyorwa zvinotsigirwa mumagadzirirwo akasarudzwa. • Kugadziriswa kunogadzirisa dambudziko rakataurwa rinotsigirwa. • Reset inodzorera default template uye inogona kubvisa custom settings.
Kudzorera haisi danho rokutanga pakutadza kwevashumiri vose. Nguva dzomutambo dzisipo, zviteshi zvinopindwa, uye mods dzakaputsika hadzigadziriswi nokutsiva mafaira ekugadzirisa kakawanda.
Usati Wagadzirisa Rega mutambo wacho, chengeta kopi isina kukanganiswa yemafaira akakanganiswa, uye verenga shanduko chaiyo yakataurwa. Mamwe ma profiles ane matemplate akazara; vamwe vanotarisira kuti mutambo wacho uchagadzira mafaira paunotanga kana kuti unoda kugadzirwa nemaoko.
Synix inoshuma kushayikwa kwezvinyorwa zvinodiwa panzvimbo pokufungidzira kuti inogona kutsiva mutsetse mumwe nomumwe zvakachengeteka. Kushandisa shanduko ye template inotarisirwa kunogona kuchengetedza kopi imwechete inonzi .synix.before-template-v<revision>.bak.
Pashure Pokuchengetedza Kana Kuti Kugadziridza Kwakakundikana Chengeta mafaira ekuchengetedza kana ekudzoreredza uye verenga meseji yekudzorera. Enzanisa shanduro yepakutanga neyakashandurwa usati wasarudza yekudzorera. Usadzima uchapupu nokuedza Reset kakawanda.
Pashure pokupora, tanga kamwe chete uye tarisa mutambo wacho pachako. Simbisa kuti iri kuverenga nzira yakarurama uye kuti zvigadziriso zvaunoda zvichiripo.

data.name: Content.7871EA5C906D13E02997
data.value:
Dune inoshandisa sisitimu yekushandisa yekunze ine michina chaiyo yemutambo uye mamiriro eboka rehondo. Haisi purogiramu yakajairika yemutambo.
ZVINOTAURWA Verenga Synix kugadzirira kuongorora kweiyo system memory, AVX2, hardware virtualization, Hyper-V, uye inotsigirwa Professional-kana yepamusoro Windows edition. Zvinodikanwa zvokuyeuka zvinoenderana neboka rokurwisa uye mepu dzaunoita.
Synix haibatsiri virtualization kana kuisa Hyper-V. Pedzisa mitemo yepamutemo yemutambo usati watanga.
KUSVIRA uye kutanga 1. Gadzira chinyorwa cheDune: Awakening uye tarisa zvaunoda uye faira rekuisa. 2. Chengetedza uye Tanga. 3. Synix inotangisa chishandiso chepamutemo chebattlegroup.bat nehurongwa hwehutungamiri hunodiwa nekutumirwa ikoko. 4. Sarudza initial-setup muchishandiso chemutambo uye upe yako Self-Host Token. 5. Pedzisa kugadziriswa kweVM, network, uye boka rekurwisa muchishandiso ichocho.
Tora Self-Host Token kuburikidza nehurumende Funcom account portal uchishandisa kwayo kukodzera / setup maitiro: https://account.duneawakening.com/
Chengeta chiratidzo chacho chakavanzika. Kukwirira kwechishandiso ichi chekushandisa hazvirevi kuti sevha yega yeSynix inofanira kumhanya semutungamiriri.
ZVINOTAURWA NENETWERKING AND CONTROL LIMITES Shandisa chaiyo host / VM network layout yekushandiswa uye zviteshi zvinodiwa. The mubvunzo munda metadata muna Synix rinomiririra RMQ, kwete dzose A2S mubvunzo muteereri.
A rakavharwa launcher hwindo haruratidzi kuti ayo VMs akamira. Simbisa kumhanya mamiriro uye kuita hondo boka mashandiro pamwe mutambo wacho kuparadzirwa kuzvidzora.
Synix inogona kuisa, kugadzirisa, kuvhura, uye kuchengetedza faira rakasarudzwa rekuisa. Usafungidzira kuti kupera kwemaitiro kwakajairika, kubvunzurudzwa kwevatambi, kana kuti kudzoreredzwa kwemurindi kunodzora zvizere kushandiswa kwekunze. Kutengeswa kwefaira rokutanga hakusi kupihwa nokuda kwepurogiramu iyi.
Shandisa mitambo-inotsigirwa shutdown uye backups nzira kuti kuramba VM / Database mashoko. ZIP yekushandisa faira yega haisi yakasimbiswa yakavimbika backup yayo.

data.name: Content.7B4987810DD3E78752A5
data.value:
Musoro uyu ndewevashandisi vakura uye vanopa. Iwe haudi maturusi ekuvandudza kuti ugadzire sevha kubva kune inotsigirwa mbiri.
ZVINOTAURWA NENYA Yakavakirwa-mukati tsanangudzo dzemutambo dzinotsanangura kurodha pasi, executables, Steam AppIDs uye zvirevo zvekupinda, kutangisa nharo, zviteshi, maitiro ekugadzirisa, zvinodiwa zvisati zvaitika, uye kugona kwemutariri.
Zvinorondedzerwa sarudza inotsigirwa yakavakirwa-mukati maitiro. Havatakuri mashandiro asina kukodzera, magungano, kana zvinyorwa zvakadhindwa zvine simba. Kudonhedza faira reJSON mufolda yekushandisa yakaiswa hakuwedzeri chimiro chitsva chemutambo chakagadzirwa.
Gadzirisa Kana Kuti Wedzera Pfungwa 1. Tanga nemirayiridzo yepamutemo yakatsaurirwa-server uye chaiyo yakagadzirwa configuration mafaira. 2. Shandisa server-root-inoenderana nzira pazvinenge zvichidikanwa uye chaiyo mutambo akatarisana identifiers. 3. Sanganisira matemplate akazara anotsigirwa munzvimbo dzawo dzakakodzera. 4. Gadziridza tsanangudzo dzakakodzera/gadziriro/template revisions. 5. Ongorora raibhurari yacho, uvake neSDK inodiwa nebasa racho, uye ita bvunzo dzakakodzera. 6. Kuedza kugadzwa, kutanga, kumisa, uye kuongorora nemutambo chaiwo asati achinyora kuongorora.
The Definition Builder chinhu kukura-kuvaka chokushandisa, kwete dzose kusunungurwa setup chinodiwa.
SHOW ORGANIZATION • UI: Fungidziro yemahwindo. • ServerHandler: Game controllers uye server integrations. • SynixEngine: Application lifecycle, maintenance, networking, backups, uye kuchengeteka. • Dhizaini: Zvirongwa, misoro, uye vanobatsira pakuronga zvinhu. • Database/GameDefinitions: Maprofayiri emitambo uye matemplate. • Database/ModSystems: Inotsigirwa mabasa ekuwedzera. • Kugadziriswa kwenzvimbo: Katalogi dzekuenzanisa uye magenerator. • Kuongororwa: Kuongororwa kwakanangana nezvinhu.
Kuti uwane shanduro, dzokorora mutauro mumwe nomumwe pamwe chete uye chengetedza nzvimbo dzacho. Sanganisira nyaya dzokubatsira, kuongororwa, rugwaro rwokuwanika, uye tsanangudzo dzokutsigira mitambo. Usashandure mirairo, makiyi, zviratidzo, tsika dzevashandisi, kana kuti zviratidzo zvekubudisa. Nhoroondo dzokutanga dzechirwere ichi hadzina kuchinja.
Verenga mitemo yeLisense & Proprietary Terms usati wagoverazve kodhi kana kuvaka. Ramba uine zviratidzo zvechokwadi uye zvinyorwa zvemunhu oga zvisingabatanidzwi.

data.name: Content.7C1660167D3419DD05A4
data.value:
Gadzirisa purogiramu yekuchengetedza sevha chete mushure mekuedza maitiro ayo akajairika ekuchengetedza, kugadzirisa, kumisa, uye kutanga.
1. Vhura zvigadziriso zvayo zvekuzvishandura/purogiramu uye shandisa purogiramu yacho. 2. Sarudza mazuva nenguva. 3. Gadza Smart Maintenance uye sarudza zviripo backup / update sarudzo. 4. Sarudza kana uchimirira vatambi uye sarudza nguva yakanyanya kunonoka. 5. Chengetedza uye edza panguva yekuchengetedza iwe unogona kutarisira.
Purogiramu dzinoshandisa nguva yePC. Chengetedza wachi yayo uye nzvimbo yayo yenguva zvakarurama.
Apo PADZIDZO DZINOFANIRA Synix inogona kumirira vatambi vakabatana, wobva wabatanidza kumira kweboka rekushanda rakasimbiswa, kuita backup panguva yakamiswa, kugadzirisa, uye kutangazve zvinoenderana nesarudzo dzakasarudzwa.
Kunonoka kwakanyanya kunogumira, kwete kuvimbisa kumirira nokusingaperi. Kuchengetwa kunogona kuenderera mberi kana kwapera kunyange kana vatambi vachiripo. Kunonoka kusingapi nguva yokumirira.
Nhau dzevatambi dzine miganhu Kumirira kunoenderana neruzivo rwunogona kupiwa nemutambo wakasarudzwa. A API-linked Satisfactory Server inobata akwegura kana zvisingawanikwi counts Conservatively panguva configured kumirira nguva. Izvozvo hazviiti kuti mashoko emubvunzo asina kutsigirwa ave akavimbika.
Zivisa vatambi pachine nguva uye verenga mameseji anoita basa. Discord zviziviso zvinogona kutaura nezvezviitiko zvekuchengetedza zvinotsigirwa kana nzira dzavo dzakagadziriswa.
Iyo PC inofanira kunge yakamuka uye iyo yakakodzera Synix maitiro kana background agent inofanirwa kumhanya. Kombiyuta yakadzimwa kana kurara haigoni kuita zvakarongwa kurodha pasi uye kutangazve.

data.name: Content.8579FAD0312C27797E9E
data.value:
Vhura Windows Terminal kana kuti PowerShell uye shandisa chiziviso chepakiti chiri pasi apa. Mirayiridzo iyi inodzora Synix pachayo, kwete mavhareji emitambo.
INSTALL winget install --exact --id ubidzz.Synix
CHECK THE INSTALLED PACKAGE winget list --exact --id ubidzz.Synix
ZVINOGADZIRWA Vhara Synix uye upedze kushanda kwayo usati washandisa: winget upgrade --exact --id ubidzz.Synix
DZIVISA KUSHANDISA winget uninstall --exact --id ubidzz.Synix
Ramba Uine Dhiyabhorosi Kuiswa kwevashandi, kuchengetedza, uye backups kwakaparadzaniswa nepakeji yekushandisa. Usadzima C:\Synix kana mamwe mafaira e data asina kujairika kunze kwekunge uchida kubvisa data iroro nemaune.
Kana Mutemo Ukakundikana Verenga chikonzero chakataurwa. Kana WinGet inoshuma hash yekusawirirana kwe installer, mira uye utaure nezvazvo; usapfuudza hash verification. Kuvandudzwa kusiripo kunogona kureva kuti repository haina kubudisa purogiramu itsva.
WinGet mvumo uye inoenderana kudhanilodha hash haina kodhi-chiratidzo Synix kana kuvimbisa kuti Windows chengetedzo software ichavimba nayo.

data.name: Content.89E9CF0E65B8EACE25DF
data.value:
Chokutanga, ratidza kuti mutambo wacho unoshanda pane network yako. Kushandurwa kwe router hakugoni kugadzirisa mutambo usina kutanga kana kupedzisa kumisikidza kwayo kwokutanga.
Sarudza Nzvimbo Yakarurama • PaPC yebasa: Shandisa kubatana kwemutambo kunotsigirwa munharaunda kana kuti kumashure. • Pane chimwe chishandiso chemumbure womumba: Shandisa kero yeLAN yePC yebasa. • Kunze kwemambure ako epamba: Shandisa kero yako yeruzhinji kana kuti nzira yekutsvaga / kubatana yemutambo inotsigirwa.
Vhura Connection Information yechinhu chakasarudzwa kuti chiongorore magumo acho. A private LAN kero haigoni kushandiswa zvakananga Internet vatambi.
Bvunzo DZEKUVA 1. Mirira kusvikira mutambo wapera kutakura. 2. Ongorora chiteshi chakagadzirirwa nemigumisiro yekugadzirira kwebasa. 3. Unganidza kubva kumubatsiri PC, ipapo kubva imwe LAN mudziyo. 4. Kana LAN kuwana kukundikana, tarisa mutambo Log uye Windows Firewall kuwana chaiko Server executable.
Bvumira Vatambi vepaIndaneti 1. Ipa muenzi kero yakagadzikana yeLAN, kazhinji iine DHCP yekuchengetedza router. 2. Ziva zviteshi zvinodiwa uye TCP / UDP protocols nokuti mutambo chaiwo configuration. 3. Tumira migumo iyoyo chete kune kero ye LAN yemushandi. 4. Bvumira kuwirirana kwemitambo traffic kuburikidza neWindows Firewall pane network profiles yaunoshandisa. 5. Kuedzwa kunobva pakubatana kwepaIndaneti kwakasiyana zvechokwadi.
Usaita kuti DMZ router ishande, usadzima firewall, kana kuratidza kuti chiteshi chimwe nechimwe chehutongi chinogadziriswa. Chengetedza zvitupa zve router zvakavanzika.
Synix inyanzvi yekugadzirisa desktop. Haibatanidzi webhusaiti yakagadzirirwa kana kuverengerwa kweruzhinji kunoita kuti zvinodiwa izvi zvehutano zviparare.

data.name: Content.8B70E3569A9351B28D08
data.value:
SteamCMD inotora uye inogadziridza mafaira akazvipira-server emitambo yeSteam inotsigirwa. Synix inogadzirira kopi yayo yakagoverwa otomatiki; purogiramu yakajairika server setup haidi rakaparadzana SteamCMD Tab.
Ramba Uchitsigira Basa Sarudza server uye verenga Activity & Diagnostics. Mufananidzo uri pane dashboard unoratidza kuti basa rokugadza riri kuitwa. SteamCMD inogona kuchinja pakati pekuodhaunirodha, kugovera, kubvisa, uye kusimbisa, saka kuburitswa kwayo hakusi nguva dzose kunopa chikamu chakasimba kana nguva yakavimbika yasara.
Ita kuti diski ishande ichipera kunyange kana motokari yemambure ikadonha. Verenga shoko rokupedzisira rekubudirira kana kuti rekutadza usati watanga rimwe basa.
KUDZIMISA KUDZIMISA KUSVIRA Vhura Zvirongwa → General → SteamCMD Download Speed. Sarudza inotsigirwa shoma muoti uye kupinda zvairatidzwa nokukurumidza, kana kusarudza zvizere nokukurumidza.
Izvi zvinokanganisa kurodha pasi kweSteamCMD, kwete bandwidth yevatambi, iyo isiri-Steam downloader yemutambo wese, kana traffic yese paPC.
ZVINONYANYA ZVEKUVA KANA ZVAKUVA KUKOSHA Mamwe ma profiles emitambo anoda mvumo yeSteam account uye Steam Guard kusimbiswa. Shandisa Synix's sign-in prompt; usaisa zvitupa zveakaundi mumagwaro eruzhinji kana kuti mumishumo.
Kuti uone kukundikana kwekurodha pasi, verenga chikanganiso chaicho cheSteamCMD uye tarisa nzvimbo yemahara yediski, kuwana mafolda, kuwana network, uye chero chinodiwa cheakaundi. Kugadziriswa kunogona kuderedzazve mafaira anotungamirirwa nemugadziri, saka chengetedza shanduko dzakagadzirirwa usati waishandisa.

data.name: Content.9C3A77D42EDA0BF1010D
data.value:
Mamiriro ezvinhu eEmpyrion uye server-code mods akasiyana. Mune Server Options → Mod & Plugin Manager, sarudza Empyrion scenarios kana Empyrion server mods. Dzivisa server uye chengetedza backup yakazara ye server usati waita shanduko.
Gadza SENARIO 1. Browse Catalog inovhura Steam Workshop. Sign up to the scenario and wait for Steam to finish downloading it. Mapurani emusangano uye kuunganidzwa hakusi server scenarios. 2. Sarudza Import Package, wozosarudza Folder. Sarudza faira yemamiriro ezvinhu ari mukati mefaira reSteam rebhizimisi rako resteamapps\workshop\content\383120. Unogonawo kusarudza zvizere mamiriro ezvinhu ZIP. 3. Pinda zita refaira rinogona kuzivikanwa. Usashandise chete nhamba yeWorkshop ID. Chengeta zita rimwe chetero refaira racho kuti rivandudzwe. 4. Ongorora kuongororwa kwepakiti uye nzvimbo yekuenda, wobva wasimbisa kupinza. Synix inokopa mamiriro ezvinhu akazara muContent\Scenarios pasina kuashandisa kana kuchinja nyika. 5. Sarudza Scenario runyorwa rwema scenarios akaiswa. Sarudza imwe uye ongorora zita rakapatsanurwa rekuponesa. Kuchinja kune imwe mamiriro ezvinhu kunoda zita idzva risina kushandiswa; Synix inoratidza imwe uye inosiya zvigaro zviripo zvisina kubatwa. 6. Shandisa chisarudzo chacho, tanga sevha, uye tarisa zvinyorwa zvayo uye kubatana kwemutengi. Mamwe mamiriro ezvinhu ane mamwe marongero kana kuti zvinodiwa zvakanyorwa nomunyori wawo.
Zita remamiriro ezvinhu rinonzi GameConfig.CustomScenario; zita renyika yakaponeswa GameConfig.GameName. Synix inotsigira dedicated.yaml isati yachinja minda iyi uye inochengetedza server yekupinda yakabatana. Haisi kudzorera mbeu, mapasiwedi, kana marongero asina chokuita.
INSTALL SERVER modes Shandisa Empyrion server mods profile uye Import Package kuti usarudze mod ZIP yakanyorwa kana faira yakazara ye mod. Sanganisira DLL dzayo, zviwanikwa zvekutsigira, zvinoenderana, uye _Info.yaml kana zvapihwa. Synix inoisa izvi pasi peContent\Mods; mutambo wacho unotakura kodhi paunotanga. Source-code kurodha pasi uye standalone installers havasi kutsigirwa mapakeji.
Synix haina kuisa mod loader kana kubvumira mod yakadzimwa otomatiki. Tevedza zvinodiwa nemunyori, kusanganisira chero imwe loader, configuration, uye mutengi setup. Kupinda kwakabudirira hakuratidzi kuti mod inowirirana nemutambo uripo kana mamwe ma mods akaiswa.
ZVINOGADZIRWA NEZVINOKONZERWA Steam inovandudza kopi yayo yeWorkshop, kwete kopi yeserver inotorwa neSynix. Kuti ugadzirise, kumisa server uye kupinza purogiramu yakagadziridzwa uchishandisa zita rimwechete refaira. Ongorora kana munyori wacho achida kuponeswa patsva. Mafaira akatsiviwa anogamuchira makopi ekudzokorora; kupinza update hakusi kuiswazve kwakachena uye hakubvisi mafaira aripo kubva mupakeji itsva.
Kuvandudza kunonyora mapakeji akazara panzvimbo pezvinhu zvose. Kuiswa (kwete kuongororwazve) kunoreva kuti kupinza kwakanyorwa, kwete kuti mafaira ose akaiswa achangobva kuongororwa zvakare. Roll Back Import inoshandura kutumira kwese kwakasarudzwa, kusanganisira mamwe ma mods mupakeji imwechete, uye inoramba kutsiva mafaera akachinjwa kunze kweSynix. Mamiriro ezvinhu akasarudzwa uye zviwanikwa zvemamiriro ezvinhu zvinodikanwa nenyika dzakachengetedzwa zvinodzivirirwa kubva mukubviswa; chiitiko chakanyorwa chinogadziridzwa chinogona kudzoserwa kumagwaro aro ekare.

data.name: Content.9CA409AF86EBA5BEC5C1
data.value:
Vhura Configure → Network & RCON kuti uongorore magumo anotsigirwa nemutambo wakasarudzwa. Shandisa gadziriro chaiyo yemutambo, kwete rondedzero yakajairika yezviteshi.
DZIMWE DZIMWE DZIMWE • Game port: Player traffic. • Query port: Server ruzivo kana kuwanikwa, kana kuti query protocol inotsigirwa. • RCON/admin port: Chiteshi chekutonga chisingabvumirwi. • App/API port: Game-specific companion kana manejimendi basa.
TCP uye UDP mapurogiramu akasiyana. Mapurogiramu maviri akasiyana-siyana anogona kushandisa nhamba imwe chete yechiteshi, asi mavhareji maviri haagoni kugoverana kupindira kwekunzwa kunopesana. Synix inoongororawo ma profiles akachengetwa kuti aone kusagadzikana kwechiteshi, kusanganisira zvinyorwa zvakamiswa.
Chengetedza endpoints akagoneswa yakasiyana zviitiko uye kuchengeta chero mutambo zvinodiwa ukama pakati zviteshi. Usafungidzira kuti mutambo wose uri UDP kana kuti munda mumwe nomumwe wemubvunzo unomiririra muteereri chaiye.
Kutonga Hakusi Mutambo Vatambi havawanzodi kuwana RCON kana imwe admin endpoint. Chengetedza kutungamirirwa kwepamba kunze kwekunge uine hurongwa hwakachengeteka hwekutungamirirwa kure.
ZVIMWE ZVIMWE ZVINOTAURANA NEMUTambo • Minecraft Java uye Bedrock vanoshandisa maitiro akasiyana ekubatanidza; tevera chinyorwa chakasarudzwa. • Satisfactory's local API inoshandisa mutambo wayo wakagadzirirwa/API port; kukosha kwayo kwekare kwemubvunzo wemunda hakusi chinodikanwa chekuwedzera cheSynix. • Dune's query field metadata inomiririra yayo RMQ kutumirwa chiteshi, kwete yakajairika Steam A2S kubvunza basa. • Rust+ inoshandisawo mugumo wayo wekushanda pamwe chete nemutambo.
Mamiriro ekusarudzika etsamba ndiwo mavambo ekutanga, kwete rondedzero yepasirese yekuvhura router. Ongorora muteereri chaiye usati wachinja mutemo we firewall.

data.name: Content.9D05F59E4F03A202388D
data.value: Dune: Awakening inoshandisa hurumende yakatsaurirwa-server kutumira hurongwa. Hyper-V uye hardware virtualization inofanira kugoneswa, uye Windows Pro kana Enterprise inodiwa. Pakutanga kuvhurwa, Synix inotanga battlegroup.bat seMutariri. Sarudza initial-setup uye gadzirira yako Self-Host Token. Synix inogona kuisa, kuvandudza, kuchengetedza, uye kuvhura kutumira, asi mutambo wacho une michina chaiyo nemamiriro avo. Nhungamiro yepamutemo: https://duneawakening.com/en/news/dedicated-server-how-to-guide

data.name: Content.A2B1D27FE31D2DC1D587
data.value:
Discord webhooks inotumira zvasarudzwa zviitiko zvevashandisi kuchiteshi. Idzo mashoko, kwete Discord bot kuti kure kudzora Synix.
Gadza Chinangwa 1. Gadzira kana kuwana webhook yechiteshi chaunobvumirwa kutarisira. 2. Vhura peji reConfigure → Discord yebasa rakasarudzwa. 3. Pinda webhook uye sarudza zviripo chiitiko-routing mikana. 4. Chengetedza gadziriro. 5. Shandisa chiito chekuedza kana chiri kupiwa, kana kuti simbisa kuendesa panguva yechiitiko chakagadzirirwa.
Start, shutdown, kupora, backup, uye kugadziriswa mameseji zvinoenderana nenzira dzakasimudzirwa uye kana kushanda chaiko kwakaitika.
Kudzivirira URL A webhook URL ine zvinyorwa zvekutumira. Munhu wose anoitora anogona kutumira mameseji kuchiteshi ichocho. Ramba uri kure nemasikirini, nyaya, zvinyorwa, uye hurukuro.
Synix inodzivirira webhook yayo yakachengetedzwa yevashandisi veWindows. Kana URL iri pachena, shandura kana kuidzima muDiscord, wobva wavandudza nzvimbo yeSynix. Ongorora mazita emaseva uye mashoko ezviitiko akatumirwa kuchiteshi chakagoverwa.
Kana Mashoko Asingasviki Tarisa nzira yakasarudzwa yechiitiko, URL, chiteshi / webhook kuwanikwa, uye kana PC ichigona kusvika Discord. Ongorora kukanganisa kwakataurwa usingabudisi URL yakazara.
Mashoko anoshandisa kubatana kunobuda kuDiscord. Hazvidi kuvhurwa kwechiteshi chekudzora chinouya che router.

data.name: Content.AC2F6ED0F16118E96232
data.value:
Sarudza kuti uri kubvisa chete control panel here kana kuti uri kubvisawo zvachose maseva ako akachengetwa. Izvozvo zviito zvakasiyana.
Bvisa ZVINONYANYA ZVAUNOITA 1. Pedzisa chero kuisirwa, kutamisirwa, kana kuti kubatsirwa kuri kumhanya. 2. Mira maseva ako achishandisa Synix, mirira kuti apedze kuchengetedza, uye buda muSynix. 3. Chengetedza kopi yakasimbiswa yenyika dzinokosha, mafaira ekugadzirisa, uye zvitupa. 4. Bvisa Synix kuburikidza neWindows Mapurogiramu akaiswa kana maneja wepakiti yako.
Chengetedza C:\Synix, mafaira emaseva akasarudzika, ekuchengetedza mitambo yekunze, uye nzvimbo dzekuchengetedza kana uchida kuashandisa zvakare. Kudzorera kushandiswa hakurevi kubvisa mafaira aya.
Bvisa SERVER INTRA Shandisa basa rekudzima re server yakasarudzwa muSynix uye verenga kusimbiswa. Kubvisa mashoko ari paDashboard hakusi kubvumirana kubvisa mafaira okuisa kana kuti maBackup. Ongorora kuti mashoko api achabviswa.
Usashandisa kudzima senzira pfupi yekugadzirisa matambudziko. Backups yakachengetwa chete mukati mefaira rauri kudzima haisi kopi yekudzoreredza.
Kana uri kuchinja kune imwe pani yekudzora, simbisa kuti inogona kutanga kuiswa kwakakodzera uye kurodha nyika yaunoda usati wabvisa data rako rekare.

data.name: Content.B4F7813ACC4371C7ADEF
data.value:

Zvitsva kuSYNIX here? Vhura Yekutanga Setup Guide muGetting Started & Setup.
KUGADZIRIRA SERVER? Sarudza chikamu chebasa racho, zvakadai sokugadziriswa, networking, backups, kana kuti mutambo unodzora.
Uri Kutsvaka Kukanganisa Here? Dzvanya Ctrl+F uye tsvaka chimwe chinhu, mutambo, kana kuti chikamu chiduku chemashoko acho. Tsvakurudzo inoongorora misoro yenyaya uye rugwaro rwakakwana uye inoita kuti rugwaro rwakafanana ruonekwe.
Shandisa bhatani rekutsvaga kuti udzokere kumisoro yose. Dhawunirodha uye tsigira zvinongedzo zvinovhurika mubrowser yako chete kana uchizvisarudza.

data.name: Content.B6FC67DB36AEA1C2C9E1
data.value: ATLAS inoda kutengeswa kwemaseva grid uye Redis database inosanganisirwa nayo ShooterGameServer.exe isati yatanga. Synix icharambidza kutanga kusvikira ShooterGame\ServerGrid.json uye ShooterGame\ServerGrid.ServerOnly.json varipo. Gadzira grid neGrapeshot Games ServerGridEditor yepamutemo, isa mafaera ese ari maviri mufolda reShooterGame, uye tanga AtlasTools\RedisDatabase\redis-server_start.bat usati watanga ATLAS server. Redis inofanira kuramba iri pedyo ne127.0.0.1 uye chiteshi che6379 hachifaniri kuiswa paInternet.

data.name: Content.B9AD3A6BF122B35896B1
data.value:
Sarudza sevha uye shandisa zvishandiso zvayo zvekuyedza kubatana kana kuti zvekutamba kana zviripo. Synix inosarudza macheki zvinoenderana nemubvunzo unotsigirwa wemutambo, TCP / UDP / HTTP, yemuno API, uye maitiro ekugadzirisa.
ZVINOTAURWA Nemugumisiro Mhinduro yekubatanidza yakaderera hairatidzi kuti mutambi anogona kuzivikanwa uye kubatana. Nzira iripowo hairatidzi kuti basa rayo rokubvunza rakagadzirira.
Nhamba yevatambi uye mazita evatambi zvinhu zvakasiyana. Server inogona kutaura kuti vatambi vangani vakabatana pasina kuzivisa rondedzero yakanyorwa. Rondedzero isina chinhu haisi nhamba yakasimbiswa yevatambi zero.
Zvishandiso Zvakavanzika OR N/A Mamwe EOS chete kana crossplay modes havasi kuratidza yakavimbika rutsigiro mubvunzo kana mutambi utariri mugero. Synix inogona kuratidza N/A kana kusiya bvunzo panzvimbo pekuratidza mhedzisiro inotsausa.
Tarisa edition yakasarudzwa uye configured utariri mugero nokuda Minecraft. Satisfactory mutambi nhamba zvinoenderana yayo zvokusarudza omunharaunda API kubatana. Usagadzira chete vanogadzira EOS credentials kumanikidza bvunzo.
SERVER-BROWSER LISTINGS Mitambo yakawanda yeSteam inoshandisa mibvunzo yeA2S, asi izvi hazvisi zvepasirese. Kunyoresa, marongero emitambo, uye basa rebhurawuza zvinokanganisa kuoneka, uye hapana nguva yakavimbiswa yokunyora.
Kana sevha isiripo pabhurawuza, edza nzira yemutambo yekubatanidza nayo zvakananga woongorora zvinyorwa zvayo. Kuchinja mashizha emubvunzo asina chokuita kakawanda kunogona kuunza mamwe matambudziko.

data.value:
ZVINONYANYA KUDZIDZA:

2. Gadzirisa 'dedicatedServerConfig.xml' kuti utsanangure mapassword emutungamiri webhu uye mapurazi ekuchengetedza maID.

data.name: Content.BDCE626AE85DA5ADC9CD
data.value:
Shandisa Configure yeminda yakajairika inotarisirwa naSynix. Shandisa mhariri wefaira rekugadzirisa muServer Options kana uchida kutarisa kana kuchinja gadziriro chaiyo yemutambo.
1. Mira sevha kana ichiverenga faira pakatanga kana kuti ichinyorazve paunenge uchimhanya. 2. Ita backup uye simbisa server yakasarudzwa uye faira. 3. Verenga tsika dziripo nemashoko. 4. Chinja chete marongero aunoda kuchinja. 5. Gadzirisa zvikanganiso zvokupupurira zvomupepeti uye dzokorora nyevero dzake. 6. Chengetedza, shandisa Server kuburikidza Synix, uye tarisa uchangobva mutambo Log.
ZVIMWE Zvishandiso Zvinotsigirwa Synix inopa format-kuziva kubata nokuda akatsigira INI / zvivako, JSON, XML, YAML, uye mamwe profile-specific Formats. Haasi mafaira ose kana kuti sarudzo dzose dzine purogiramu yekugadzirisa. YAML editing inotsigira nested settings, indented lists, uye single-line values apo kuchengeta mashoko uye indentation. Zvinhu zvakaoma zveYAML zvakadai seanchor, aliases, inline collections, uye multiline values zvinorambidzwa pasina kuchengetedza.
Chengeta kiyi dzokugadzirisa, tsika dzinogamuchirwa, mazita emepu, uye mirairo sezvainotarisirwa nemutambo. Usashandure kuti zvienderane nemutauro wepurogiramu.
Kuongorora Kwete Bvunzo Yokutamba Nayo Faira rakagadzirwa zvakanaka rinogona kunge riine marongero asina kuwirirana. Mods kana kuti mitambo inogadziridzwa inogona kuwedzera zvinhu zvisingazivikanwi nemupepeti. Ongorora kuti mutambo wakaisa faira rauri kuda uye nyika pashure pokutangazve.
Kana mumwe mupepeti kana kuti mutambo ukashandura faira racho richiri rakavhurika, ridzazve uye enzanisa usati waponesa. mafaira emutambo anogona kunge aine mapassword kana tokens anoverenga; dzokorora uye dzigadzirise usati wagovana.
Satisfactory's mhenyu API sarudzo dzinomira muControl Center yayo uye dzakaparadzaniswa nekugadzirisa mafaera ayo ekumisikidza diski.

data.name: Content.C3732C45553C69AA02C1
data.value:
Sarudza Configure for an existing server, kana kuti shandisa hwindo rekugadzirisa paunenge uchigadzira imwe. Chinja minda chete inoshanda kumutambo wako.
ZVINHU ZVOKUTANGIRA NEZVAKAITIKA Nzira yokutanga inosimbisa marongero akajairika uye murayiro wekutanga unokurudzirwa. Advanced mode inoratidza zvimwe zvedzidzo, kusanganisira inotsigirwa RCON uye mbishi kutanga mikana. Kuchinja modes hakubvisi akachengetwa tsika. Discord zviziviso zviripo mune zvose modes.
ZVINOTAURWA NEPAI NEDZIMWE • General: Server zita, mutambo, shanduro / shanduro, uye inotsigirwa Gameplay Profile sarudzo. • Kuchengetedzwa: Mapasiwedi uye mamwe marongero ekuwana anotsigirwa netemplate. • Chizvarwa Chenyika: Zita renyika, mbeu, kukura, uye nzira dzinoshanda munyika. • Network & RCON: Gameplay inotsigirwa, mubvunzo, shamwari / API, uye administrative endpoints. • Automation: Backup/update-on-start uye yakarongwa kuchengetedza. • Discord: Nzvimbo dzekuzivisa uye nzira yechiitiko. • Install & Launch: Folda yekuisa uye inotsigirwa sarudzo dzekutanga.
Nzvimbo dzakakanganiswa dzemutambo dzinoitwa nemaune. Mutambo unogona kuva nehurongwa uhwu kana kuti haufaniri kutsigirwa; kumanikidza nharo dzokuwedzera mukutungamirira hakusi kutsiva kwakachengeteka.
ZVIMWE ZVINHU ZVINA Server Details → Zvinodiwa Settings → Ongororo → Save server
Izvi tarisa configuration kugadzirira, kwete kukopa kana kugadzwa mberi. Kana marongero anodiwa apfuura nekusimbiswa, Synix inovhura nhanho 3 kuitira kuti iwe ugone kuongorora sarudzo dzako, wobva wavhura Save Server. Kuchinja marongero kunovhara Save zvakare kusvikira sarudzo dzakagadziridzwa dzaratidzwa muReview. Unofanira kusarudza kuponesa pachako; kuvhura Ongororo haisi kuzoponesa. Verenga mashoko chaiwo ari pasi apa kana chimwe chinhu chichida kutarisirwa.
Paunenge uchigadzirisa sevha, inomisa kutanga kana kuchinja kwacho kuchikanganisa mafaira kana kuti zvingasarudzwa zvakaverengwa pakatanga. Save Changes inovandudza chimiro chayo; hazvivimbisi kuti mutambo uri kumhanya wakashandisa tsika idzi. Tangazve kuburikidza Synix apo mutambo kunoda izvozvo.

data.name: Content.CBFC11B8C03869110CF7
data.value:
Vhura Configure → Automation kuitira kuti server yakasarudzwa isarudze basa rinoitika pamberi pekutanga kunotsigirwa.
BACK UP ON START Ita izvi kuti ugadzire backup yakamira-server isati yatanga kushanda. Isa mudzi wekutsigira uye kuchengetedza muApplication Settings → Backups.
Kuparadzwa-kupora kunotanga kusapfuudza zvakajairika zvekuchengetedza. Automatic startup backups haisi kutsiva kuramba vakazvimiririra kupora pfungwa pamberi kuchinja kukuru.
Gadziridza START Ita kuti izvi zviitike kuti uongorore kugadziridzwa kwemutambo kunotsigirwa usati watanga. Inogadziridza mafaira emushandi wemutambo, kwete chikumbiro cheSynix.
Kuongororwa kwekuvandudzwa hakusi kuvimbisa kuti kutanga kwose kunotora mafaira. SteamCMD nomugadziri womutambo vanosarudza zvinodiwa.
VALIDATION AND CUSTOM FILES Chiito cheValidate chinogona kugadzirisa kana kudzorerazve mafaira anotarisirwa nemugadziri. Kuchengetedza shanduko dzisati dzavandudzwa kana kusimbiswa; usafungidzira kuti mafaira etsika anogara asina kubatwa.
Edza ZVAUNOSarudza Chengetedza marongero uye ita kuti vanhu vatange. Verenga mhedzisiro yebasa racho kuti uwane backup, update, uye launch. Kudhanilodha kwakapedzwa hakuratidzi kuti mutambo wacho wakabudirira.
Bvumira nzvimbo yakakwana yokuchengetera zvinyorwa, kudhanilodha, mafaira enguva pfupi, uye mutambo wakaiswa. Kana basa risati ratanga richitaura nezvekukundikana, tsvakurudza chikonzero chakataurwa pane kuvhura sevha imwechete kunze kweSynix kuti uzvidzivise.

data.name: Content.CD4007BB408F0C6825C6
data.value: Vhura Documents\American Truck Simulator\config.cfg uye kuisa kushandisa g_console "1". Vhura zvakajairika American Truck Simulator mutambo, kurodha kwako Profile uye mepu, Press ~ kuvhura Console, uye kumhanya export_server_packages. Vhara mutambo wacho, wobva wadzvanya Start muSynix zvakare. Synix ichatora mafaira akagadzirwa otomatiki.

data.name: Content.CEBB295EB1521FABB36D
data.value:
Vhura Kugadzirira kwebasa rakasarudzwa risati ratanga kana chimwe chinhu chikakundikana. Inounganidza kuongororwa kunotsigirwa neprofile iyoyo, senge mafaira, runtimes, configuration, disk space, ports, maitiro ehurumende, uye zvinyorwa zvakakodzera.
Nzwisisa Zvakaitika • Kugadzirira: Hapana nyaya dzokuvharira dzakawanikwa pamishonga iripo. • Kudzokorora: Verenga zvakawanikwa uye sarudza kuti pane zvaunofanira kuita here. • Kuvharwa: Gadzirisa nyaya yakataurwa usati waenderera mberi.
Kugadzirira hakuiti kuti kugadziriswa kwose kunenge kwava kuda kuitwa kuve kwakagadzirwa. Ongorora danho rakataurwa uye kusimbiswa kwaro.
Pashure POKUCHengetedza Nhoroondo Itsva Kutanga kwekutanga kunogona kudhawunirodha mafaira, kuisa runtime inotsigirwa, kugadzira gadziriro, uye kumirira kutanga kwemutambo. Tevera mirayiridzo yokutanga-kutanga uye Activity & Diagnostics pane kubata zvinyorwa zvakaponeswa zvemadheshibhodhi semutambo wakaiswa.
Mimwe mitambo inoda chibvumirano, kusimbiswa, kana mukati-mutambo kudana / chikamu setup chero munhu asati anogona kubatana. Pedzisa danho iroro panzvimbo inodiwa nemutambo.
KUSHANDIRA kuwirirana Isa, Tanga, Mira, uye Ongorora mhedzisiro yekurekodha mashandiro Synix yakacherechedza. Hazvina kuongororwa asi zvinoreva kuti hapana mhedzisiro yakanyorwa; hazvirevi kuti mutambo unozivikanwa kuti wakaputsika.
Mugumisiro wakagadzirira kana kuti kuongororwa kwepanyika kwakabudirira hakusi kuvimbiswa kwekuwana internet, modhi dzakanaka, kana kuwirirana nemutengi mumwe nomumwe. Pedzisa nokuedza kubatana kwakarongwa nenyika.

data.name: Content.D04B8B2F340C3B82596E
data.value:
Backup yakasarudzwa-server inochengetedza mafaira ari mufolda yekuisa yeiyo server. Ongorora kuti mutambo wacho unoponesa sei nyika yawo usati waivimba nawo.
Gadzira Zvokudzorera 1. Dzivisa server kuburikidza Synix uye kumirira kuti maitiro ayo kubuda. 2. Sarudza basa rekuchengetedza muServer Options. 3. Ongorora nzvimbo yacho, nzvimbo yauri kuenda, saizi inofungidzirwa, uye nzvimbo iripo. 4. Simbisa uye mirira kuti upedze. 5. Sarudza Open Backup Folder kuti uwane archive. Ramba uine gwaro racho.
KUVHURWA Backups inosanganisira faira rekugadza, kwete subfolder diki yekuchengetedza. Mitambo mikuru inogona kuda nguva yakawanda nokuchengetwa.
Kuchengetedza muAppData, Zvinyorwa, imwe dhiraivha, kana muchina chaiwo wemutambo unogona kunge uri kunze kweiyo folda. Dzokera shure zvakasiyana uchishandisa nzira inotsigirwa nemutambo.
Nzvimbo Yokuchengetera Zvinhu Tsika dzekuchengetedza midzi ndeye C:\Synix\BackupGames. Settings → Backups inokutendera iwe kusarudza imwe midzi uye kuisa iyo yakachengetedzwa-backup muganho.
Nzvimbo yacho inofanira kunge iri kunze kweiyo source server folder. Kuchinja bhatani rekutsigira hakufambisi kana kudzima zvinyorwa zviripo; ongorora nzvimbo yekare kuti uone ma backup ekare.
Kuchengetwa kunobvisa zvinyorwa zvekare kana muganhu wakagadzirirwa ukapfuudzwa panguva yekugadzira backup. Chengetedza nzvimbo dzokudzorera dzinogara dziri kunze kwenzvimbo iyoyo yokudzorera.
Chengetedza imwe kopi yakasimbiswa yenyika dzakakosha pane imwe nzvimbo yokuchengetera. Disiki rakakundikana rinogona kuparadza zvose sevhavha uye backups yakachengetwa pane imwecheteyo disk. ZIP yefolda yekutumira yekunze haisi automatically inowirirana VM kana dhatabhesi backup.

data.name: Content.D2EE952679F0F36E81E6
data.value:
Verenga mashoko chaiwo eWindows usati wasarudza zvokuchinja. Chinhu chinobviswa, kukanganisa kuwana mafaira, uye nguva yekumhanya yemutambo isiripo zvinetso zvakasiyana.
SYNIX HAIZOFANISI KUISIMBIRA kana KUVhura Shandisa shanduro yepamutemo kana kuti yakarurama WinGet pasuru ubidzz.Synix. Kana uchitsiva faira inoshuma kuwana kwakarambwa, vhara iyo Synix muenzaniso uchishandisa nzira iyoyo zvakajairika uye edza zvakare. Ongorora kuwanika kwemafolda uye mashoko ezvokuchengetedza kana dambudziko racho richienderera mberi.
Usadzima dhata remushandisi kana kudzima chengetedzo sechigadziriso chakajairika.
SMARTSCREEN A mukurumbira yambiro anogona kupa More info → Run zvakadaro, zvichienderana Windows mutemo. Kuvapo kwenzira iyoyo hakuratidzi kuti faira rakachengeteka. Ongorora tsime rehurumende uye uongorore nyevero yacho usati wasarudza kuenderera mberi.
SMART APP CONTROL Izvi zvinogona kuvharira purogiramu apo Windows isingakwanisi kusimbisa kuvimba kwakakwana. Hauna munhu-app bypass kuenzana SmartScreen's Run zvakadaro. Usadzima Windows zvigadziro zvekuchengetedza chete kuti umhanye Synix.
ANTIVIRUS OR HASH FAIL Ongorora kuonekwa kwakanyatsojeka uye mafaira. Usafungidzira kuti chiziviso chiri chakaipa nokuti faira racho rine zita rokuti Synix. SHA-256 hash inoenderana inozivisa faira rakadhindwa; hazvisimbisi kuvimba kana kusaina kodhi.
Taura nzira chaiyo yokunyevera uye yokugadza nayo uchibvisa mashoko akavanzika. Dzivisa kubviswa kwakajairika kana kusapfuudza installer hash kuongorora.
