data.name: Content.DEF7504305FCA62C7644
data.value:
Shandisa Settings → Backups kuti uwane Synix yakakwana inotengeswa/inotengeswa. Izvi zvakasiyana nekunyoresa imwe faira iripo yevashandi.
Ongorora Zvinofanira Kufamba Mabhokisi ekutengesa anotakura muti mukuru weC:\Synix. Server custom kana backup mafaira kunze kwayo uye yokunze mutambo anoponesa zvinoda kutarisirwa zvakasiyana. Nyora nzira dzavo usati watanga. Zvido zvakajairika zveWindows zvinogonawo kuda kuongororwa kunzvimbo yekuenda.
EXPORT 1. Mira maseva opedza basa rokuraramisa, kurodha pasi, uye kuita backups. 2. Sarudza encrypted kana Normal ekisipoti. 3. Sarudza nzvimbo iri kunze kwemuti unobva uye tarisa saizi uye zvinodiwa nenzvimbo yenguva pfupi. 4. Kana uchida kutumira zvinhu kunze kwenyika zvakavanzika, sarudza password yakasimba yekuchinjisa woichengeta zvakasiyana. 5. Mirira kuti purogiramu ye .synixbackup ipedze, wozoongorora.
Sarudza KUDzivirirwa Kwakanaka Export yakavharidzirwa inodzivirira pasuru uye inotsigira kutakurwa kwezvinyorwa zvinotsigirwa kuWindows account yekuenda.
Kunotengeswa kwenguva dzose hakusi kunyorwa. Mafaira emitambo uye zvinyorwa zviri mukati mayo zvinogona kuratidza zvakavanzika. Kutevedzera Windows yakasungwa encrypted tsika hazvirevi kuti pachavo kuita kuti ushandiswe pane imwe nhoroondo.
KUTANGA 1. Tanga waunganidza mashoko aripo eSynix. 2. Vhura zvigadziro zvekupinza/kuongorora uye sarudza pasuru yakatarwa. 3. Ipa password yekutumira kana ikakumbirwa uye simbisa pasuru. 4. Ongorora nzvimbo yauri kuenda, zvinodiwa nediski, uye nyora yambiro. 5. Regai kugadzirwa, kuongororwa uye kupora zvipedzisike. 6. Ongorora nzira dzevashandi, zviteshi, marongero, nzvimbo dzekuchengetedza, uye zvitupa usati watanga chero chinhu.
Reconnect Satisfactory kana yayo yomunharaunda kuzivikanwa kana kudzivirirwa kubatana haasisiri kuwirirana. Chengetedza purogiramu yepakutanga nedata rekare kusvikira mavhareji anotorwa aedzwa.
Kutama kwemashoko kunotsigirwa kunochengetedza kopi yedatabhesi risati rasvika. Kana kupinza kana kutama kukundikana, chengetedza kopi iyoyo nemashoko ekudzoreredza pane kutsiva dhatabhesi riri kushanda apo Synix iri kumhanya.

data.name: Content.E03D856AEDD6B1B81DFD
data.value:
Install & Launch ine faira re server rakasarudzwa uye sarudzo dzaro dzinotsigirwa dzekutanga. Chengeta murayiro wakakurudzirwa kunze kwokunge wanyatsonzwisisa hurukuro yemutambo.
ZVINOGADZIRWA Shandisa Advanced mode apo nharo mbishi dzinodiwa. Ongorora mashoko, nzira dzinogona kushandiswa, uye mazita ezvisarudzo zvinodikanwa mumutambo. Synix inopa kare inotsigirwa manejimendi nharo; kuwedzera imwe kopi kunogona kuita kuti zvinhu zvipindirane.
Usashandura switches kana kutsiva unotarisirwa hwokugadzira ukoshi nemashoko ayo akashandurwa. Usambofa wakawedzera zviratidzo kumurayiro kungoitira kuti zvive nyore kukopa.
EXPORTED LAUNCH FILES Kune maprofiles anotsigirwa, Server Options → Create Batch File inonyora rakagadziriswa kuvhura mirairo kune script.
Faira iroro rinogona kunge riine mapassword anogona kuverengwa kana kuti zviratidzo zvebasa kuitira kuti riite basa rakazvimiririra. Ramba uri wega uye uongorore usati wagovana kana kutamisa.
Kumhanya manyorerwo kunze Synix hakupi zvose Synix kushanda zvevharuvhu, watchdog kuwirirana, backups, kana yakarongwa kugadzirwa. Usamumhanya Synix yatova kuti Server kumhanya.
ZVIMWE ZVAKAITIKA Mamwe maprofayiri emitambo anotanga zvishandiso zvavo zvekuisa panzvimbo peimwe nzira yakajairika yebasa. Zvishandiso izvozvo zvingada kubvumirwa kwakasiyana uye zvinogona kusatsigira kutengeswa kwefaira rekutanga. Tevera nhungamiro yemutambo yeprofile pane kutsiva imwe executable kana wrapper.

data.name: Content.EA307763F93AA4306555
data.value:
Shandisa purogiramu yepamutemo yekusunungurwa. Inosanganisira .NET runtime inodiwa neSynix; maseva emitambo angangodawo zvaanenge asarudza.
Sarudza Nzira Yokuisa • MSI: Dhawunirodha SynixSetup.msi, kumhanya, wobva wavhura Synix Control Panel kubva kuStart menu. Nzvimbo yakajairika yekushandisa pamushandisi ndeye %LocalAppData%\Programs\Synix. • WinGet: Shandisa purogiramu chaiyo.Synix. Nyaya WinGet Installation and Updates ine mirairo. • Inogona kutorwa pachayo: Isa iyo yepamutemo yakazvimiririra kurodha pasi mufaira rinogona kunyorwa woishandisa ipapo. Kufambisa chinhu ichocho hachisi kutsauswa kwakazara kwemaseva ako.
Dhawunirodha zviri pamutemo: https://github.com/ubidzz/Synix-Control-Panel/releases/latest
Gadziridza KUSHANDISA 1. Pedzisa kurodha pasi, kuita backups, uye kugadzira. 2. Dzivisa mitambo yako servers kuburikidza Synix uye kuvhara Synix zvakajairika. 3. Shandisa updater kana installer yenzira yawakasarudza yekuisa. 4. Vhurazve Synix uye tarisa kuti zvinyorwa zvako zvebasa uye nzira dzakarurama.
Kana uchitsiva chigadzirwa chekare cheEXE neMSI, tanga wabvisa chigadzirwa chekare. Chengetedza mashoko omubatsiri uye mafaira emubatsiri akasarudzwa. Usadzima C:\Synix kuti ugadzirise purogiramu.
Kugadziridza kunoshandiswa hakugadziridzi mitambo yaunogamuchira. Shandisa basa rekuti "Update" pane server yakasarudzwa kuti uite izvozvo.
Kana Windows ichitaura kurambwa kwekupinda paunenge uchitsiva chinonzi executable, tarisa kuti kopi iri kutsiviwa haisi kumhanya. Usanyora pamusoro pechikumbiro chiri kumhanya kana kubvisa data rebasa kuti ushandise kukanganisa.

data.name: Content.F77CEDCB39BB6AFDDB17
data.value:
Synix inoongorora kumanikidzwa kwemidziyo isati yatangwa kuitira kuderedza mikana yokunyanyisa kutakura. Kana kutanga kuchinonoka kana kuvharirwa, verenga nyaya yemidziyo yakataurwa.
Ramba Uine Imba Yokuitira Munhu Waunogara Bvumira ndangariro Windows uye kumashure zvikumbiro uyewo mutambo. Chengetedza nzvimbo ye diski iripo nokuda kwokuvandudza, mafaira enguva pfupi, kuchengetedza, uye backups.
A configured Minecraft ndangariro muganhu kunokanganisa mutambo wayo / runtime. Haisi muganhu wakaoma wenyika yose nokuda kwechiito chimwe nechimwe chakatangwa nemutambo mumwe nomumwe.
Kuongororwa kwemidziyo hakuiti kuti sevha ive mumudziyo weCPU/RAM kana kuvimbisa kuti Windows haigoni kupera nemidziyo. Shandisa chishandiso Monitor uye yose PC dashboard pfupiso kunzwisisa chaiko mutoro.
NETWORK GUARD The experimental network-nyaradzo kuchiitwa tarisa zvisingawanzoitiki bandwidth / pfuma ezvinhu uye nhoroondo anozivikanwa SteamCMD basa kuderedza nyevero dzenhema.
Haisi firewall, traffic filter, kana DDoS kudzivirira basa. Chenjezo hariratidzi munhu anorwisa kana kuti rinoratidza kuti kurwiswa kwakaitika.
Paunonyeverwa, enzanisa basa racho nezvinozivikanwa zvekuodhaunirodha, kuita backups, nezvimwewo zvinoshandiswa. Ongorora zvinyorwa zvakakodzera usati wachinja marongero ekuchengetedza kana enetiweki.

2. Zvinyorwa zvepamutemo: https://wiki.factorio.com/Multiplayer#Server_settings

data.name: Content.F83D1D2838B71617191E
data.value:
Sarudza iyo Rust profile uye tarisa nyika yayo, hunhu, mutambo, mubvunzo, uye shamwari marongero usati watanga.
ZVINONYANYA ZVAKAITIKA Synix inopa kukosha kwe+server.identity kunotsigirwa kubva pachiratidzo chebasa. Chengetedza zvivako zvakasiyana uye kuzivikanwa kuti zviitiko zvakasiyana kuitira kuti vasagoverana vasingazivi nyika kana configuration.
RUST+ Gadzirisa yakasarudzika inotsigirwa App Port yebasa remubatanidzwa, wozotevera Rust's pairing uye network requirements. Endpoint yayo yakaparadzaniswa nemutambi mutambo uye optioneel RCON utariri.
Ongorora zviteshi chaizvoizvo configured pane kukopa mutemo kubva mumwe Rust Server. Chengetedza RCON zvitupa uye usazvibudisa kuti ubatsire vanhu kujoina.
VANILLA AND OXIDE Vanilla anoshandisa mafaira emushandi wepamutemo. Kusarudza Oxide kunowedzera hurongwa hwepamutemo hunotsigirwa pashure pemafaira eSteam. Kuiswa kwepurogiramu hakusarudzi kana kuongorora plugins yega yega.
Shandisa Mod & Plugin Manager's inotsigirwa local workflow yeOxide/uMod installation yakaonekwa. Maplugin achiri kuda mavhezheni anowirirana uye masosi akavimbika.
Synix inoshandisazve iyo inotsigirwa Oxide runtime mushure mekuvandudzwa kana kusimbiswa kweRust kana hurongwa uhwu hwasarudzwa. Kuti udzokere kumafaira eVanilla epamutemo, chinja chisarudzo chehurongwa uye umhanye basa rinotsigirwa rekuvandudza kana kusimbisa.
Usati wachinja purogiramu kana mutambo, chengetedza nyika, kugadziriswa, uye plugin data. Ongorora zvose mutambo uye Oxide zvinyorwa pashure restarting; kubudirira framework Download hakuratidzi kuti plugin ose akaremerwa nemazvo.

data.name: Content.FE08796B9B27C2F7036C
data.value: ATLAS iri clustered Server uye haagoni kusika mafaira aya nokutanga Server. Shandisa Grapeshot Games ServerGridEditor yepamutemo kugadzira nekutengesa kunze grid. Kopa ServerGrid.json uye ServerGrid.ServerOnly.json mufolda yeShooterGame yebasa. Usati watanga ATLAS, shandisa AtlasTools\RedisDatabase\redis-server_start.bat uye siya Redis ichimhanya. Ramba Redis akasungwa 127.0.0.1; usaratidza chiteshi che6379 kune LAN, router, kana Internet. Mupepeti Mukuru: https://github.com/GrapeshotGames/ServerGridEditor

data.name: Content.FE8445D560EC3691D1E1
data.value: Ongorora kuti Synix inovaka sei murayiro wakashandiswa kutanga sevha iyi.

data.name: Content.FF6EEAB0A9848FC8CD5C
data.value: Synix inogadzira iyo yakazara server-inogadzirwa serverconfig.xml marongero uye inodzora zita re server, password, chiteshi, mutambi muganho, nyika, mbeu, uye saizi yenyika. Mamwe mavara emitambo anoramba achigadziriswa mumushanduri wekugadzirisa.

data.name: Language.Description
data.value: Sarudza mutauro unoshandiswa neSynix. Mitemo yemutambo uye tsika dzakachengetwa hadzina kushandurwa.

data.name: Uninstall.Everything
data.value: Bvisa purogiramu, maseva anotarisirwa uye Synix data

data.name: Uninstall.Keep
data.value: Inobvisa zvaunofarira zveSynix app, cache, mafaira enguva pfupi uye zvinyorwa zvekutanga kweapp. Rinochengeta zvose C:\Synix, mutambo servers, backups uye kupora mafaira. Rondedzero yevashandi uye marongero muSynixData\servers.json anochengetwa uye anoiswazve kana iwe uchinge waisa Synix zvakare.

data.name: Uninstall.Review
data.value: Tarisa mafaera nemaforodha achadzimwa pazasi. Nzvimbo dzichachengetwa hadzisi parondedzero. Kudzima mafaera hakudzoreki, kunyange kana kubvisa chirongwa kukakundikana gare gare.

data.name: Uninstall.Confirm
data.value: Ndachengetedza zvandinoda uye ndinoda kubvisa mafaira aya zvachose.

data.name: Uninstall.Stop
data.value: Vhara Synix uye umise maseva ose emitambo usati wabvisa dhata remushandi.

data.name: Uninstall.Changed
data.value: Zvinyorwa zvevashandi zvakachinja. Ongorora mafaira acho zvakare usati wabvisa chero chinhu.

data.name: Uninstall.Failed
data.value: Kubviswa kwakamiswa. Mamwe mafaira angangodaro akatobviswa. Synix ichiri kuiswa. Ongorora mafaira asara usati waedza zvakare.

data.name: Uninstall.BackupsOption
data.value: Bvisawo mafaira ekuchengetedza uye ekudzorera maseva akanyorwa

data.name: Uninstall.BackupsDelete
data.value: Backups uye mafaira ekudzorera akasarudzwa kuti abviswe:

data.name: Uninstall.NoBackups
data.value: Hapana ma backup akawanikwa munzvimbo dzinozivikanwa dzekuchengetedza Synix.

data.name: Uninstall.KeptLocations
data.value: Nzvimbo dzakachengetwa (kunze kwemabhachi akasarudzwa zvakajeka pamusoro apa):

data.name: Uninstall.CloseApp
data.value: Vhara Synix usati waibvisa. Maseva emitambo anogona kuramba achishanda kana chirongwa chete chabviswa.

data.name: History.Unavailable
data.value: Nhoroondo haigoni kuverengwa kana kuponeswa. Ongorora kupinda kwemafolda uye nzvimbo yakasununguka yedhisiki.

data.name: History.Retention
data.value: Yakachengetwa pakati pemisangano yeSynix. Kusvikira ku{0} zvinyorwa zvitsva pamushandiri. Mapasiwedi nemirairo yokutanga haina kubatanidzwa.

data.name: BackupHealth.Notice
data.value: Kubva pamafaira uye zvikwangwani, kwete kuongororwa kutsva kwokuvimbika. Backups akwegura kupfuura 7 mazuva anosimbiswa.

data.name: History.Empty
data.value: Hapana zviitiko zvakarekodhwa nokuda kwebasa iri.

data.name: Appearance.Description
data.value: Sarudza dingindira, ruvara rwokutaura uye maitiro okudzora. Kuchinja kunoshanda pakarepo uye kunochengetwa otomatiki.

data.name: Settings.Privacy.ActivityCount.Description
data.value: Zvingasarudzwa: tumira kodhi yemusangano isina kujairika ku synix.info maminetsi ese e10 apo Synix inomhanya, kusanganisira kumashure. Hapana data revashandi rinotumirwa. Kuverenga kunopera pashure pemaminitsi 15. Inoshanda nenzira isiriyo. Unogona kuidzima pano.

data.name: RemoteManager.Description
data.value: Batanidza komputa iyi kuti uone, utangise, umise, utangisezve uye ugadzire makopi ekuchengetedza maseva uchishandisa webhusaiti yeSynix. Kupinda uri kure kunoramba kwakadzimwa kusvikira wabvumira kubatanidza pano.

data.name: RemoteManager.Heading
data.value: Dzora kombiyuta iyi kubva pawebsite yeSynix

data.name: RemoteManager.Instructions
data.value:
Pinda pawebsite yacho uye pinda kodhi iyi. Bvumidza zita rako rokushandisa chete pano.
Chengeta Synix yakavhurika kana kuti yakaderedzwa. Kubatana kwakanyarara kunoteerera kunyorera. Dhiyabhorosi yevashandi inovandudzwa mumasekonzi 10 ega ega paanenge achionekwa. Kubvisa vaviri kunodzivisa kuwana kure pasina kumisa maseva.

data.name: RemoteManager.CodeExpired
data.value: Kodhi yacho yapera. Gadzira kodhi itsva yokubatanidza.

data.name: RemoteManager.ClaimFormat
data.value: Kudzora kwekukumbira account: {0} Bvumidza chete kana iri zita rako rekushandisa.

data.name: RemoteManager.CheckFailed
data.value: Haikwanisi kuongorora kushamwaridzana. Ongorora kubatana kwako neIndaneti.

data.name: RemoteManager.Unavailable
data.value: Handikwanisi kutaura nemutungamiriri weSynix. Ndapota edza zvakare.

data.name: RemoteManager.IdentitySoftware
data.value: Chiziviso chemakomputa: Windows-yakachengetedzwa software kiyi (TPM haisi kuwanikwa)

data.name: RemoteManager.RemovalPending
data.value: Yakadzimwa munharaunda. Edzazve kubvisa kana uchinge wabatanidzwa.

data.name: RemoteManager.LoadFailed
data.value: Kubatanidza kwakanga kusingagoni kuiswa. Kuwana zviri kure kwakadzimwa.

data.name: RemoteManager.SaveFailed
data.value: Kusvika kure kwakadzimwa. Kugadzirisa marongero hakukwanisi kuponeswa.

data.name: RemoteManager.PairingRemoved
data.value: Kubatanidzwa kwewebsite kwakadzimwa. Kuwana zviri kure kwakadzimwa.

data.name: RemoteManager.InvalidResponse
data.value: Mutungamiri weSynix akadzorera mhinduro isina kukodzera.

data.name: RemoteManager.FinishUnpair
data.value: Pindazve paIndaneti uye tanga wapedza kubvisa matanda ekare.

data.name: RemoteManager.RecoveryInstructions
data.value: Gadzira pasiwedhi yenguva pfupi pano. Pinda pawebhusaiti nayo pamwe nenzira yako iripo ye2FA kana kiyi yekupinda (passkey), wobva wasarudza pasiwedhi itsva. Kana nzira mbiri dzichidiwa, dzose dzinoramba dzichidiwa. Pasiwedhi yenguva pfupi inoshanda kamwe chete uye inopera mushure memaminitsi 10. Pasiwedhi yako yepakutanga inoramba ichishanda kusvikira kudzorerwa kweakaundi kwapera.

data.name: RemoteManager.RecoveryExpired
data.value: Kudzorera kwapera kana kuti kwakadzimwa. Tangazve.

data.name: RemoteManager.RecoveryLimited
data.value: Zvikumbiro zvakawanda kwazvo. Edza zvakare gare gare.

data.name: Status.Activity.ReconnectedByPath
data.value: [SYNIX] Yakabatanidzwazve kune inomhanya server "{0}" inowanikwa mufaira rayo rekuisa (PID: {1}).

data.name: Settings.Backup.Transfer.RemoteAccessNotice
data.value: Kubatanidzwa kwekupinda kure hakuchinji. Kana ukashandisa mukana uri kure, batanidza kombiyuta itsva neakaundi yako pa manager.synix.info pashure pokudzorera Synix.
